stratagems.name: BURST OF SPEED
stratagems.when: End of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army (excluding units that made a move this phase).
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6, and then cannot move again this phase.|
|FORCE A BREACH|000010249002|Challenger – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|0|Break through their defences, smash down their walls and barricades and breach their lines. Let no obstacle halt your progress.|Your turn|Movement phase|||WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: Having unleashed hell upon their target, this unit presses forward, lent fresh speed and impetus by the invigorating thrill of battle.

stratagems.name: PIVOTAL MOMENT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: The outcome of the battle hangs in the balance. This is the time to strike hard and without mercy.

stratagems.name: ALL IN
stratagems.when: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6 instead of up to 3. In addition, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends it as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: The time has come to commit your forces. Order your soldiers forward, pursue the foe and cut them down without mercy. Victory or death!

stratagems.name: STRATEGIC RETREAT
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: The soundest military minds find no shame in signalling a retreat. Strength preserved may prove pivotal at a later juncture.

stratagems.name: HARBOURED POWER
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability and your choice of the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
stratagems.legend: Overcharged power packs, experimental ammunition, potent combat stimms or sorcerous might: these assets may be expended in the pursuit of victory.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after you make an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test or a Hazardous test for a unit from your army, or a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, or a roll to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in that unit. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple rolls or saving throws at once.
stratagems.target: That unit or model from your army.
stratagems.effect: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those rolls or saving throws to re-roll.
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.

stratagems.name: GO TO GROUND
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have a 6+ invulnerable save and have the Benefit of Cover.
stratagems.legend: Seeking salvation from incoming fire, warriors hurl themselves into whatever cover they can find.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.when: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you take a Battle-shock test for a unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit automatically passes that Battle-shock test.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.

stratagems.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a CHARACTER unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more Attached units is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: One CHARACTER model in your unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all melee attacks made by that model have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.legend: The legends of the 41st Millennium are replete with deadly duels between mighty champions.

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is within 6 of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit now declares a charge that targets only that enemy unit, and you resolve that charge as if it were your Charge phase.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only select a VEHICLE unit from your army if it is a WALKER. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.|
|COUNTER-OFFENSIVE|000008335003|Core – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|2|In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|||WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.

stratagems.name: GRENADE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GRENADES unit from your army (excluding units that Advanced, Fell Back or have shot this turn) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
Select one GRENADES model in your unit and one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 8 of and visible to your GRENADES model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.|
|SMOKESCREEN|000008335011|Core – Wargear Stratagem|1|Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|||WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Priming their hand-held projectiles, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.

stratagems.name: UNLEASH THE LIONS
stratagems.rawType: Lions of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Allarus Custodians or Aquilon Custodians unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: That unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.
stratagems.legend: Heroic bands of Terminator-armoured Custodians engage entire armies in unrelenting battle.

stratagems.name: DEFIANT TO THE LAST
stratagems.rawType: Lions of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if that model has the CHARACTER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is treated as having 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: The harder the battle, and the heavier their losses, the more resolute the Lions of the Emperor become.

stratagems.name: GILDED CHAMPION
stratagems.rawType: Lions of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an Adeptus Custodes Character model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet that states it can only be used ‘once per battle’.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.
stratagems.effect:
Your model can use that ‘once per battle’ ability one additional time during the battle (but not in the same phase).
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.
stratagems.legend: The shining champions of the Adeptus Custodes are looked upon in awe by all who witness their grim arts. Their judgement is without flaw, and their tactical acumen utterly impeccable.

stratagems.name: MANOEUVRE AND FIRE
stratagems.rawType: Lions of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: The Adeptus Custodes are unrelenting in their advance, laying down punishing fire even as they manoeuvre to new positions.

stratagems.name: PURGATION SWEEP
stratagems.rawType: Null Maiden Vigil – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Witchseekers unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit. If such a weapon targets a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit this phase, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic instead.
stratagems.legend: Witchseekers know their role in combat is to spread indiscriminate carnage through the foe’s ranks.

stratagems.name: ANATHEMA BLADEMASTERY
stratagems.rawType: Null Maiden Vigil – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Vigilators unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll If the target of that attack is Battle-shocked or a PSYKER, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.legend: The Vigilators train tirelessly in the art of the swift, beheading strike, with a particular emphasis on the swift elimination of enemy witches.

stratagems.name: WITCH HUNTERS
stratagems.rawType: Null Maiden Vigil – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Anathema Psykana unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability, but models in your unit can only target PSYKER units with their attacks.
stratagems.legend: Null Maidens train to slay psykers with swift martial efficiency, for they know their prey have many weapons beyond just their powers and must not be allowed time or opportunity to employ them.

stratagems.name: PSY-CHAFF VOLLEY
stratagems.rawType: Null Maiden Vigil – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Prosecutors unit from your army that has just shot.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while your unit is on the battlefield, that enemy unit is prosecuted. While a unit is prosecuted, each time an Anathema Psykana model makes an attack against that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. While a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit is prosecuted, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Prosecutors can fire psy-chaff bolts whose esoteric emissions weaken those targets not slain outright.

stratagems.name: DESPERATION’S PRICE
stratagems.rawType: Null Maiden Vigil – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy PSYKER unit has either finished using a Psychic ability that targets a unit, or finished making Psychic Attacks.
stratagems.target: One Anathema Psykana unit from your army within 18 of that enemy PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect:
That enemy PSYKER unit must take a Leadership test If the test is passed, that PSYKER unit is Battle-shocked; if the test is failed that PSYKER unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked.|
AC|PSYCHIC ABOMINATIONS|000008927007|Null Maiden Vigil – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Enemies must overcome disorienting waves of revulsion in order to even focus upon Null Maidens.|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|Null Maiden Vigil|000000862|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: To overcome the Null Maidens’ aura, enemy psykers overstretch themselves with horrible consequences.

stratagems.name: ARCHEOTECH MUNITIONS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
stratagems.legend: The Shield Hosts have access to stockpiles of ancient and incredibly rare weaponry and ammunition.

stratagems.name: ARCANE GENETIC ALCHEMY
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound has been allocated to an Adeptus Custodes model from your army(excluding Anathema Psykana models).
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES model’s unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: The Adeptus Custodes are individually engineered on a molecular level using secrets of genetic alchemy that render them virtual demigods in battle.

stratagems.name: VIGILANCE ETERNAL
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Custodes Battleline unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
stratagems.legend: Simply because the Adeptus Custodes do not stand sentinel over a strategic location or asset, does not mean that it - or any who would threaten it - escapes their gaze.

stratagems.name: MULTIPOTENTIALITY
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Custodes unit from your army that Fell Back this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: So widely skilled and studied are the Custodians that, whatever situation they find themselves in, they have the martial wisdom to prevail.

stratagems.name: UNWAVERING SENTINELS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) that is within range of an objective marker you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Once the Custodians have laid claim to a location, they defend it with incredible tenacity and skill.

stratagems.name: AVENGE THE FALLEN
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) that is below its Starting Strength.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. If your unit is Below Half-strength, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those melee weapons instead.
stratagems.legend: The loss of a single Talon of the Emperor is commemorated by the tolling of the Bell of Lost Souls on Terra, and by their comrades’ bloody vengeance on the battlefield.

stratagems.name: FLAWLESS CONSTRUCTION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Custodes Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: The vehicles of the Adeptus Custodes are the finest examples of their kind. Their expertly wrought armoured forms contain ancient and esoteric technology, including auto-repair subroutines and reactive field generators.

stratagems.name: EMPEROR’S VENGEANCE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the Walker keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is assumed to have 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Even as death’s cold embrace falls upon them, Custodians vent the last of their wrath upon the foe.

stratagems.name: WRATHFUL ADVANCE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Piles In.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3 instead of up to 3.
stratagems.legend: The golden-armoured onslaught smashes through the enemy line, trapping the foe and preventing their escape.

stratagems.name: UNSTOPPABLE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Custodes Vehicle or Adeptus Custodes Mounted unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
stratagems.legend: Armoured in adamantine and possessed of furious machine spirits, the vehicles of the Adeptus Custodes are almost impossible to stop in their tracks.

stratagems.name: PUNISHMENT INESCAPABLE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: The Ten Thousand are relentless in pursuing the Emperor’s foes and thorough in their annihilation. No armour, sorcery or hiding place can shield an enemy from their wrath.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS PERSECUTION
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That Adeptus Custodes Vehicle unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the Walker keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
stratagems.legend: Custodians coax wrathful fury from their war engines’ machine spirits to hunt down and eliminate their foes at speed.

stratagems.name: TALONS INTERLOCKED
stratagems.rawType: Talons Of The Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY units from your army, and one enemy unit that is an eligible target for all of those units.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, your units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of your units makes a ranged attack, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6 of each other.|
AC|EMPYRIC SEVERANCE|000008922004|Talons Of The Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Null Maidens quash the manifestations of witches.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Talons Of The Emperor|000000861|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: With practiced ease, the Talons of the Emperor establish vicious crossfires to cut the foe apart.

stratagems.name: EMPEROR’S EXECUTIONERS
stratagems.rawType: Talons Of The Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two Adeptus Custodes units from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units targets an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an Anathema Psykana unit and both are within 6 of each other.|
AC|TALONED PINCER|000008922006|Talons Of The Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Every move the enemy makes only sees them fall.|Opponent’s turn|Movement phase|Talons Of The Emperor|000000861|WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.legend: The Talons of the Emperor tear apart their prey.

stratagems.name: SHIELD OF HONOUR
stratagems.rawType: Talons Of The Emperor – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Anathema Psykana Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one other friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within 6 of that ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, any attack that targets your ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit must instead target your other ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (unless it is not an eligible target).|
AC|HUNT AS ONE|000008922002|Talons Of The Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Custodians and Null Maidens cover one another seamlessly as they manoeuvre to corner their prey.|Your turn|Movement phase|Talons Of The Emperor|000000861|WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: It is second nature for Custodes to place themselves between their comrades and potential peril.

stratagems.name: ARTIFICER ROUNDS
stratagems.rawType: Voyagers in Darkness – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding ballistus grenade launchers) have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting units within 6.|
AC|AURIC STORM|000009265005|Voyagers in Darkness – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Even the boldest foes falter before the sudden and unstoppable onslaught of the Allarus Terminators.|Your turn|Charge phase|Voyagers in Darkness|000000909|WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after an ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.legend: These hand-crafted bolt shells are made to fragment with particular ferocity, making them ideal for boarding actions.

stratagems.name: AUTO-DIVINATORY TARGETING
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army, and one objective marker.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have a Ballistic Skill characteristic of 3+ and the [IGNORES COVER] ability, but they can only target units within range of the selected objective marker.
stratagems.legend: Encoded with the schemata of the enemy's fortified battle lines and auto-codified vectors of attack, the Cohort's war engines are perfectly aligned to deliver the Machine God's wrath.

stratagems.name: BENEVOLENCE OF THE OMNISSIAH
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, which is improved to Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: A protective blessing chanted in pentakairic Novabyte moves machine spirits to defy the most esoteric of assaults.

stratagems.name: MACHINE SUPERIORITY
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back and you can ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).
stratagems.legend: Let the unenlightened be cast down! Let all feel the fire of the Motive Force, and may the sacred engines crunch over their weak bones without impediment!

stratagems.name: MACHINE SPIRIT RESURGENT
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.legend: To invigorate the failing machine spirit of a damaged vehicle is a sacred task, greatly aided by certain data-hymns transmitted in the correct sequence.

stratagems.name: TRANSCENDENT COGITATION
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are both active for your unit.
stratagems.legend: Enhanced static chants can briefly raise a war engine's machine spirits to exultant heights of cogitation and multi-tactical capacity.

stratagems.name: CHANT OF THE REMORSELESS FIST
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CULT MECHANICUS model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: In spitting out a staccato chant to the Motive Force, the faithful warriors of the Cult Mechanicus are filled with merciless surety as well as intent.

stratagems.name: INCANTATION OF THE IRON SOUL
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after you allocate a mortal wound to a CULT MECHANICUS model from your army.
stratagems.target: That CULT MECHANICUS model’s unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, CULT MECHANICUS models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: Raising their voices in binharic praise, the Machine God's disciples bolster their spirits - as well as those that inhabit their augmentations - with iron surety.

stratagems.name: LUMINESCENT BLESSING
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, CULT MECHANICUS models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: As the cohorts of the Omnissiah recite their dazzling consecration, energy is redirected to infuse masterwork bionics and even the lambent glow of protective fields ignites in a halo of divine defence.

stratagems.name: VERSE OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CULT MECHANICUS model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Rousing code in binharic duometer incites fury for the lost fragments of technological lore. In the grip of vengeance, the devoted extend their remaining functions for one last act of retribution.

stratagems.name: TRIBUTE OF EMPHATIC VENERATION
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army and one enemy unit within 18 of it.
stratagems.effect:
That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that test is failed, until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.|
AdM|LITANY OF THE ELECTROMANCER|000008565006|Data-Psalm Conclave – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Summoning the spark of the Machine God's divinity that burns within them, the Omnissiah’s faithful manifest blazing auras of energy that lay low the unbeliever.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Data-Psalm Conclave|000000821|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: A cacophonous chorale pours from the emitters and augmented throats of the Cult Mechanicus’ faithful, venerating the Omnissiah in deafening and disconcerting frequencies of praise.

stratagems.name: OMNI-TARGETERS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability. If one or more of those weapons already have this ability, then until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with such a weapon that targets a unit within 6, add 1 to the Hit roll.|
AdM|SAVIOUR SYSTEMS|000009282005|Electromartyrs – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Many warriors of the Adeptus Mechanicus have defensive measures suited to close-quarters battle built into their flesh-and-metal frames.|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|Electromartyrs|000000912|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Predictive gunnery subroutines take over, allowing greater reactions and accuracy at close range than any flesh-and-blood soldier could manage.

stratagems.name: AUTO-ORACULAR RETRIEVAL
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Acquisition objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: With a surge of targeting data from the war engine as its hatches slam open, the warriors inside pour out with weapons already trained unerringly on the foe.

stratagems.name: CACHED ACQUISITION
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of an objective marker you controlled. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
stratagems.legend: Death is irrelevant compared to the hallowed duty of securing the Omnissiah's knowledge for future retrieval.

stratagems.name: REACTIVE SAFEGUARD
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target:
One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY
unit from your army within range of your Acquisition objective marker that was selected as a target of that charge, and one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS TRANSPORT.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT.
RESTRICTIONS: Every model in your unit must be within 3 of that TRANSPORT and there must be sufficient transport capacity to embark the entire unit.|
AdM|INFOSLAVE SKULL|000008569004|Explorator Maniple – Wargear Stratagem|1|Mono-task infoslave skulls range ahead to assess potential sites that must be investigated.|Your turn|Command phase|Explorator Maniple|000000822|WHEN: Your Command phase.
stratagems.legend: Holy data must be hoarded at all costs, and thickly armoured war engines offer swift and secure vaults.

stratagems.name: INCENSE EXHAUSTS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target:
One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit
from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS SMOKE unit within 6 of it.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, both of those units have the Stealth ability and the Benefit of Cover.|
AdM|TARGETING OVERRIDE|000009746003|Haloscreed Battle Clade – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Experienced Tech-Priests rapidly analyse the foe’s weaknesses and feed the resultant data to their soldiers, who exploit these flaws to destroy their targets.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Haloscreed Battle Clade|000000984|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: The machine spirits of sanctified war engines can be entreated to release clouds of incense laced with radioactive particles, veiling the faithful from the foe.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE IMPULSE
stratagems.rawType: Haloscreed Battle Clade – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Skorpius Dunerider model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit disembarks from that model after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.
stratagems.legend: Urgent imperatives flood into the crew thralls of Skitarius transport units, urging them to deploy their cargo of cybernetic soldiers into the heart of the fight.

stratagems.name: NEURAL OVERLOAD
stratagems.rawType: Haloscreed Battle Clade – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
If your unit is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Select one Override ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active for your unit.
Designer’s Note: This means that if the targeted unit already has the HALO OVERRIDE keyword, it can be affected by multiple Override abilities at the same time, but suffers mortal wounds to do so. Alternatively, if your unit does not have the HALO OVERRIDE keyword, it instead has the chosen Override ability until the start of your next Command phase, but does not benefit from any other Override abilities that are active.
stratagems.legend: By projecting their consciousness into the minds of tech thralls, a Tech-Priest may significantly enhance their warriors’ lethality. However, doing so risks overloading their combat units’ more limited neural networks. Such hazards are seen as an opportunity to give one’s life in the name of the Omnissiah.

stratagems.name: OMNISSIAH’S GUIDANCE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can ignore other models in their unit for the purposes of determining visibility.
stratagems.legend: By surrendering all control to the Omnissiah, the faithful are able to target their foes with near-omniscient accuracy.

stratagems.name: TETHER-TENDRILS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.target: One TEcH-PRIEST or ELEcTRO-PRIESTS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when that enemy unit Falls Back, models in it must take Desperate Escape tests as if their unit was Battle-shocked. When doing so, if that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked by other means, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.
stratagems.legend: Weaponised mechadendrites burst from the rapturous faithful, ensnaring and electrocuting foes seeking to flee.

stratagems.name: POWER OF THE MOTIVE FORCE
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ELEcTRO-PRIESTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: Seized by overwhelming holy energies, these auto-fanatics hurl themselves into the fight with tendon-straining, inhuman haste.

stratagems.name: ELECTROGHEIST VISITATIONS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ELEcTRO-PRIESTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the attacking model is within 6” of your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: The faithful summon leaping electrogheists whose arcing energies interfere with enemy targeting and swat hostile projectiles from the air.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSOR IMPERATIVE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase. If that unit is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE units) within 6 of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.
stratagems.legend: The Skitarii feel the press of an invisible hand upon their minds as the Machine God drives them forward. Servos are pushed to their structural limits as fibre bundles fill with the boundless energy of the Motive Force and propel the faithful on an unstoppable crusade.

stratagems.name: PRE-CALIBRATED PURGE SOLUTION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. If that unit is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE units) within 6 of it.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of those units makes a ranged attack, if the target of that attack is within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.|
AdM|BULWARK IMPERATIVE|000008386007|Rad-Zone Corps – Battle Tactic Stratagem|2|With a pulse of force-loaded wisdom, microactuators lock into bracing positions, reserve power cells are brought online and the Omnissiah's holy crusaders are bestowed with a sensation of sacred invulnerability.|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|Rad-Zone Corps|000000762|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Employing targeting data collated by a swarm of servo-skulls released over the enemy's battle lines, the Machine God’s faithful purge the foe stumbling amidst rad-scourged positions.

stratagems.name: BALEFUL HALO
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army (excluding Vehicle units) that was selected as the target of one or more of that enemy unit’s attacks. If that unit is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE units) within 6 of it.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is made that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.|
AdM|EXTINCTION ORDER|000008386003|Rad-Zone Corps – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|As Tech-Priests order the purge of an area of the battlefield, rad-bombardments are redoubled in the hopes of turning it into a wasteland.|Your turn|Command phase|Rad-Zone Corps|000000762|WHEN: Your Command phase.
stratagems.legend: By briefly unshielding the most corrosive or irradiated components of their being, the warriors of a Rad-Zone Corps can exhale on isotopic fog, sapping the strength of those not inured to its effects.

stratagems.name: LETHAL DOSAGE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
stratagems.legend: Tri-fold sanctified power cells, fuel canisters and solid slugs have spent a decade in the most irradiated forge temple to certify their lethality.

stratagems.name: PRECOGNITATED FIREFIELDS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If your unit has the BATTLELINE keyword, those weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.
stratagems.legend: The Skitarii have datamapped every distance, angle and optimised fire field of their ship in advance, and can access this targeting intelligence at will.

stratagems.name: INTEGRATIVE WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. In addition, after your unit has shot this phase, if it is within 1 of an open Hatchway and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can close that Hatchway.|
AdM|ACCESS OVERRIDES|000009291003|Response Clade – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The machine spirits of the vessel’s hatchways open willingly to permit these defenders to pass.|Your turn|Movement phase|Response Clade|000000913|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: Employing their servo-symbiotic link to the machine spirits of their vessel, the Skitarii perform a fighting retreat aided by the systems of the ship itself.

stratagems.name: RESPONSIVE SHIELDING
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker and was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: Key shipboard power nodes detect the proximity of Skitarii defenders and activate temporary energy shields to protect them.

stratagems.name: BINHARIC OFFENCE
stratagems.rawType: Skitarii Hunter Cohort – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Two SKITARII units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by models in both of your units by 1.
RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target].
stratagems.legend: Employing directed binharic entanglement to coordinate their motions, paired squads of Skitarii attack with eerie and lethal synchronicity.

stratagems.name: EXPEDITED PURGE PROTOCOL
stratagems.rawType: Skitarii Hunter Cohort – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: Binharic imperatives flash through neural architecture, driving augmetic muscle-bundles and auto-actuators into overdrive to propel the Skitarii more swiftly into the fray.

stratagems.name: PROGRAMMED WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.rawType: Skitarii Hunter Cohort – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two SICARIAN units from your army, or one SKITARII INFANTRY or SKITARII MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
RESTRICTIONS: Each unit targeted with this Stratagem must be more than 3 away from all enemy units.|
AdM|BIONIC ENDURANCE|000008561002|Skitarii Hunter Cohort – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Between their multi-layered bionics and their fanatical faith in the indomitability of these machine-blessings, the most augmented of Skitarii are nigh-impossible to lay low.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Skitarii Hunter Cohort|000000820|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase orthe Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Taking direct control of their cybernetic soldiers’ manoeuvres, the cohort’s commander sees their withdrawal carried out with such precision that they can be pressed back into service from the most efficacious of attack vectors.

stratagems.name: ISOLATE AND DESTROY
stratagems.rawType: Skitarii Hunter Cohort – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target:
One SICARIAN, PTERAXII, SYDONIAN,
IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII or SKITARII MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other enemy units within 6 of the unit targeted by that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.|
AE|SUDDEN STRIKE|000009895005|||||Charge phase|Army Rules|000000783|TRIGGER: When an eligible unit from your army is selected to fight.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6 instead of up to 3.|
AE|STAR ENGINES|000009895004|||||Movement phase|Army Rules|000000783|TRIGGER: When an eligible Vehicle unit from your army is selected to make an Advance move.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, Ranged weapons equipped by this unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.|
AE|SWIFT AS THE WIND|000009895002|||||Movement phase|Army Rules|000000783|TRIGGER: When an eligible unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move. You can trigger this Agile Manoeuvre more than once per phase (provided a different unit performs it each time).
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.
stratagems.legend: The swiftest hunters seek to engage foes with the equations of war in their favour, isolating their quarry and dispatching it with ruthless efficiency.

stratagems.name: VECTORED ENGINES
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an AELDARI VEHICLE unit from your army that can FLY Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That Aeldari Fly Vehicle unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: The result of exquisite and ingenious Aeldari engineering, vectored engines enable grav vehicles to evade their enemies while maintaining accurate fire.

stratagems.name: CLOUDSTRIKE
stratagems.when: Start of the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Aeldari Vehicle unit from your army that can Fly and is in Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Deep Strike ability. When your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6 horizontally away from all enemy units, but if it does, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge. In addition, if your unit is a Transport, each unit that disembarks from it this turn must be set up more than 6 horizontally from all enemy units and until the end of the turn, is not eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.legend: The Asuryani often deploy their anti-grav vehicles in the lower atmosphere rather than on the ground. At a signal, they strike before the enemy can react.

stratagems.name: SOULSIGHT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Aeldari Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to shoot, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll made for a model in your unit. If you are using fast dice rolling, you can select one of those rolls to re-roll before moving onto the next step of the attack sequence.
stratagems.legend: Spirit stones containing the souls of gifted seers have been embedded into this vehicle’s targeting matrices. The essences within lend guidance even in death.

stratagems.name: ANTI‑GRAV REPULSION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One Aeldari Vehicle unit from your army that can Fly and was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Skilled Aeldari pilots angle their vehicle’s anti-grav fields to repulse the enemy.

stratagems.name: LAYERED WARDS
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to an AELDARI VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That Aeldari Vehicle unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: The wraithbone superstructure of this vehicle has been interlaced with warding runes, enabling its hull to resist incoming fire.

stratagems.name: SWIFT DEPLOYMENT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Aeldari Transport unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, units can disembark from your TRANSPORT after it has Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move that phase, and cannot declare a charge in the same turn, but can otherwise act normally.
stratagems.legend: With consummate skill, Guardian crews guide their agile armoured transports across the battlefield before swooping low to unload their cargo of warriors.

stratagems.name: WARRIOR FOCUS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill, Weapon skill, Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: So absolute is the focus of these warriors in battle that nothing can distract them or stay their blows.

stratagems.name: DOOM INESCAPABLE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Avatar of Khaine model from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, your model’s Wailing Doom ranged weapon has a Range characteristic of 18 and a Damage characteristic of 8.|
AE|PRETERNATURAL PRECISION|000009928006|Aspect Host – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Analysing their targets' weaknesses with incredible skill, the Aeldari fire for lethal effect.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Aspect Host|000001024|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Cast with the force of a thunderbolt, the Avatar's weapon strikes the foe with meteoric force.

stratagems.name: PIRATES’ DUE
stratagems.when: The Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit has the Anhrathe keyword, then until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.legend: In their pursuit of riches, Anhrathe warriors will fight with violent fury to seize their due.

stratagems.name: INTO THE BREACH
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Anhrathe unit from your army destroyed one or more enemy units.
stratagems.target: That ANHRATHE unit.
stratagems.effect:
After your unit has resolved all of its shooting attacks, it can make a Normal move of up to D6+1.|
AE|LETHAL RUSE|000010705003|Corsair Coterie – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|With a final flurry of gunshots, blade strikes and explosives, these warriors feign retreat before striking again with renewed aggression.|Your turn|Movement phase|Corsair Coterie|000001136|WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an AELDARI unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.legend: Corsair raiders are swift to exploit gaps in the enemy line and advance upon their objectives.

stratagems.name: VENGEFUL SORROW
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Aeldari Infantry unit from your army, if one or more models in that unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, and if that AELDARI unit is neither Battle-shocked nor within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Surge move. To do so, roll one D6 and add 1 to the roll: models in your unit move a number of inches up to this result, but your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Anhrathe share bonds forged in battle. The loss of an ally inspires sorrow and fury in equal measure.

stratagems.name: EMISSARIES OF YNNEAD
stratagems.rawType: Devoted of Ynnead – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a Ynnari Infantry unit from your army has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: That YNNARI INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If your unit is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
stratagems.legend: Immersed in murder and gripped by holy purpose, these warriors bring Ynnead’s fatal message and his final gift to all who face them.

stratagems.name: SOULSIGHT
stratagems.rawType: Devoted of Ynnead – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Ynnari unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
stratagems.legend: Perceiving the flickering soulstuff of their foes, the Ynnari strike with ruthless precision.

stratagems.name: MACABRE RESILIENCE
stratagems.rawType: Devoted of Ynnead – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Ynnari Infantry or Ynnari Mounted unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Such is the conviction and power of the Ynnari that sometimes even mortal wounds cannot slow them.

stratagems.name: PARTING THE VEIL
stratagems.rawType: Devoted of Ynnead – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Ynnari unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: In the moment of transcendent glory, before the Ynnari give their essence to their god, they fight harder than ever to take the foe with them to death.

stratagems.name: DEATH ANSWERS DEATH
stratagems.rawType: Devoted of Ynnead – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Ynnari unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units), if one or more models in that unit were destroyed this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: As the foe slays their warriors, a terrible vigour grips the Ynnari and compels them to repay the slaughter in kind.

stratagems.name: PALL OF DREAD
stratagems.rawType: Devoted of Ynnead – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Ynnari unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.legend: Even after they fall, the most fervent Ynnari leave a sinister sense of watchfulness in their wake like some invisible death shroud.

stratagems.name: NO PREY TOO BIG
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Anhrathe, Rangers or Shroud Runners unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than the highest Toughness characteristic of models in the target unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: By accurately targeting weak points in anatomies and superstructures, the Anhrathe can bring down even the most resilient of foes.

stratagems.name: YRIEL’S EXAMPLE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Aeldari Infantry unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
stratagems.legend: Inspired by their prince, who has felt Ynnead’s touch, the Eldritch Raiders laugh in the face of death.

stratagems.name: WITHDRAW AND REINFORCE
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Anhrathe unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If that unit is below Starting Strength, return all destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) to that unit.
stratagems.legend: Prince Yriel commands resources beyond the dreams of most Corsair Princes. Depleted bands may fall back from the battlefield to be reinforced and resupplied at a moment’s notice.

stratagems.name: RUTHLESS KILLERS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Corsair Voidscarred unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or Fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: These are Yriel’s chosen killers, and there is no escape for their prey.

stratagems.name: RAIDERS’ SPOILS
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Anhrathe unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.legend: Even as battle rages around them, the Eldritch Raiders prioritise the seizing of treasures above the destruction of their foes.

stratagems.name: IMPEDING FIRE
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Rangers, Shroud Runners or Starfang unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) visible to and within 36 of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit declares a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).|
AE|BLOODY DANCE|000009916006|Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Enemies goaded into following the steps of the saedath come unwittingly on cue to their executions.|Opponent’s turn|Charge phase|Ghosts of the Webway|000001021|WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.legend: As the foes attempt to close in, Yriel’s cunning outcasts stymie their assault with a dazzling burst of distracting fire.

stratagems.name: MOCKING FLIGHT
stratagems.rawType: Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Harlequins unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: The Harlequins tumble away in mock terror and panic before spinning back into the fight with cruel laughter and redoubled fury.

stratagems.name: HEROES’ FALL
stratagems.rawType: Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Harlequins unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Though they may be slain, this step of the saedath calls on the players to act out the demise of tragic heroes who take their enemies with them to death.

stratagems.name: TRICKSTERS’ RETORT
stratagems.rawType: Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Troupe unit from your army that is within 9 of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6.
stratagems.legend: To the Harlequins, the foe are simply unwitting dance partners, their every move matched with graceful aplomb.

stratagems.name: EXIT THE STAGE
stratagems.rawType: Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Harlequins unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: Players know when to fade back from the stage of war, ready to strike again when their moment comes.

stratagems.name: STAGED DEATH
stratagems.rawType: Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Harlequins Character model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect:
At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with half of its starting number of wounds remaining.
RESTRICTIONS: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.legend: A feigned death and sudden, shocking return are as impactful as dismaying to the foe.

stratagems.name: BLADES OF ASURYAN
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.
stratagems.legend: Asuryani martial teachings enable those wielding ranged weapons to employ them as close-quarter implements of death as well.

stratagems.name: VAUL’S VENGEANCE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army.
stratagems.target: One War Walkers unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
After that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
stratagems.legend: Swift and terrible vengeance comes for those who dare strike down the warriors of the Aeldari in the form of searing heavy weapons fire.

stratagems.name: SHIELD NODES
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is within range of one or more objective markers, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Exploiting a spar of old Aeldari technology, these warriors engage the flickering ghosts of ancient defensive force fields.

stratagems.name: WARDING SALVOES
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Woe betide the foe that seeks to claim the holdings of armed and determined Asuryani.

stratagems.name: TIME TO STRIKE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Storm Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.|
AE|COST OF VICTORY|000009912007|Guardian Battlehost – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|In so desperate and vital a fight, the Aeldari must accept casualties they would normally avoid and even send fresh warriors in to bolster the flagging ranks if it means victory.|Opponent’s turn|Fight phase|Guardian Battlehost|000001020|WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Storm Guardians train to recognise where and when their selfless aggression can best benefit their craftworld and never to miss such opportunities.

stratagems.name: SHIELD OF BLADES
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One DIRE AvENGERS or GUARDIAN DEfENDERS unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
stratagems.legend: A discipline refined for shipboard battle, this feat of marksmanship sees the Aeldari overlap annihilating hails of defensive fire.

stratagems.name: FATE INESCAPABLE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Asuryani Infantry unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is within 9 of one or more friendly Asuryani Psyker models.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.|
AE|ISHA’S FURY|000009924006|Seer Council – Epic Deed Stratagem|1|Leaping from the seer’s outstretched hand, this blast of empyric energy is a raw expression of the sorrow and bitterness suffered by the Aeldari people.|Opponent’s turn|Movement phase|Seer Council|000001023|WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.legend: The Aeldari have already seen how best to lay low this enemy and strike in the sure knowledge the foe cannot evade their terrible fate.

stratagems.name: PSYCHIC SHIELD
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Asuryani Infantry unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 9 of one or more friendly Asuryani Psyker models.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18.
stratagems.legend: A twist of the seer's psychic powers raises a whirling shield of empyric energy and psychokinetic debris to screen the Aeldari from enemy fire.

stratagems.name: UNSHROUDED TRUTH
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Asuryani Infantry unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that has not been selected to move this phase, was not set up on the battlefield this phase, and is within 9 of one or more friendly Asuryani Psyker models.
stratagems.effect:
Remove your unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9 horizontally away from all enemy models.
RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to be selected to move.
stratagems.legend: Dispelling the psychosomatic mirage that has so far beguiled and assailed the foe, the seer reveals the true location of the warriors it was masquerading as.

stratagems.name: PRESENTIMENT OF DREAD
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Asuryani Psyker model from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit within 18 of and visible to your model. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.|
AE|FOREWARNED|000009924003|Seer Council – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Having foreseen already how this fight will play out, the seer projects their insights and warnings into the minds of the Aeldari who must fight it.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Seer Council|000001023|WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: The seer plucks fate to find the foe suffering a horrible death, then projects it into their minds.

stratagems.name: WEAVING STRIDE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Harlequins Infantry unit from your army that is within 9 of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6.
stratagems.legend: Maintaining their blistering pace, these warriors respond to their foes’ steps in the saedath with their own gravity-defying motions.

stratagems.name: FANGS OF THE BROOD
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Troupe unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when using your unit’s Dance of Death ability, you can select three of the abilities for your unit to gain, instead of one.
stratagems.legend: Many are the heads of the brood, and many their fangs. As they spring and tumble over their foes, the Harlequins’ weapons echo the multiplicity of strikes unleashed by that mythic nest of snakes.

stratagems.name: VENOMOUS WRATH
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Harlequins Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
After your unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6. Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.|
AE|STRIKING STRIDE|000010650004|Serpent’s Brood – Stratagem|1|Springing between pillars and rubble, bounding forwards as though running on thin air, the Harlequins acrobatically hurl themselves into battle.|Your turn|Charge phase|Serpent’s Brood|000001124|WHEN: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.legend: Embodying the serpent that strikes with blinding swiftness, this grav-skimmer lunges suddenly into range and unleashes its full fury on the foe.

stratagems.name: SKYWARD LUNGE
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Harlequins Vehicle or Harlequins Mounted unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: Like a serpent rearing back to strike at its prey anew, the Harlequins sweep high and appear to quit the field, ready to descend in fury a moment later.

stratagems.name: CRUSHING STRIDES
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Wraithblades, Wraithlord or Wraithknight unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHLORD or WRAITHKNIGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each WRAITHBLADES model in your unit, or roll four D6 if your unit has the WRAITHLORD keyword, or roll six D6 if your unit has the WRAITHKNIGHT keyword: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.legend: Elegant they may be, but the weight and implacable strength of wraith constructs on the charge can smash enemies to the ground bloody and broken.

stratagems.name: WRAITHBONE ARMOUR
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Wraith Construct unit from your army (excluding TiTANic units] that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: The apparent fragility of wraith constructs’ lithe bodies be/ies their incredible resilience.

stratagems.name: BLADES FROM BEYOND
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Wraithblades, Wraithlord or Wraithknight unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
stratagems.legend: Sometimes, the twinned perceptions of ghost warriors allow them to perceive - and strike at - the souls of their foes.

stratagems.name: SEER’S EYE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Aeldari Psyker model from your army and one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12 of it that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit visible to your PSYKER model. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Armour Penetration and/or Damage characteristics of that attack.|
AE|SPIRIT TOKEN|000009908006|Spirit Conclave – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|By leaving psycho-resonant wraithbone markers upon the battlefield, these warriors wreathe vital strategic locations in an aura of dread not easily overcome.|Your turn|Movement phase|Spirit Conclave|000001019|WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: Seeing their prey as much through the eyes of their guiding seer as with any sense of their own, the wraith constructs strike swift and true.

stratagems.name: VOID GHOSTS
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Exploiting the fluctuating gravity of voidship fighting and flowing with the nigh-imperceptible movements of the vessel around them, the Aeldari acrobatically evade the blasts and blades of their foes.

stratagems.name: DARTING STRIKES
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Shuriken weaponry fill corridors and chambers with inescapable hails of monomolecular discs and reduce enemy boarding parties to bloodied ruin.

stratagems.name: SERPENT STRIKE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an AELDARI unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That AELDARI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to D3+3 instead of up to 3 and, if it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units that are visible to it (and in Unit Coherency), it can still make that Consolidation move, and when doing so can move in any direction.
stratagems.legend: A discipline refined for shipboard battle, this feat of marksmanship sees the Aeldari overlap annihilating hails of defensive fire.

stratagems.name: ACROBATIC LEAPS
