stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Desperate Escape tests taken for models in your unit are automatically passed, and each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, models in your unit can move through other models as if they were not there.
stratagems.legend: Reacting with a speed most mortal beings could not dream of, the Aeldari engulf emerging foes in a sudden hail of gunfire.

stratagems.name: LIGHTNING-FAST REACTIONS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Asuryani unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Processing events at incredible speed, these warriors easily evade attacks that would have slain any less celeritous combatants.

stratagems.name: BLITZING FIREPOWER
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Asuryani unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 12. If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.|
AE|SKYBORNE SANCTUARY|000009900003|Warhost – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The Aeldari excel in striking swiftly, then leaping back into the safety of their skimming transports.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Warhost|000001017|WHEN: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: When unleashed in a close-ranged storm, Aeldari weapons fire can completely eradicate all life within the target zone.

stratagems.name: FEIGNED RETREAT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Asuryani unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ASURYANI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: What appears to be a full retreat one moment is revealed as the deceptive prelude to a devastating attack the next.

stratagems.name: FIRE AND FADE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Asuryani Infantry unit from your army (excluding Aircraft, Asurmen and Wraith Construct units) has shot.
stratagems.target: That ASURYANI unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1.
RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a Transport.|
AE|WEBWAY TUNNEL|000009900007|Warhost – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|By slipping away into the ethereal confines of the Webway, Aeldari warriors can circumnavigate the foe and strike from new and unexpected quarters.|Opponent’s turn|Fight phase|Warhost|000001017|WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: The Aeldari are masters of hit-and-run tactics, engaging a target with a flurry of shots before swiftly ducking back out of harm's way.

stratagems.name: SPIRALLING EVASION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Asuryani Mounted or VYPER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: None but the Aeldari could risk such breakneck and seemingly suicidal evasive manoeuvres to jink around incoming enemy fire.

stratagems.name: FOCUSED FIREPOWER
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Asuryani Mounted or VYPER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Able to analyse and assess target data at incredible speeds, these Aeldari isolate the foe's weak spot and pour all their fire into it as they hurtle past.

stratagems.name: DEATH FROM ON HIGH
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Asuryani Mounted or VYPER unit from your army that was set upon the battlefield from Reserves this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Streaking suddenly down from on high, the Aeldari strike like the fall of an executioner's blade.

stratagems.name: OVERFLIGHT
stratagems.when: End of your Shooting phase or the end of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Asuryani Mounted unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 7.|
AE|WIND OF BLADES|000009904004|Windrider Host – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Warriors such as these cannot be pinned down or held back. They hit and run at will, hammering the foe with constant fire and slashing blows.|Your turn|Movement phase|Windrider Host|000001018|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: These airborne warriors arc up and away from the ruin of their foes, already seeking fresh prey.

stratagems.name: UNFLINCHING FIRE
stratagems.rawType: Wraiths of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
stratagems.legend: None can match the calm, patient precision of those who have already known death and do not fear it.

stratagems.name: OPENING SALVO
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Emerging from their armoured transports, heavily armed soldiers open fire before enemies can dive for cover or angle their stoutest armour towards the fusillade.

stratagems.name: ORDER THE ADVANCE
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Select one or more friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6 of your unit; until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for those units.|
AM|SUPPORTING ORDNANCE|000010792005|Armoured Infantry – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|This vehicle’s heavy weapons support lightly equipped infantry, suppressing enemy armour and bringing down lumbering monsters.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Armoured Infantry|000001150|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: At a barked order, armour and infantry surge forward as one, utilising speed and aggression to close with objectives and the enemy.

stratagems.name: BELLICOSA DROP
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that is in Reserves and has the Deep Strike ability.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, when your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6 horizontally away from all enemy units.
RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.|
AM|FIRING HOT|000009802003|Bridgehead Strike – Battle Tactic Stratagem|2|At the risk of permanently burning out power packs, hot-shot weaponry can be temporarily overcharged to provide additional punch at the crucial moment.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Bridgehead Strike|000000996|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Bellicosa drop protocols require intensive additional training but enable elite Imperial soldiery to land virtually on top of the enemy’s positions.

stratagems.name: ON MY POSITION
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Regiment Infantry unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds. Then, your unit suffers 3D3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: Circling Aeronautica Imperialis strike fighters wait above to launch strafing runs should the attack falter. In extremis, these assets can be called down upon Imperial positions in danger of being overrun, affording soldiers the desperate dignity of taking their enemies with them into death.

stratagems.name: AERIAL EXTRACTION
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, if all of its models have the Deep Strike ability, or one Valkyrie unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: Such swift manoeuvres are vital to retaining command of the developing tactical situation, whether gunships are peeling off to strike at the enemy from a fresh angle or infantry being extracted by dropcraft for rapid redeployment.

stratagems.name: FIRE AND RELOCATE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: Once deployed, it is vital that the soldiers stay on the move and keep firing, avoiding becoming bogged down and maintaining the pressure on their reeling foes.

stratagems.name: SERVO‑DESIGNATORS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That Astra Militarum Infantry unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks that is visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.
stratagems.legend: Released in a swarm from a modified Valkyrie gunship, high-altitude servo-skulls analyse targeting data from the ongoing fight and then provide updated firing solutions to the troops on the ground.

stratagems.name: COORDINATED ACTION
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One Regiment unit from your army and one Squadron unit from your army within 6 of and visible to that REGIMENT unit.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.|
AM|FIELDS OF FIRE|000008381005|Combined Arms – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Armour and infantry work in concert, forming overlapping fields of fire against which neither cover nor heavy armour can protect.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Combined Arms|000000760|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: The potency of armour and infantry is greatly enhanced when both work in close concert.

stratagems.name: BRUTAL CHOKE POINT
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
stratagems.legend: The Tactica Imperialis teaches well how to exploit choke points to slaughter the foe. Its lessons transfer well to voidship corridors and chambers.

stratagems.name: SNAP TO IT
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s OFFICER model can issue 1 Order as if it were your Command phase.
stratagems.legend: Reading the flow of battle and reacting in accordance, this officer expects their barked orders to be followed post-haste.

stratagems.name: VETERAN SHARPSHOOTERS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
stratagems.legend: Marksmanship is a skill that only increases with experience.

stratagems.name: NO RETREAT!
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by the Duty and Honour! Order.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.
stratagems.legend: Battle-hardened and zealous, the company’s grizzled elites will gladly give their lives to honour the Emperor.

stratagems.name: PURGING FIRE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by an Order that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
stratagems.legend: Clear the area and defend your objectives. Take no prisoners.

stratagems.name: MORDIAN MINUTE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army affected by the First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! Order.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Named for the soldiers of Mordian, this rapid-fire drill requires exceptional accuracy and coordination, but renders even the humble lasgun highly lethal.

stratagems.name: ADDITIONAL ARMOUR
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Veteran soldiers know the value of additional protection, whether welded to vehicles or worn under flak armour.

stratagems.name: FURIOUS CANNONADE
stratagems.rawType: Hammer of the Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Squadron unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 12, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.|
AM|SCOUTING OUTRIDERS|000009870007|Hammer of the Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Sentinels and cavalry units use their speed and mobility to outflank the foe, ready to strike at the most opportune moment.|Opponent’s turn|Any phase|Recon Element|000001013|WHEN: End of your opponent’s turn.
stratagems.legend: At close range, armoured vehicles open up with their full complement of weapons, dispensing the Emperor’s righteous wrath.

stratagems.name: BLAZING ADVANCE
stratagems.rawType: Hammer of the Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That SQUADRON unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: By petitioning the machine spirits of their vehicles, tank crews push their armoured steeds beyond conventional limits.

stratagems.name: FINAL HOUR
stratagems.rawType: Hammer of the Emperor – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Squadron unit from your army that is Below Half-strength (excluding Officer units).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle round, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons) have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and to the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Even with flames licking through the interior of their vehicle, this crew refuse to abandon their positions, regardless of the risk to their lives.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.rawType: Hammer of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That SQUADRON unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Even in retreat, the armoured fist of the Astra Militarum keep their cannons firing.

stratagems.name: CRASH THROUGH
stratagems.rawType: Hammer of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.
stratagems.legend: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the grinding advance of an Astra Militarum armoured corps.

stratagems.name: ABLATIVE PLATING
stratagems.rawType: Hammer of the Emperor – Wargear Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: Crews routinely reinforce their vehicle's armour, adding ablative plating, track links, sandbags and other means to protect the hull.

stratagems.name: CLEAR AND SECURE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Mechanised charges rely upon shock, awe and speed to secure ground. Any enemies that block the path must be obliterated swiftly.

stratagems.name: SWIFT INTERCEPTION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Transport unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and TiTANic units) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and is within 9 of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
stratagems.effect: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6.
stratagems.legend: Fast-moving armoured transports allow a commander to react quickly to enemy movements and intercept outflanking opponents.

stratagems.name: HASTY EXTRACTION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, after an enemy unit has selected targets for its charge but before it makes a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect:
Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3 of an AsTRA Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.|
AM|RAPID DISPERSAL|000009862003|Mechanised Assault – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Troops trained in mechanised combat disembark swiftly from their transport’s hatches, avoiding incoming fire and advancing on their objectives.|Your turn|Movement phase|Mechanised Assault|000001011|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: Should the tide turn against them, mechanised forces swiftly re-embark their transports in order to reposition.

stratagems.name: MOVE OUT
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s turn.
stratagems.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3 of an Astra Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.|
AM|VOX-RELAY|000009862002|Mechanised Assault – Wargear Stratagem|1|This armoured transport has been modified to house a tactical command suite and vox-relay, enabling embarked officers to give orders from relative safety.|Your turn|Command phase|Mechanised Assault|000001011|WHEN: Your Command phase.
stratagems.legend: High command’s priorities have shifted. Swift embarkation and redeployment is required.

stratagems.name: TANGLEFOOT GRENADES
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum Grenades unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as the target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
stratagems.legend: Employed by skirmishers and recon troops, tanglefoot grenades ensnare advancing infantry, slowing their advance.

stratagems.name: TRENCH FIGHTERS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if it is a Regiment model. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Inured to the savage horrors of trench warfare, these warriors will fight until their last breath.

stratagems.name: CALLOUS SACRIFICE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Platoon unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, one model from your unit is destroyed after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
stratagems.legend: All victory requires sacrifice. The destruction of the enemy must always take priority over the preservation of lives.

stratagems.name: FURIOUS FUSILLADE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Platoon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit while targeting an enemy unit within half range.
stratagems.legend: Whilst accuracy has its benefits, sheer weight of fire is no less effective at bringing down the foe.

stratagems.name: OVER THE TOP
stratagems.when: Start of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Infantry Officer model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when your model issues the Move! Move! Move! Order, it can issue that Order to any number of eligible friendly Infantry Regiment units, regardless of range to your model.
stratagems.legend: The whistle blows to signal the attack. Waves of infantry emerge from cover to advance upon the foe.

stratagems.name: FLARE BURST
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum Character unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit within 12, you can re-roll the Hit roll.|
AM|MINEFIELD|000009858007|Siege Regiment – Wargear Stratagem|1|Sappers have laid down a network of mines across the battlefield. Should the enemy attempt an ill-advised assault, they will surely suffer for it.|Opponent’s turn|Charge phase|Siege Regiment|000001010|WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.legend: As the infantry assault proceeds, flares are fired into the skies, illuminating opponents below.

stratagems.name: STEEL HEART
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a GREy KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: The battle-brothers of the Grey Knights never flee from their daemonic foes, instead merely withdrawing momentarily before striking anew.

stratagems.name: RITES OF EXORCISM
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO MAllEUS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy DAEMON unit within 12 and visible to your unit. That unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that test is failed, then until the end of the phase, each time a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMpERIUM unit makes an attack that targets that DAEMON unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.|
AoI|RITUAL OF WARDING|000009135002|Daemon Hunters – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Whether sanctifying the battlefield against heresy or binding sinister guardian entities to keep watch, this ritual extends its practitioner’s strategic influence.|Either player’s turn|Command phase|Ordo Malleus Daemon Hunters|000000894|WHEN: Start of any Command phase.
stratagems.legend: With the correct words of abjuration and banishment, daemons can be driven out of realspace and back into the warp.

stratagems.name: HEXAGRAMMIC WARDS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ORDO MAllEUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
stratagems.legend: Ancient warding sigils inscribed in shimmering silver, these strange runic designs ward away the hostile energies of the warp.

stratagems.name: PSYBOLT AMMUNITION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREy KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [PSYCHIC] abilities.
stratagems.legend: Specially consecrated and silver-tipped, these bolt shells channel the firer’s innate psychic fury and detonate spectacularly on impact.

stratagems.name: TRUESILVER ARMOUR
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase orthe Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREy KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Grey Knights battle plate incorporates litanies of purity, strands of sanctified silver and other sacred wards, whose defences can be further empowered by ritual mantras.

stratagems.name: CLOSE-QUARTERS BARRAGE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One VOIDFARERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.|
AoI|MASTERS OF THE VOID|000009139003|Imperialis Fleet – Epic Deed Stratagem|1|With command of the orbital engagement zone comes the ability to strike at the enemy from unexpected angles.|Your turn|Movement phase|Imperialis Fleet|000000895|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: Soldiers trained in shipboard warfare and chamber-by-chamber clearance know how best to focus theirfirepower during close-range firefights.

stratagems.name: DUTY AND DEATH
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
stratagems.legend: So important are the targets of Adeptus Arbites voidship raids that the Arbitrators will not let themselves fall until they know their duty is done.

stratagems.name: CRACKDOWN
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Veterans of close-quarters brutality, these warriors know how to swiftly incapacitate enemies in the close-quarters confines of voidships and the like.

stratagems.name: INESCAPABLE JUDGEMENT
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when that enemy unit Falls Back, models in it must take Desperate Escape tests as if their unit was Battle-shocked. When doing so, if that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked by other means, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.
stratagems.legend: Attempting to flee from the implacable Arbitrators and their ferocious cybercanids only exposes the foe to a swift and brutal end.

stratagems.name: ARBITRARY EXECUTION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ARBITES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Arbites shotpistols equipped by models in your unit have an Attacks characteristic of 2 and the [LETHAL HITS] ability, and models in your unit can target enemy units that are not within Engagement Range of them (provided they are otherwise eligible targets).
stratagems.legend: Well practised in bringing down their targets with effective head shots, the Arbitrators wield their sidearms to deadly effect.

stratagems.name: DISPENSE JUSTICE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEpTUS ARbITES, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
stratagems.legend: Agents of the Ordo Hereticus are unmerciful in meting out what they see as the Emperor's justice.

stratagems.name: EXECUTION ORDER
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEpTUS ARbITES, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRy unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy CHARACTER unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit targets that CHARACTER unit, its weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.legend: There can be no mercy for heretic leaders.

stratagems.name: INVIOLATE JURISDICTION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEpTUS ARbITES, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRy unit from your army within range of an objective marker and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
stratagems.legend: These warriors defend the sanctity of the Emperor's realm with unwavering determination, no matter the odds stacked against them.

stratagems.name: EXACT PUNISHMENT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an AGENTS OF THE IMpERIUM unit from your army is destroyed as the result of an enemy unit's attacks.
stratagems.target: One ADEpTUS ARbITES, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that was within 6 of the destroyed unit (you cannot target the destroyed unit with the Stratagem).
stratagems.effect:
After the attacking unit has shot, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).|
AoI|LINE OF FIRE|000009131006|Purgation Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|These ruthless warriors will risk firing into their own ranks if it ensures the deaths of heretics.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Ordo Hereticus Purgation Force|000000893|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Vengeance is swift and unforgiving for those who attack the servants of the Emperor.

stratagems.name: STUN GRENADES
stratagems.when: Start of any phase (excluding the Command phase).
stratagems.target: One ADEpTUS ARbITES, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS GRENADES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS or VEHICLES) within 8 of and visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.|
AoI|PRIME TARGET|000009758002|Veiled Blade Elimination Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|A primary target has been revealed. All efforts must be made to ensure the kill.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Veiled Blade Elimination Force|000000987|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Emitting blasts of light, sound and blinding smoke, these devices disorient the foe.

stratagems.name: AMMO RATIONS
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One or more VOIDfARERS units from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Many Navis officers carry limited quantities of specialist ammunition such as hellfire or manstopper rounds, to be issued to their squads in the face of especially formidable opposition.

stratagems.name: BREACH AND CLEAR
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an IMPERIAL NAvY BREAcHERS unit from yourarmy opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if that model is on the opposite side of the Hatchway from the side it started the turn on, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Naval armsmen of every stripe train extensively in the tactics of chamber-by-chamber combat, clearing one space of foes before pressing on to the next.

stratagems.name: SHIP’S WATCH
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two VOIDSMEN-AT-ARMS units from your army that have not fired Overwatch this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6. When doing so, models in your units can ignore other models in their unit for the purposes of visibility, and each time a model in one of your units makes an attack, if that unit contains a Canid model, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.legend: The Navis Imperialis prides itself on the ironclad discipline and keen watchfulness of its warriors.

stratagems.name: BOARDING DRILL
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One VOIDfARERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot or perform a Tactical Manoeuvre in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Exhaustively trained in the strategy and tactics of shipboard warfare, these warriors never miss an opportunity to seize the advantage over their foes.

stratagems.name: SHIELD OF FAITH
stratagems.rawType: Army of Faith – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit, or one friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit within 3 of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds. If you targeted an ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit from your army with this Stratagem, then until the end of the phase, while a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is unit is within 3 of your unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: There is no armour as resilient as conviction itself.

stratagems.name: FAITH AND FURY
stratagems.rawType: Army of Faith – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of your unit's attacks this phase, you gain 1 Miracle dice.
stratagems.legend: The righteous zeal of the Sisters of Battle burns bright as they charge towards their foes.

stratagems.name: DIVINE GUIDANCE
stratagems.rawType: Army of Faith – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of any of those attacks, you gain 1 Miracle dice.
stratagems.legend: With miraculous precision, the blows of the Sisters of Battle strike the weak points of enemy armour.

stratagems.name: LIGHT OF THE EMPEROR
stratagems.rawType: Army of Faith – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn, your unit is blessed. While a unit is blessed, it can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: the profile characteristics of its models; the Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models; any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws). If your unit has the JUMP PACK keyword, until the end of the turn, while a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 3 of your unit, that friendly unit is also blessed.|
AS|ANGELIC DESCENT|000009038007|Army of Faith – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|On wings of fire do the angelic warriors of the Orders Militant descent to battle.|Opponent’s turn|Fight phase|Army of Faith|000000880|WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: The Emperor’s radiance shines upon his warriors, magnifying their purity in their darkest hour.

stratagems.name: CLEANSING FLAMES
stratagems.rawType: Bringers of Flame – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability
stratagems.legend: Burn the mutant. Burn the heretic. Burn the witch.

stratagems.name: RIGHTEOUS BLOWS
stratagems.rawType: Bringers of Flame – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of attacks made by those weapons this phase, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.legend: As the faithful strike their foes in righteous anger, they feel the Emperor's hand adding strength to their blows.

stratagems.name: SHIELD OF AVERSION
stratagems.rawType: Bringers of Flame – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The Sisters of Battle gird themselves with the strength of their faith. It is a shield of repulsion that rejects the heretical cunning of their enemies.

stratagems.name: CARRY FORTH THE FAITHFUL
stratagems.rawType: Bringers of Flame – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just before an ADEPTA SORORITAS TRANSPORT model from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS TRANSPORT model.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your TRANSPORT, and units can disembark from your TRANSPORT even though it Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move, and cannot declare a charge this turn
stratagems.legend: Congregated within a transport, the Battle Sisters recite bellowing prayers so that the whole vehicle echoes to furious piety.

stratagems.name: TO THE HEART OF HERESY
stratagems.rawType: Champions of Faith – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. If your unit is Righteous, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 as well.
stratagems.legend: Seizing their moment to drive like a burning blade through the enemy lines and complete their holy mission, these faithful strike with unstoppable might.

stratagems.name: PATH OF THE RIGHTEOUS
stratagems.rawType: Champions of Faith – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6 instead of up to 3. When doing so, if your unit is Righteous, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: When exemplars of the Imperial Creed stride to do the God-Emperor’s will, little can slow their sacred procession.

stratagems.name: BASTION OF FAITH
stratagems.rawType: Champions of Faith – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Celestian Sacresants unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. In addition, if your unit is Righteous, you can select one other CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit from your army that is not Battle-shocked and is within 6 of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets that CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll as well.|
AS|SHIELD OF DENIAL|000009832002|Champions of Faith – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|With so singular and fanatical a purpose, the Adepta Sororitas can will their injuries away, at least until the fight is done.|Either player’s turn|Any phase|Champions of Faith|000001003|WHEN: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army.
stratagems.legend: Unified in their inviolate dedication to fulfil their oaths to Him on the Throne, the Order’s elite form a rampart of ceramite and unyielding faith to throw back the desperate blows of the foe.

stratagems.name: PASSION OF THE PENITENT
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One PENITENT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a PENITENT model in your unit makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.legend: The penitent are full of a burning passion to inflict suffering upon the faithless.

stratagems.name: FINAL REDEMPTION
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One PENITENT unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of an objective marker you controlled. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
stratagems.legend: Those seeking absolution in the eyes of the Emperor will gladly give their last drop of blood to defy his enemies.

stratagems.name: DEVOUT FANATICISM
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One PENITENT unit from your army that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but it must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, models in your unit can be moved within Engagement Range of enemy units.
stratagems.legend: The God-Emperor's faithful followers, heedless of incoming fire, leap forth to deliver his furious judgement in the press of melee

stratagems.name: BOUNDLESS ZEAL
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit has the PENITENT keyword, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.
stratagems.legend: The urge to absolve their sins and destroy the enemy drives the penitents to push their tortured bodies beyond their mortal limits.

stratagems.name: CONTEMPT FOR DEATH
stratagems.rawType: Penitents and Pilgrims – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: The desire for absolution lends the penitent hosts unnatural resilience in the face of superior foes.

stratagems.name: SLICK WITH GORE
stratagems.rawType: Penitents and Pilgrims – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the battle, your unit is slick with gore. In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 6 of and visible to a unit from your army that is slick with gore, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that enemy unit is also Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. This cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem while a unit from your army that is slick with gore is on the battlefield.|
AS|SAVAGE FRENZY|000009317005|Penitents and Pilgrims – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|A tide of screaming zealots swarms over the enemy, flailing wildly with deadly weapons and slaughtering any who attempt to flee.|Opponent’s turn|Movement phase|Penitents and Pilgrims|000000917|WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.legend: With chainsword and fist these warriors cut through the enemy until their bodies are coated in viscera and the foe quail before their bloody advance.

stratagems.name: WRATH UNDENIABLE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Legiones Daemonica Khorne unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Even the banishing blow is often not enough to prevent the daemons of Khorne from lashing out to take bloody vengeance as they discorporate.

stratagems.name: GORE‑HUNGRY ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Legiones Daemonica Khorne unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
stratagems.legend: The manifest will to run down and slaughter their prey allows the daemons of Khorne to surge through physical barriers as though they did not exist, falling upon their victims like bloody phantasms.

stratagems.name: SKULLS BEGET BLOOD
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Legiones Daemonica Khorne Infantry or Legiones Daemonica Khorne Mounted unit from your army (excluding units that Fell Back this turn) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of one or more units from your army and is within 8 of and visible to your unit. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.|
CD|BLOOD BEGETS SKULLS|000009816005|Blood Legion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The iron reek of mortal blood pulsing through living veins fires the unnatural senses of Khorne’s daemons, drawing them on all the swifter to tear, slay, and hack skulls from necks for mighty Khorne.|Your turn|Charge phase|Blood Legion|000000999|WHEN: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.legend: Torn from the wet and ragged necks of worthy mortal champions, these skulls blaze with balefire as the daemons of Khorne heft and hurl them. They explode amongst the foe to shed more blood for the Blood God.

stratagems.name: DRAUGHT OF TERROR
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1. In addition, until the end of the phase, each time such a weapon targets a unit that is Battle-shocked, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: The swelling fear of their mortal prey serves as an intoxicating elixir to the daemonic followers, each draught invigorating their forms with deadly power.

stratagems.name: DAEMONIC INVULNERABILITY
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of that enemy unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an invulnerable saving throw is made for a model in your unit, re-roll a saving throw of 1.
stratagems.legend: Daemons are madness given form. Their very bodies are fashioned from the stuff of the warp, and are difficult to destroy through conventional means.

stratagems.name: THE REALM OF CHAOS
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s turn.
stratagems.target: Up to two LEGIONES DAEMONICA units from your army that are within your army’s Shadow of Chaos, or one other LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Remove the targeted units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. They will arrive back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units with this Stratagem.
stratagems.legend: When the energies of the warp bleed into realspace, the Legiones Daemonica can rip open portals in seeming thin-air, returning to their hellscapes only to rematerialise amidst their foes a heartbeat later.

stratagems.name: WARP SURGE
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army that is within your army’s Shadow of Chaos.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: The winds of the warp blow strong, invigorating daemonkind and lending them supernatural speed and ferocity.

stratagems.name: CORRUPT REALSPACE
stratagems.when: Start of any Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect:
That objective marker is said to be Corrupted and remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn. In addition, while an objective marker is Corrupted and under your control, the area of the battlefield within 6 of that objective marker is considered to be within your army’s Shadow of Chaos. |
CD|DENIZENS OF THE WARP|000008437005|Demonic Incursion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Ever lurking in the warp, daemons will wait until the barriers between realms thin before tearing their way into realspace.|Either player’s turn|Any phase|Daemonic Incursion|000000779|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: Daemons instinctively feel the need to despoil and corrupt every corner of realspace, the better to sustain their otherworldly forms.

stratagems.name: SEDUCTIVE WHISPERS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SLAANESH LEGIONES DAEMONIcA unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: In the press of combat, these daemons utter beguiling susurrations that cloud the minds of their mortal foes.

stratagems.name: SOPORIFIC SCENT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One SLAANESH LEGIONES DAEMONIcA unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Desperate Escape tests taken for models in your unit are automatically passed and your unit does not suffer mortal wounds from the Lithe Killers Detachment rule.
stratagems.legend: A cloud of sickly-sweet perfume surrounds these daemons, dulling the senses of the foe and preventing them from striking back.

stratagems.name: INSUBSTANTIAL ENTITIES
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One SLAANESH LEGIONES DAEMONIcA unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.|
CD|DANCE OF DEATH|000009573004|Dread Carnival – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Coiling like wind-rippled streamers between the blades of their foes, these daemons flicker momentarily out of the fray before slashing back in.|Your turn|Movement phase|Dread Carnival|000000956|WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a SLAANESH LEGIONES DAEMONIcA unit from your army
Falls Back.
stratagems.legend: Physical barriers are no obstacle to creatures that can will their desires into being with but a twist of their supernatural powers.

stratagems.name: ABJECT HORROR
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONIcA unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
stratagems.legend: Fighting for one's life against ferocious daemons of murder, tom straight from the pages of nightmare scripture, is a terrifying experience.

stratagems.name: INSUBSTANTIAL ENTITIES
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONIcA unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.|
CD|SWIFT AS MURDER|000009556005|Infernal Onslaught – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The very eagerness of these daemons to shed blood and reap skulls propels them all the quicker towards their foes.|Your turn|Movement phase|Infernal Onslaught|000000954|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: Physical barriers are no obstacle to creatures that can will their desires into being with but a twist of their supernatural powers.

stratagems.name: OVERWHELMING EXCESS
stratagems.rawType: Legion of Excess – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Sensation gushes relentlessly into the overstimulated minds of the enemy until their souls strain fit to burst. Barely able to think or function, they recoil in their desperate need to stem the unstoppable tide.

stratagems.name: ARCHAGONISTS
stratagems.rawType: Legion of Excess – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh Monster unit or up to two Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh units (excluding Monsters) from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of those units makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: These daemons perceive with absolute clarity whereabouts on their victims’ bodies they must strike to inflict the greatest possible excess of suffering.

stratagems.name: CAVALCADE OF BLADES
stratagems.rawType: Legion of Excess – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, or roll six D6 instead if your unit is a MONSTER unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.legend: The cavorting approach of Slaaneshi daemons is hypnotic and enthralling. It is a whirling carousel of eye-searing colours and flashing blades that tempt mortals to reach out with trembling eagerness until they can just reach.

stratagems.name: THIEVES OF PAIN
stratagems.rawType: Legion of Excess – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an attack or mortal wound is allocated to a model in a Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh unit from your army (excluding Monsters and Vehicles).
stratagems.target: That LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit.
stratagems.effect:
Select one other friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit that is within 9 of and visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, while the selected unit is on the battlefield, each time a model in your unit would lose a wound, inflict 1 mortal wound on the selected unit instead.|
CD|SENSORY EXCRUCIATION|000009807004|Legion of Excess – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|This entity causes the battlefield to flicker wildly between the debauched Slaaneshi Warp interstice and the most brutally mundane reality, faster than even supernatural senses can perceive. The result is a psychically devastating barrage of excess and deprivation.|Your turn|Command phase|Legion of Excess|000000997|WHEN: Your Command phase.
stratagems.legend: To exist, however fleetingly, in realspace is an opportunity to indulge in every physical sensation. So enraptured do the daemons of Slaanesh become that they even steal one another’s agonies to enjoy.

stratagems.name: FICKLE BLESSINGS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HORRORS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities.
stratagems.legend: Even the daemons of Tzeentch are not immune to the fundamentally unstable nature of their own magicks, which may twist and rupture their bodies as often as they lend terrible power.

stratagems.name: INSUBSTANTIAL ENTITIES
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One TzEENTcH LEGIONES DAEMONIcA unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.|
CD|FEVER VISIONS|000009820003|Plague Legion – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|A plague of waking nightmares races through the enemy ranks, leaving foes reeling in the grip of nauseating visions that curdle into soul-destroying reality.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Plague Legion|000001000|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Physical barriers are no obstacle to creatures that can will their desires into being with but a twist of their supernatural powers.

stratagems.name: SEEPING VIRULENCE
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Legiones Daemonica Nurgle unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.legend: Repugnant filth wells from the weapons, gaping maws and open wounds of these daemons, slopping across the foe and causing swift and virulent rot wherever it finds the slightest way in.

stratagems.name: FOETID RESURGENCE
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Legiones Daemonica Nurgle unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: Return up to 1 destroyed model to your unit, or up to D3 destroyed models instead if your unit is a Battleline unit, with their full wounds remaining. If it is a Monster unit, one model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds instead.
stratagems.legend: As the power of the Plague God saturates the battlefield, fresh daemonic life blooms from the septic corpse mulch that bubbles underfoot.

stratagems.name: ROT AND RENEWAL
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Legiones Daemonica Nurgle unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
stratagems.legend: Rather than lumber across the battlefield, these daemons rot away to nothing before hatching anew from canker blooms wherever they wish to be.

stratagems.name: PLAGUE OF WOES
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Command phase, before selecting any targets for the Melancholic Miasma Detachment rule.
stratagems.target: One Legiones Daemonica Nurgle unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, after an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test as a result of the Melancholic Miasma Detachment rule, select one other enemy unit within 9 of your unit; that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.|
CD|FOUL RESILIENCE|000009565002|Rotten and Rusted – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|So full of repulsive vitality are these daemons that their corporeal forms must be absolutely destroyed before they halt their advance.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Rotten and Rusted|000000955|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Even as one band of foes gives in to despair, their sorrows spread like a virus to the minds and souls of others, the enemy’s woes multiplying by the moment.

stratagems.name: INSUBSTANTIAL ENTITIES
stratagems.rawType: Rotten and Rusted – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One NURGLE LEGIONES DAEMONIcA unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.|
CD|PYROGENESIS|000009811003|Scintillating Legion – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Warpflame is as changeable as the monsters who wield it, capable of easily burning through ceramite plates or reinforced hulls when desired.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Scintillating Legion|000000998|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Physical barriers are no obstacle to creatures that can will their desires into being with but a twist of their supernatural powers.

stratagems.name: BALEFUL BLESSING
stratagems.rawType: Cabal of Chaos – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a Heretic Astartes unit from your army has a mortal wound allocated to it.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: The powers of the cabal render these warriors semicorporeal for a short time, causing the most powerful attacks of their foes to simply pass through them as though they were smoke.

stratagems.name: UNHOLY HASTE
stratagems.rawType: Cabal of Chaos – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to charge that phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: Hastened through the weave of time by sorcerous magicks, these warriors spring suddenly upon their foes.

stratagems.name: NO REST IN DEATH
stratagems.rawType: Cabal of Chaos – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes unit from your army within 9 of a Heretic Astartes Psyker, Heretic Astartes Daemon Prince or Heretic Astartes Daemon Prince with Wings unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
One model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds. If your unit has the Battleline keyword, you can return up to D3 destroyed models (excluding Character models) to your unit with their full wounds remaining, instead.|
CSM|MUTATION’S CURSE|000010152004|Cabal of Chaos – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Surging warp energies coil around the foe and rapidly mutate them until their physical forms are rent asunder. |Your turn|Shooting phase|Cabal of Chaos|000001058|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: With an imperious gesture, one of the army’s sorcerous masters conjures the wounded and dead back to their feet to fight on for their amusement.

stratagems.name: SOULSEEKERS
stratagems.rawType: Cabal of Chaos – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot that phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
stratagems.legend: These warriors have been gifted with hex-marked rounds that seek the living essence of their targets, leaving them nowhere to hide.

stratagems.name: IMPERIOUS ADVANCE
stratagems.rawType: Champions of Chaos – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIc ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the selected models, and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.
stratagems.legend: Attempting to bar the path of these chosen warriors only fills them with a cruel and arrogant desire to crush those who stand in their way.

stratagems.name: MALIGN WILL
stratagems.rawType: Champions of Chaos – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time your unit takes a Leadership test for the Dark Pacts ability, subtract 1 from the result and, if passed, select one objective marker within 6 of your unit. If there are no enemy units within range of that objective marker (excluding Battle-shocked units], that objective marker is Secured by your army.|
CSM|INFERNAL PATRONS|000009521004|Champions of Chaos – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Many chosen warriors of the Dark Gods have forged pacts with minor daemonic entities, gaining their insidious aid to terrify and disorient the foe in battle.|Either player’s turn|Any phase|Champions of Chaos|000000948|WHEN: Any phase, just after your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem.
stratagems.legend: These warriors' will to conquer and despoil is so great that it manifests through the dark power of the warp into a corporeal blight upon realspace.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE STRIKE
stratagems.rawType: Champions of Chaos – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that arrived using the Deep Strike ability this turn.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6.
RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.|
CSM|CRAZED FOCUS|000008982005|Chaos Cult – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Sven in the grip of frothing madness, these heretics are murderous in the extreme|Your turn|Shooting phase|Chaos Cult|000000872|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Veterans of countless teleport assaults, these warriors burst from the warp already striding, firing and bellowing praise to the Dark Gods

stratagems.name: SELFLESS DEMISE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, roll one D6 on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.
stratagems.legend: The zealous followers of the Dark Gods are devoted to the last. As death comes they strike a desperate final blow in hope of reward.

stratagems.name: RECKLESS HASTE
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: Consumed by a desire to spill blood, these fanatical heretics hurl themselves towards the foe.

stratagems.name: AUTOSTIMULANTS
stratagems.rawType: Creations of Bile – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: Arrays of subdermal vials inject autostimulants and biocatalysts into the warriors’ enhanced muscles, invigorating them for incredible feats of exertion.

stratagems.name: DIABOLIC REGENERATION
stratagems.rawType: Creations of Bile – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit (excluding Damned units) from your army.
stratagems.effect: One destroyed model (excluding Character models) is returned to your unit. If your unit is a Battleline unit, D3 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) are returned to your unit instead.
stratagems.legend: Not even death can lay the most vile of Bile’s creations low.

stratagems.name: DELAYED MUTATIONS
stratagems.rawType: Creations of Bile – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit (excluding Damned units) from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then select one augmentation (see Experimental Augmentations). Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the selected augmentation in addition to any other augmentations they have.
stratagems.legend: Fabius Bile’s experiments are notoriously unstable. In the heat of battle, new mutations may burst forth in explosions of gristle and oozing gore, many of which are as lethal to the subject as they are to the enemy.

stratagems.name: MONSTROUS VISAGES
stratagems.rawType: Creations of Bile – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Bile’s experimental ministrations have left these warriors as freakish monsters. Cursed with clusters of compound eyes, distended, fang-stuffed jaws or myriad other grotesqueries, they are hideous to behold.

stratagems.name: MASTERS ARE WATCHING
stratagems.rawType: Creations of Bile – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, subtracting 1 from the result if it is a Damned unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Feeling the expectant gaze of Bile’s greatest creations from across the battlefield, transhuman and mortal warriors strive slavishly to impress.

stratagems.name: SPECIMENS FOR THE SPIDER
stratagems.rawType: Creations of Bile – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll. After your unit has fought, if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one enemy unit within 6 of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the enemy WARLORD was destroyed as a result of those attacks, each enemy unit within 6 of your unit must take a Battle-shock test instead.
stratagems.legend: The Clonefather’s agents are always searching for new test subjects. They strive to harvest the bodies of great leaders and champions, dragging them from battle and leaving the remaining foes utterly demoralised.

stratagems.name: SOUL-TALLY OFFERING
stratagems.rawType: Cult of the Arkifane – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Soul Forge unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Offering up so great a sacrificial victim will surely win favour with the Arkifane, or go some way toward settling the looming debts already incurred to him.

stratagems.name: BALEFIRE BOON
stratagems.rawType: Cult of the Arkifane – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Soul Forge unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
