stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Channelling the infernal flames of the soul forges, this unit tears through its victims with blows and blasts that melt the toughest armour.

stratagems.name: TOUCH OF THE ARKIFANE
stratagems.rawType: Cult of the Arkifane – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding Damned units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit is selected to make a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain.
stratagems.legend: The blessings of Vashtorr flow through these warriors’ weapons, infusing them with power and mutating them into still-deadlier forms.

stratagems.name: BIOMECHANOID REGENERATION
stratagems.rawType: Cult of the Arkifane – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding Damned units).
stratagems.effect: One model in your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If your unit has the Soul Forge keyword, one model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.
stratagems.legend: Metal and muscle, wire and sinew flow together, reknitting battle damage with sparking clots of repulsive mutant growth.

stratagems.name: UNHOLY FORTITUDE
stratagems.rawType: Cult of the Arkifane – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Soul Forge unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.legend: Responding swiftly to incoming fire, the bound entity within this daemon engine raises arcane wards to soak up the foe’s fury.

stratagems.name: FORGE-FIRE SURGE
stratagems.rawType: Cult of the Arkifane – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the Soul Forge keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
stratagems.legend: Warp-tainted motive force and empyric plasma flows through engine and living entity alike, driving them on even as it scours them from within.

stratagems.name: PICK THEM OFF
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.legend: The Heretic Astartes are pitiless reavers, targeting weak points in the enemy line with ruthless efficiency.

stratagems.name: FROM ALL SIDES
stratagems.when: Start of your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit for each other HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this phase (to a maximum of +3)
stratagems.legend: When the assault comes, it does so swiftly and without warning.

stratagems.name: COILS OF DECEPTION
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back
stratagems.legend: Some Heretic Astartes are masters of deceit, often feigning retreat only to open fire from close range.

stratagems.name: SCRAMBLED COORDINATES
stratagems.when: Start of the Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12 horizontally of your unit.|
CSM|RELENTLESS PURSUIT|000008965006|Deceptors – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|These warriors stalk their assigned target with dogged determination, reacting to their every move|Opponent’s turn|Movement phase|Deceptors|000000868|WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.legend: Employing fell techno-sorcery, the Heretic Astartes disroot enemy navigational cogitators and scramble teleporter beacons.

stratagems.name: PITILESS HUNTERS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: These predatory warriors sense weakness as the hydra shark smells blood, sating their bloodlust upon the fearful and wounded.

stratagems.name: DEPTHLESS CRUELTY
stratagems.when: Fight phase
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Terror troops such as these inflict agonies upon their victims with malicious relish, targeting the weakened and wounded without pity

stratagems.name: BLOODY EXAMPLE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army destroys a CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect:
Each enemy unit within 12 of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test.|
CSM|SCREAMING DESCENT|000008973006|Dread Talons – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Jump pack borne warriors descend from the skies, terrifying screams emanating from their vox-grilles as they plummet towards their prey.|Your turn|Movement phase|Dread Talons|000000870|WHEN: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.
stratagems.legend: The violent and bloody slaughter of the enemy’s leadership hurls their followers into abject panic.

stratagems.name: PERSISTENT ASSAILANTS
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more attacks this phase and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit is Below Half-strength you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.legend: These iron-willed warriors refuse to retreat, even i the face of overwhelming odds. Mounting losses serve only to drive them forward

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK DESTRUCTION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit’s ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons) have the [PISTOL] ability.
stratagems.legend: Even in the press of combat, the Heretic Astartes bring heavy weapons to bear, shattering fortifications and obliterating enemy infantry.

stratagems.name: PITILESS CANNONADE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit
stratagems.legend: These warriors focus their ire upon a wounded foe, combining fire to fell their target in a cavalcade of destructive force.

stratagems.name: BRUTAL ATTRITION
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack is allocated to your unit, after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, roll one D6 (to maximum of six D6 per attacking unit): for each 4+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.legend: These implacable soldiers weather the enemy's fury before striking back in kind, to devastating effect.

stratagems.name: STEADFAST DETERMINATION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
stratagems.legend: These warriors possess endless endurance and are capable of weathering untold hardships in order to destroy their foes.

stratagems.name: SIEGECRAFT
stratagems.when: Start of your opponents Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
stratagems.legend: Veterans of countless grinding sieges, these Heretic Astartes repel and pin down wave after wave of foes with rapid boltgun fire and accurate artillery.

stratagems.name: HARDENED KILLERS
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Damned unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Select one of the following effects:
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.Until the start of your next turn, your unit has the benefit of that effect.
stratagems.legend: The mortals under Huron’s command have earned their place through bloody success on countless battlefields.

stratagems.name: SEIZE THE PRIZE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army has been selected to Advance.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect:
Do not make an Advance roll for your unit. Instead, until the end of the phase add 6 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.|
CSM|REAVERS’ FLURRY|000010689005|Huron’s Marauders – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|The Red Corsairs excel in the furious violence of melee combat, butchering outmatched foes in a lethal flurry of steel.|Your turn|Fight phase|Huron’s Marauders|000001133|WHEN: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: After locating targets of opportunity, the Red Corsairs pursue them with shocking speed and relentless determination.

stratagems.name: LOW CUNNING
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Disabused of such notions as honour or self-sacrifice, Chaos Space Marines use every trick and cunning ruse to ensure their own survival.

stratagems.name: INVETERATE MURDERERS
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of the target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: So long have these warriors fought and killed their way across the galaxy that they have become experts in finding the weak spots of even the hardiest foes.

stratagems.name: NEXT PRIZE
stratagems.when: Your Command phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army has Secured an objective marker, or your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army has opened a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3. If this Stratagem is used in your Movement phase, at least one model from your unit must end that move on the opposite side of the Hatchway from the one it started the phase on.|
CSM|CRUEL EXECUTION|000009504005|Infernal Reavers – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Veteran killers all, these warriors will exploit the slightest enemy misstep to simply move back and gun their victims down in cold blood.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Infernal Reavers|000000946|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: The Long Waris gruelling and requires endless captured materiel to wage. Thus this warband are forever searching for the next cache of arms or riches to loot with rapacious eagerness.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS TERROR
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Heretic Astartes Infantry unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: These warriors strike in screaming waves, each charge as brutal as the last.

stratagems.name: TALONS SUNK DEEP
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: When indecision and terror grip the foe, their frailties are exposed to the cruelest of lunges.

stratagems.name: PREY ON THE WEAK
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Suitably wounded, or with the corpses of their comrades around them, the enemy’s faltering cohesion marks them as doomed.

stratagems.name: SADISTIC DISPLAY
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect:
Each enemy unit within 6 of and visible to your unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) must take a Battle-shock test.|
CSM|PROFANE ZEAL|000008358004|Pactbound Zealots – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Those Heretic Astartes sworn to the service of the Dark Gods display zeal through violence.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Pactbound Zealots|000000751|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: It is not enough to slay. The foe’s allies must understand exactly what horrors await them.

stratagems.name: SCOUR AND SEIZE
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.legend: If the bounty is to be claimed, the foe must first be purged.

stratagems.name: UNFAILINGLY OBDURATE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Such is their determination to claim their due that these warriors will gladly weather a storm of fire.

stratagems.name: RUINOUS RAID
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Fight phase
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Utilising their swift transports, these ravagers plunge through the enemy lines to assault key positions.

stratagems.name: OPPORTUNISTIC RAIDERS
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6, or up to 12 if it is a MOUNTED unit. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move. It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.legend: Mobility is the key to victory These Heretic Astartes raiders outmanoeuvre and outflank the foe in order to achieve victory.

stratagems.name: REAVERS’ HASTE
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If you select one or more units within range of an objective marker as a target of that charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.
stratagems.legend: The prospect of riches spurs these renegade warriors forwards. Woe betide any in their path.

stratagems.name: WARPCHARGED ENGINES
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TRANSPORT or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.|
CSM|VENGEFUL DESTRUCTION|000010695003|Renegade Warband – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Hatred is a powerful motivator. Those who cross Renegade Space Marines rarely live long enough to regret their actions.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Renegade Warband|000001134|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: The engines of this vehicle or construct crackle with the raw energies of the immaterium, propelling it forward or incredible speed.

stratagems.name: RENEGADE CLAIM
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.legend: Renegades do not relinquish their prizes easily.

stratagems.name: UNDYING HATRED
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Freed from the Emperor’s yoke, these warriors are motivated only by bitter hatred, channelling their ire into every brutal strike: even their final one.

stratagems.name: DESPERATE PLEDGE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: A daemon construct may beseech the Arkifane for further aid, adding to its soul debt in return for greater might.

stratagems.name: DAEMONIC POSSESION
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding Daemon units).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, your unit has the DAEMON keyword.
stratagems.legend: Those steeped in techno-sorcery may trammel daemonic entities within mechanical constructs.

stratagems.name: UNSTOPPABLE RAMPAGE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Heretic Astartes Vehicle or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes Normal, Advance or charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.
stratagems.legend: The tortured machine spirits of Heretic Astartes vehicles are driven forward by their anguish.

stratagems.name: GLUT OF SOULS
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding Titanic units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack that destroys an enemy model, roll one D6: on 5+, your unit regains 1 lost wound after all of its attacks have been resolved (to a maximum of 6 wound).
stratagems.legend: Wrh each soul harvested the bound daemon comes closer to settling its contract and earning freedom.

stratagems.name: PREDATORY PURSUIT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall back move.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that is within 9 of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Corrupted Heretic Astartes Vehicles Pursue their prey with an animalistic determination.

stratagems.name: FEEDING FRENZY
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that is within Engagement Range of your units Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, of that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, substract 1 from each of those tests.
stratagems.legend: The daemonic entities at the heart of possessed vehicles hunger for the life force of their enemies.

stratagems.name: INFERNAL ALTARS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if your unit is within range of an objective marker, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against that attack. If your unit has the CULTIST MOB keyword, models in it have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against that attack instead.
stratagems.legend: Whether heretical fanes unveiled amidst the rebellion or heaped corpses and votive offerings, these ritual foci lend the faithful supernatural protection.

stratagems.name: FLEETING MIGHT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DAMNED unit from your army makes a Dark Pact.
stratagems.target: That DAMNED unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
stratagems.legend: For one tantalising instant, the dark prayers of these fanatics are answered by some infernal warp patron, placing the power to slay champions in their hands.

stratagems.name: STORM THE BRIDGE!
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One DAMNED or CHAOS SPAwN unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: Seizing their opportunity to strike a fatal blow against those who have oppressed them for so long - and please the Dark Gods in the process - these heretics surge forwards with zealous ferocity.

stratagems.name: CRUDE SABOTAGE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One CULTIST MOB or DAMNED CHARAcTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
Select one closed Hatchway within 1“ of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.
RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.
stratagems.legend: Using charged rigged from scavenged junk and pollutant runoff, the fanatical masses blast open the hatchways that bar their paths to ascension.

stratagems.name: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
stratagems.rawType: Veterans of the Long War – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponents Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Such embittered warriors as these shrug off hails of enemy fire with arrogant disdain.

stratagems.name: LET THE GALAXY BURN
stratagems.rawType: Veterans of the Long War – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding TZEENTCH units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.
stratagems.legend: No barricade or fortification is proof against the vengeful fury of these hate-fuelled murderers.

stratagems.name: BRINGERS OF DESPAIR
stratagems.rawType: Veterans of the Long War – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
stratagems.legend: Fearful of countenance, these ancient warriors are redolent with warp power and radiate a horrifying aura of might.

stratagems.name: ENDLESS IRE
stratagems.rawType: Veterans of the Long War – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units)
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit within 12 of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.|
CSM|MILLENNIA OF EXPERIENCE|000008961007|Veterans of the Long War – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Thousands of years of ceaseless conflict have forged these warriors into skilled and merciless killers.|Opponent’s turn|Movement phase|Veterans of the Long War|000000867|WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.legend: No amount of bloodshed can truly satisfy this bitter champion's desire for vengeance.

stratagems.name: GRIM REAPERS
stratagems.rawType: Death Lord’s Chosen – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Swollen with bitter arrogance, these warriors carve a path through their perceived lessers and leave them as worm food.

stratagems.name: SIGNAL POX
stratagems.rawType: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Lord of Virulence model from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Select one objective marker within 30 of and visible to your model. Until the start of your next turn, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective marker, that unit is Afflicted.|
DG|BLOOMING PESTILENCE|000010144002|Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem|1|Death Guard warriors know to chant the sevenfold prayers to unleash Nurgle's bounty on the foe.|Either player’s turn|Any phase|Death Lord’s Chosen|000001054|WHEN: Start of any phase.
stratagems.legend: Guided in by rasping jets of fumes sent up by this Lord of Virulence, plague-ridden artillery fire and airbursting spore-shells saturate the target zone.

stratagems.name: UNDYING SPITE
stratagems.rawType: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Terminator unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Driven by bitterness and the putrid vitality of Nurgle's gifts, these warriors fight on for several moments, even after death.

stratagems.name: MORTARION'S TEACHINGS
stratagems.rawType: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.
stratagems.legend: Exemplifying the Daemon Primarch's doctrines on versatile heavy infantry tactics, these warriors position themselves and let fly.

stratagems.name: SICKENING IMPACT
stratagems.rawType: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Terminator unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.legend: Employing their crushing bulk and contagious gifts, these Terminators slam into their victims and grind them into putrefying mulch.

stratagems.name: INFESTATION
stratagems.when: Start or end of any turn, when an enemy unit attempts to Seize an objective marker you have Secured.
stratagems.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXwALKERS units) within Contagion Range of that objective marker.
stratagems.effect:
Roll one D6: on a 5+, until the end of your next turn, that objective marker remains Secured by your army and you are considered to control it, regardless of how many enemy models are within range of it.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
stratagems.legend: The taint left by the servants of Nurgle is not easily scoured from the stuff of realspace.

stratagems.name: MYPHITIC INVIGORATION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that is within 6 of one or more friendly Myphitic Blight-hauler units and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of this unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.|
DG|DRONING HORROR|000009730005|Flyblown Host – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Clouds of droning daemon flies sweep across the battlefield to envelop the enemies of the Death Guard. As their victims claw and scratch at the seething swarms, Mortarion’s sons pick off their targets at leisure.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Flyblown Host|000000980|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Daemon flies are drawn to and invigorated by the foul miasmas surrounding Myphitic Blight‑haulers. In the vicinity of these malodorous constructs, the swarms gather in densities great enough to form a living barrier to the foe’s attacks.

stratagems.name: SHOCK AND HORROR
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Death Guard unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That DEATH GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
stratagems.legend: Already dismayed by this living nightmare, the enemy falters before another sudden onslaught.

stratagems.name: HIDDEN AMONGST THE DEAD
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.
stratagems.legend: Another wave of Poxwalkers rises from the battlefield’s carrion heaps.

stratagems.name: SMEARED WITH FILTH
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
stratagems.legend: Hacking a path through a horde of Poxwalkers leaves aggressors coated in infectious matter.

stratagems.name: CLUTCHING CORRUPTION
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more Plague Legions units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: The daemons of Nurgle grasp their victims tightly with rotting talons and coiling tentacles, their clutch as inescapable as entropy itself.

stratagems.name: PERSISTENT PESTS
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Nurglings unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect:
Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.legend: There is no simple way to wholly cleanse a Nurgling infestation once it has taken root.

stratagems.name: ALL IS ROT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Plague Legions unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
stratagems.legend: Death Guard warriors open fire into foes already embattled by Nurgle’s daemons, knowing that no matter who they hit, all will wither and rot.

stratagems.name: FLESHY AVALANCHE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Plague Legions Monster unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.legend: The ephemeral structures of realspace have no power to halt the onset of Nurgle's Great Unclean Ones; they crumble, rot and burst apart before their unholy bulk.

stratagems.name: AVATARS OF DECAY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Plague Legions unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6 of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.|
DG|MIRESLICK|000010136007|Tallyband Summoners – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Beneath the tread of Nurgle’s daemons, even ferrocrete or plasteel soon turns to a quagmire of rotting matter, in which their unlucky enemies begin to sink and become trapped.|Opponent’s turn|Movement phase|Tallyband Summoners|000001052|WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.legend: Countless diseases blossom in the unreal flesh of Nurgle's daemon childer, manifestations of his blessings to be spread to all.

stratagems.name: DISGUSTINGLY RESILIENT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: Those favoured by Nurgle are inured to pain, their rotting bodies shrugging off all but the most traumatic damage with ease.

stratagems.name: PLAGUESURGE
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: Your Death Guard WARLORD that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect:
Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3 to the Contagion Range of models from your army.|
DG|LEECHSPORE ERUPTION|000010124005|Virulent Vectorium – Epic Deed Stratagem|1|Billowing from this warrior's wounds come clouds of parasitic spores that settle on the foe and drain their vitality, stealing it for the one who spawned them.|Your turn|Command phase|Virulent Vectorium|000001049|WHEN: Your Command phase.
stratagems.legend: The foul miasma around the Death Guard swells and thickens, boiling outward like putrid smog.

stratagems.name: PUTRID DETONATION
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Death Guard Vehicle or Death Guard Monster model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
stratagems.legend: Bloated with putrefaction and swilling with infectious poisons, the demise of this hulking entity is as revolting as it is explosively hazardous.

stratagems.name: OVERWHELMING GENEROSITY
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Death Guard Character unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.
stratagems.legend: Unholy filth gushes from Nurgle's faithful into their guns until the armaments threaten to burst like bloated corpses.

stratagems.name: CREEPING BLIGHT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Those in the grip of Nurgle's unholy plagues become weaker by the moment, barely able to lift their weapons, let alone defend themselves from the attacking Death Guard.

stratagems.name: CONNOISSEURS OF PAIN
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Spend 1 Pain token. Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. At the end of the phase, if your unit is still on the battlefield and it is a Haemonculus Covens unit, you gain 1 Pain token.
stratagems.legend: These epicureans of extreme sensation revel in their agonies as much as those of the foe.

stratagems.name: POSTMORTALITY
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Haemonculus model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect:
Spend 1-3 Pain tokens. At the end of the phase, set the destroyed model back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with a number of wounds remaining equal to the number of Pain tokens you just spent.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem if you have 0 Pain tokens, and you cannot target the same HAEMONCULUS model with this Stratagem more than once per battle.
stratagems.legend: To the greatest Haemonculi, death is but an intriguing and temporary state to be experienced.

stratagems.name: POISONER’S ART
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a Haemonculus Covens unit from your army has fought.
stratagems.target: That HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is poisoned. At the start of each Command phase, roll one D6 for each poisoned unit on the battlefield: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: The venoms wielded by these warriors are potent enough to impress Shaimesh himself.

stratagems.name: SYMPHONY OF SUFFERING
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a Drukhari unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That DRUKHARI unit.
stratagems.effect:
Each enemy unit within 9 of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if your unit is a Haemonculus Covens unit.|
DRU|ENFOLDING NIGHTMARE|000010585007|Covenite Coterie – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Even as the prey seek to drive the covenites back with hails of firepower, the horrors lurch closer.|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|Covenite Coterie|000001114|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.legend: So extreme are the foe's agonies that they spread a shock wave of terror through their comrades.

stratagems.name: DECKPLATE SWEEPERS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One KABAL unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of splinter cannons, splinter rifles and splinter pistols equipped by models in your unit by 1.
stratagems.legend: Indiscriminate hails of splinter fire fill chambers and corridors, leaving nowhere to hide in the enclosed space.

stratagems.name: ELUSIVE DUELLISTS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, if your unit has the INcUBI keyword, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: These warriors delight in the close-quarters blade-duels of boarding actions, weaving around their enemies' blows and cutting them down in droves.

stratagems.name: OPPORTUNISTIC THIEVES
stratagems.when: End of your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One KABAL unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
Select one objective marker you do not control that is visible to your unit. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6, but if it does, every model in that unit must end that move as close as possible to that objective marker.|
DRU|TAKE THEM ALIVE|000009434004|Kabalite Corsairs – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Aiming to maim rather than slag, and employing psychotropic or paralysing venoms, the Kabalites seek to incapacitate their victims so that they too may be taken as plunder.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Kabalite Corsairs|000000935|WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABAL unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.legend: Any undefended source of riches or power is fair game to these fast-moving raiders.

stratagems.name: INSTINCTIVE SPITE
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two Drukhari Battleline units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: You can spend 1 Pain token. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in each of those units makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If you spent 1 Pain token, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.legend: It is hardwired into the Drukhari psyche to prey upon weakened and suffering victims.

stratagems.name: FIGHTING SHADOWS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari unit from your army (excluding Haemonculus Covens units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Even attempting to strike the Drukhari is like trying to lay a blade to smoke, so sly and swift are they.

stratagems.name: DARK HARVEST
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two Wracks units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in each of those units have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
stratagems.legend: Wicked sickles and serrated blades hack through writhing flesh as the Drukhari harvest agony and suffering.

stratagems.name: RAID AND FADE
stratagems.when: End of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two Kabalite Warriors units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army (excluding ScouRGES and Aircraft).
stratagems.effect:
Each of those units can make a Normal move of up to 6.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Until the end of the turn, those units are not eligible to declare a charge.|
DRU|MALICIOUS FRENZY|000009782002|Reaper’s Wager – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Jealous competition descends into frenzied carnage as the kill count climbs higher and the intoxicating screams of the dying fill the air.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Reaper’s Wager|000000993|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: The Drukhari are masters at using hit-and-run tactics, engaging a target with a flurry of shots before quickly manoeuvring into cover or out of sight.

stratagems.name: SHORTEN THE ODDS
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army has Advanced.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: Having selected their victims, these killers strive to complete the kill with speed and brutality whilst moving ever closer to winning their macabre wager.

stratagems.name: FATEFUL ROLE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if that unit is losing the wager: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: These warriors are so absorbed by their desire to win the wager that they risk death to land their killing blows.

stratagems.name: SCINTILLATING TEMPO
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase, just after a Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at your unit.
stratagems.legend: Commorrite or Harlequin, these lithe combatants move with stunning speed, darting in and out of firing lines before their foes can raise their weapons.

stratagems.name: HYPERAGILITY
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One WYcH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Driven by combat drugs and the elation of their victims'fear and pain, the Wyches weave around their enemies' blades with easy scorn.

stratagems.name: TOYING WITH THE PREY
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a WYcH CULT unit from your army has fought.
stratagems.target: That WYCH CULT unit.
stratagems.effect: If your unit destroyed one or more enemy models this phase, select one of those enemy models. Until the end of your opponent’s next turn, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy model's unit (to a minimum of l).
stratagems.legend: More than simply besting their victims in combat, the Wyches slowly take them apart, one perfectly placed cut and slice at a time, making a terrifying example to shatter enemy morale.

stratagems.name: NO OBSTACLE
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that opened a Hatchway this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can declare a charge that includes one or more targets that are not visible to it, provided each of those units that are not visible to it are wholly on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit.
stratagems.legend: Scenting their prey's fear sweat, tracking their fluttering heartbeats, the Wyches beardown unerringly on their victims through corridors and chambers.

stratagems.name: PHANTASM GRENADES
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a WYcH CULT unit from your army ends a Normal move, before any enemy units fire Overwatch.
stratagems.target: That WYCH CULT unit.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit within 9 of and visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.|
DRU|SKYBORNE ANNIHILATION|000010577005|Skysplinter Assault – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|These warriors are well versed in raining suppressing fire on the foe even as they close with them from on high, shredding defences and leaving the survivors easy prey for the raid.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Skysplinter Assault|000000831|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: These hallucinogenic atomisers spew clouds of nightmare-inducing gasses that leave the foe glassy-eyed and reeling.

stratagems.name: ACROBATIC DISPLAY
stratagems.rawType: Spectacle of Spite – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Wych Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: Moving so quickly they seem to blur, the Wyches evade incoming fire with contemptuous elegance.

stratagems.name: A CHALLENGE MET
stratagems.rawType: Spectacle of Spite – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that would be able to declare a charge if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit within 9 of your unit that was set up on the battlefield this phase or that ended a Normal or Advance move this phase. Your unit now declares a charge that targets only that enemy unit, and you resolve that charge.
RESTRICTIONS: Even if that charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.|
DRU|DEADLY DEBUT|000010581003|Spectacle of Spite – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Imitating Lelith Hesperax, these warriors begin their gladiatorial bout with an opening so spectacularly violent that none can fail to be impressed.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Spectacle of Spite|000001113|WHEN: Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: The foe's advance is not something to be wary of but rather an opportunity to be seized.

stratagems.name: SYCOPHANTIC SURGE
stratagems.rawType: Carnival of Excess – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, provided at least one of the targets of that charge is within Engagement Range of one or more Emperor’s Children units from your army.
stratagems.legend: The daemons of Slaanesh care naught for mortals but strive to earn the approval of their Dark Prince.

stratagems.name: UNCANNY REACTIONS
stratagems.rawType: Carnival of Excess – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Slaanesh unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Those who have earned the favour of their Dark Prince may be granted a sliver of his grace.

stratagems.name: DARK APPARITIONS
stratagems.rawType: Carnival of Excess – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Daemonettes unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If it arrives back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6 horizontally away from all enemy units (instead of more than 9), provided it is also set up wholly within 9 of one or more friendly Emperor’s Children units.|
EC|ECSTATIC SLAUGHTER|000010011003|Carnival of Excess – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|As the violence intensifies, so does the ecstasy of battle empower daemon and mortal alike.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Carnival of Excess|000001036|WHEN: Fight phase, just after a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: The daemons of Slaanesh are not bound by the laws of reality, fading in and out of existence at will.

stratagems.name: VIOLENT CRESCENDO
stratagems.rawType: Carnival of Excess – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Slaanesh Beasts, Slaanesh Infantry or SLAANESH Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6 instead of up to 3. When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: In the final act of the battle, the followers of Slaanesh descend to slaughter the remaining foes.

stratagems.name: MARTIAL PERFECTION
stratagems.rawType: Coterie of the Conceited – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: The Emperor’s Children find stimulation in excess, be it brutally shocking acts of violence or gratuitous displays of martial prowess.

stratagems.name: UNBOUND ARROGANCE
stratagems.rawType: Coterie of the Conceited – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Emperor’s Children unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect:
Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
stratagems.legend: The hubris of the Emperor’s Children is both their greatest strength and their biggest weakness.

stratagems.name: UNSHAKEABLE OPPONENTS
stratagems.rawType: Coterie of the Conceited – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Inured to ordinary sensations by several lifetimes of indulgence, there is little that can deter or faze the warriors of the Emperor's Children.

stratagems.name: EMBRACE THE PAIN
stratagems.rawType: Coterie of the Conceited – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children Infantry unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.
stratagems.legend: The Emperor’s Children revel in every sensation - even ones that would slay lesser mortals outright.

stratagems.name: PROTECTION OF THE DARK PRINCE
stratagems.rawType: Coterie of the Conceited – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound or attack is allocated to a model in an Emperor’s Children unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: On occasion, the Dark Prince may grant a boon of protection to his favoured followers in the heat of battle. Such a boon incurs a debt, one that will be paid in the fullness of time.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF ABHORRENCE
stratagems.rawType: Coterie of the Conceited – Wargear Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The abhorrent contempt that the Emperor’s Children possess, combined with their combat-stimmed physiologies, makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: CATALYTIC STIMULUS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Stimulus move. To do so, roll one D6: models in your unit move a number of inches up to the result, but your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Invigorated by pain, the Emperor’s Children will embrace an enemy’s attack as a catalyst for masterful vengeance.

stratagems.name: PRIDEFUL SUPERIORITY
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: The chance to ostentatiously humble the foe’s champions and prove them worthless rivals is a lure few Emperor’s Children can resist.

stratagems.name: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: With cocktails of resilience-enhancing stimms or armour inlaid with forbidden runes of warding, the Emperor’s Children sneeringly disregard even powerful blows.

stratagems.name: EUPHORIC INSPIRATION
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children Daemon unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls for friendly Emperor’s Children units within 6 of your unit.|
EC|CLOSE-QUARTERS EXCRUCIATION|000010655005|Court of the Phoenician – Stratagem|1|At short range, the Emperor’s Children eagerly target weak points in their enemies, exulting over every cry of pain they elicit.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Court of the Phoenician|000001125|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Those with the Dark Prince’s blessings inspire euphoric floods of battle-lust in the Emperor’s Children, who power towards the foe with screams of murderous ecstasy.

stratagems.name: SINUOUS BREACH
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children Daemon unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.legend: The power of Slaanesh is an undulating and writhing thing, and his daemonic servants can mould their forms to slither over and through any obstacle.

stratagems.name: VIOLENT EXCESS
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
stratagems.legend: The visceral thrill of killing causes the warriors of the Emperor’s Children to enter an ecstatic frenzy of butchery and dismemberment.

stratagems.name: COMBAT STIMMS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children iNFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Hideously euphoric concoctions empower the minds and constitutions of the Legion’s sybaritic warriors.

stratagems.name: HONOUR THE PRINCE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.|
EC|CAPRICIOUS REACTIONS|000009999006|Mercurial Host – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Their superhuman reflexes enhanced by endless streams of addictive combat stimms, the Emperor's Children react to incoming fire with haste, weaving between shots and taking cover in the blink of an eye.|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|Mercurial Host|000001033|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Warriors who venerate Slaanesh through the most graceful fighting forms are rewarded for their efforts.

stratagems.name: CUT DOWN THE WEAK
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army (you can only select a Vehicle if it is a Walker) that is within 6 of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select that enemy unit as a target of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.|
EC|DEATH ECSTASY|000010003003|Peerless Bladesmen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|2|Death is but another thrilling experience and the Emperor's Children are loath to deny the enemy such ecstatic sensation.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Peerless Bladesmen|000001034|WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Contempt for lesser warriors drives the Emperor's Children in their punishing reprisals.

stratagems.name: OUTFLANKING STRIKE
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children Transport from your army, or up to two Emperor’s Children Dedicated Transports from your army.
stratagems.effect:
For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9 of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.|
EC|REACTIVE DISEMBARKATION|000010007006|Rapid Evisceration – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|As their transports come underfire, the Emperor’s Children disembark and take the fight to the foe with boltgun and sword.|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|Rapid Evisceration|000001035|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: The Emperor’s Children utilise their infantry to pin the enemy down whilst further transports seek to outflank the foe and deploy troops behind.

stratagems.name: DEVOTED DUELLISTS
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One or more Emperor’s Children Character units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those CHARACTER units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: By slaying theirfoes in close combat, the champions of Slaanesh seek to elevate themselves in his favour.

stratagems.name: HEIGHTENED JEALOUSY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Emperor’s Children Character unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions, or just after your army’s Favoured Champions unit destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: Your army’s Favoured Champions unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that is not your army’s Favoured Champions makes an attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: Rivalries are commonplace amongst the champions of the Emperor's Children as all vie for Slaanesh’s boons.

stratagems.name: REFUSAL TO BE OUTDONE
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Emperor’s Children Character unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more units from your army. Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if that enemy unit is one of the targets of that charge, add 2 to the Charge roll.
stratagems.legend: Rivals for the Dark Prince's favour will stop at nothing to outdo their foes and claim a greater tally of souls.

stratagems.name: DIABOLIC MAJESTY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Emperor’s Children Character unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect:
Each enemy unit within 6 of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.|
EC|BEAUTIFUL DEATH|000010019003|Slaanesh’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The more extravagant and luridly violent the kill, the greater the Dark Prince's appreciation.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Slaanesh’s Chosen|000001038|WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Those who gaze upon one of Slaanesh’s chosen are stricken by their diabolic majesty.

stratagems.name: EAGER FOR MORE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3.|
EC|ALLURING GROTESQUERIE|000010809002|Sublime Strike – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Physically and spiritually distorted by the blessings of Slaanesh, these warriors can project an aura that fascinates and revolts their enemies on a level so instinctual that it drives some to madness.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Sublime Strike|000001154|WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Never sated, no matter the ferocity of the fight, the Emperor's Children maintain a manic momentum as they drive toward their primary target at a breakneck pace.

stratagems.name: EVASIVE VANGUARD
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 9 of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers, before removing those markers from the battlefield.
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9 horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.legend: Adaptive and intelligent, the purest of a cult's broods can evade their foes to find new avenues of ingress.

stratagems.name: SYMBIOTIC DESTRUCTION
stratagems.rawType: Brood Brother Auxilia – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum and one GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that is visible to both of those selected units and within range of at least one ranged weapon from each of those units. Until the end of the phase, models in those units can only make attacks that target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). When doing so, each time such a model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
stratagems.legend: As the Broodmind coordinates their timing, martial and insurrectionist comrades target their chosen victims in volleys of mutually supportive firepower.

stratagems.name: A DARK NETWORK
stratagems.rawType: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum or GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 12 of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6.
stratagems.legend: Forewarned of the enemy's sudden onset by spies in their ranks or by the Brood Brothers' own strategos, the cult’s faithful evade potential catastrophe.

stratagems.name: ACCEPTABLE LOSSES
stratagems.rawType: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Astra Militarum unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army. Until the end of the phase, your unit can make ranged attacks that target that enemy unit. If it does, after it has resolved those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those GENESTEALER CULTS units: on a 5+, the unit being rolled for suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: With martial pragmatism and the cult's victory at stake, Brood Brothers will willingly open fire on the foe even if it endangers infiltrating cells of allies.

stratagems.name: SUPPRESS AND OVERWHELM
stratagems.rawType: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Astra Militarum unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That ASTRA MILITARUM unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot be targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem and each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army selects that enemy unit as a target of a charge, you can re-roll the Charge roll.
stratagems.legend: Disciplined salvoes of fire can drive the foe into cover, leaving them vulnerable to the rest of the cult.

stratagems.name: REGIMENTAL REINFORCEMENTS
stratagems.rawType: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Astra Militarum Infantry Regiment unit from your army (excluding Artillery and Character units) is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect:
Roll one D6: on a 3+, place one Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9 horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed) and add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.|
GC|IN THE SHADOW OF IRON|000009085002|Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Hulking armoured war engines provide ideal cover to launch a well-timed ambush.|Either player’s turn|Any phase|Brood Brother Auxilia|000000888|WHEN: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 9” of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.legend: Xeno-tainted soldiers have long learned to lurk in the shadows, ready to attack when the cult calls.

stratagems.name: FOR THE BROOD
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more friendly GENESTEALER CULTS units. Until the end of the phase, your unit can make ranged attacks that target that enemy unit. If it does, after your unit has finished making those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those friendly units: on a 2-4, that friendly unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that friendly unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: Fanatical, and with wills suborned by the insidious Broodmind, these cultists will gladly die amidst hails of their comrades’fire if it means victory.

stratagems.name: OUT OF HIDING
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
stratagems.target: One NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
stratagems.legend: Wary of detection, the cult has concealed cells of the faithful through the structure of the ship. Now they emerge into the fight like insects from their cocoon.

stratagems.name: PLANNED EXTRACTION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Driven by the Broodmind and their own guerrilla training, these cultists refuse open battle, instead firing hails of cover fire as they retreat into the shadows.

stratagems.name: DIVINE IMPERATIVE
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
