stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more Tyranids units from your army. Until the end of the phase, each time your GENESTEALER CULTS unit declares a charge, if that enemy unit is one of the targets of that charge, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit and you can re-roll the Charge roll.
stratagems.legend: Cultists dash madly into the fighting without a care for their survival, drawn onward to aid the vanguard organisms by a will they cannot resist.

stratagems.name: HYPERFEROCITY
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If one or more friendly Tyranids units are within 6 of that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.|
GC|AVENGE THE STAR CHILDREN|000009828004|Final Day – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Some amongst the cult still retain enough sentience and zeal to feel rage and a need for vengeance if they see the Star Children slain.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Final Day|000001002|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.legend: Goaded by the newly ascendant Hive Mind, the cultists fight with greater fury even as their muscles tear and organs rupture under the strain.

stratagems.name: RESISTANCE TUNNELS
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults or Tyranids unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: Never again will the tunnel networks of the cult provide secret roads for hopeful and idealistic freedom fighters. Yet they can still serve one last time as a means by which the Tyranids and their surviving worshippers can vanish from the battlefield only to strike again elsewhere.

stratagems.name: UNSTOPPABLE BRUTES
stratagems.when: Your Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ABOMINANT or ABERRANTS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, when makinga Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1 of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.|
GC|GROWING DREAD|000009469005|Genespawn Onslaught – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The more enemies see of the gene-wrought terrors they are fighting against, the more their tactical cohesion is drowned by horror and panic.|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|Genespawn Onslaught|000000940|WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to perform a Tactical Manoeuvre.
stratagems.legend: Bulked out with enormous slabs of twisted muscle, Aberrants and Abominants simply smash aside hatches and bulkheads that block their paths.

stratagems.name: MONSTROUS MOMENTUM
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That GENESTEALER CULTS unit.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in your unit can end that move as close as possible to the nearest Hatchway instead of the nearest visible enemy unit. Your unit can then attempt to operate that Hatchway.
stratagems.legend: Not content with slaying their immediate prey, these warriors press on in search of more before the bodies have even stopped twitching.

stratagems.name: SOLDIERS OF THE STAR CHILDREN
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a HYBRID METAMORPHS unit from your army is selected to perform the Set Overwatch Tactical Manoeuvre.
stratagems.target: That HYBRID METAMORPHS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
stratagems.legend: For all their grotesque appearance, Hybrid Metamorphs are amongst the most skilled and ruthlessly efficient of the cult’s warriors.

stratagems.name: COORDINATED TRAP
stratagems.rawType: Host of Ascension – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Two GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (if this Stratagem is used in the Fight phase, that enemy unit must be within Engagement Range of both of your units). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: A tenet of guerrilla warfare is the concentration of even inferior firepower to inflict maximum harm.

stratagems.name: PRIMED AND READIED
stratagems.rawType: Host of Ascension – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
stratagems.legend: The broodkin have been trained and equipped for this moment, with weapons readied for Ascension.

stratagems.name: TUNNEL CRAWLERS
stratagems.rawType: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6 horizontally away from all enemy units.
RESTRICTIONS: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.|
GC|RETURN TO THE SHADOWS|000009068006|Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|With their task of drawing the oppressors' fire complete, the surviving cultists melt away, ready to strike again.|Opponent’s turn|Fight phase|Host of Ascension|000000884|WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: The cult can expertly assail seemingly impregnable enemy positions.

stratagems.name: A DEADLY SNARE
stratagems.rawType: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults Infantry unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: An enemy's fervour to strike down the faithful of the cult can be turned against them, luring the foe into a region laced with hidden traps and primed explosives.

stratagems.name: HYPERADRENAL REFLEXES
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: Goaded by the biostimulants surging through their bodies, these warrior organisms evade their enemies'attacks with unbelievable swiftness.

stratagems.name: HUNTING GROUNDS
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That GREAT DEVOURER unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3, provided at least one of its models ends that move on the opposite side of that Hatchway from when your unit opened it.|
GC|OUTFLANK|000009477005|Infestation Swarm – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Swarms of Genestealers crawl through vents and ducts as they seek to outflank their prey.|Opponent’s turn|Fight phase|Infestation Swarm|000000941|WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Genestealers on the hunt are relentless, squirming through hatches before they have even half opened.

stratagems.name: ALONG SHADOWED TRAILS
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 9 of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9 horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.legend: With raw speed and subtle misdirection, Atalan Jackals outflank those who believe them trapped.

stratagems.name: RAPID FEINT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that is within 9 of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6.
stratagems.legend: An Outlander Claw’s skilled riders and crews can use their enhanced hybrid reactions to rapidly alter speed and course, roaring after fleeing prey or luring enemy out of position and leaving them flat-footed.

stratagems.name: ENCIRCLING THE PREY
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Genestealer Cults Mounted or Genestealer Cults Vehicle unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is wholly within 9 of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.effect:
Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.|
GC|FRENZIED DEVOTION|000009072003|Xenocreed Congregation – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|The faithful will gladly hurl themselves into harm's way.frenziedly dragging the foe down.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Xenocreed Congregation|000000885|WHEN: Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Skirting the edge of battle, an Outlander Claw's raiders watch keenly forvulnerabilities, ready to throw themselves back into the fight to exploit any weaknesses in the enemy.

stratagems.name: TRANSCENDENT CELERITY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
stratagems.legend: Owing to their hypersensory reactions, the cult’s rate of fire increases.

stratagems.name: TIRELESS FERVOUR
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. When doing so, if it targets an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more friendly Character units, you can re-roll the Charge roll.
stratagems.legend: When the cult's leaders demand devotion, danger and exhaustion are forgotten in the rush to serve.

stratagems.name: THE PATH OF ANGUISH
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Acolyte Hybrids or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a move of up to D6, but it unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT), When doing so, models in your unit can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.|
GK|AGGRESSIVE ANTICIPATION|000010365002|Augurium Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Already knowing, blow-for-blow, how the battle they fight is predicted to play out, the Grey Knights take full advantage of their supernatural insight.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Augurium Task Force|000001085|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Bloody persecution by the oppressors is grist for the mill of the cult's violent and zealous creed.

stratagems.name: ARMOURED AEGIS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARAcTER model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
stratagems.legend: This warrior stands indomitable, a shining tower of strength amidst a maelstrom of foes.

stratagems.name: SANCTIC CIRCLE
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARAcTER or PALADIN SqUAD unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker within 9” of and visible to your unit. If that objective marker does not have any enemy models within range of it (excluding Battle-shocked models), your unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result if that objective marker is Secured by your opponent’s army. If that test is passed, that objective marker is no longer considered Secured by your opponent’s army and is Secured by your army.
stratagems.legend: Through focused psychic might, this warrior cleanses and wards a vital location against the foe.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS BOARDERS
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Once aboard the enemy vessel, the elite of the Grey Knights press forward relentlessly, even their momentary withdrawals only presaging another aggressive push into the next chamber.

stratagems.name: PSYBOLT AMMUNITION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of storm bolters equipped by models in your unit by 1.
stratagems.legend: By entreating the machine spirit of his weapon with psychic incantations, a battle-brother can infuse it's already deadly payload with explosive mental energy.

stratagems.name: HEXWROUGHT REPRISAL
stratagems.when: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is on the battlefield and suffered one or more mortal wounds this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit which inflicted one or more mortal wounds on your unit this phase, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of mortal wounds your unit suffered this phase: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.
stratagems.legend: Hexagrammic wards worked into this warrior’s wargear blaze to life, bringing down a potent empyric curse upon those who dared seek to harm him.

stratagems.name: WARDING CHANT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1.
stratagems.legend: The Grey Knights maintain a tireless chant of warding magicks that turn aside the blasts and blades of even the most skilled foes.

stratagems.name: CHAOS BANE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] ability.
stratagems.legend: The Grey Knights reserve their greatest loathing and most potent rites of banishment for those who serve the Ruinous Powers.

stratagems.name: CELERITY
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Psyker Infantry unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: Tried and tested tactical battlefield magick, this working accelerates its casters' swiftness of thought and movement to preternatural levels.

stratagems.name: SHADOW OF ANARCH
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is within 9 of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6 or, if it has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: This muttered incantation conjures a sympathetic shadow of the true darkness beneath Mount Anarch, through which the Grey Knights stride fearlessly to emerge elsewhere than where they began.

stratagems.name: CIRCLE OF SANCTUARY
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Character model from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12 horizontally of your model.|
GK|PURGATION PATTERN|000010349004|Brotherhood Strike – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Employing an overlapping fire pattern coupled with destructive cantrips, the Grey Knights fill the target zone with an inescapable hail of death.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Brotherhood Strike|000001081|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Autolaunchers on this warrior's armour dispense airbursting canisters of blessed waters to create an instant zone of warding against hostile manifestations.

stratagems.name: TRUESILVER CHANNELLING
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
stratagems.legend: Chanting words of abjuration, the Grey Knights pour their psychic might into their weapons until they burn with a sorcerous flame.

stratagems.name: DUTY UNENDING
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more Grey Knights units from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: One of those GREY KNIGHTS units that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: There are always more threats than the templars of Titan can attend to at once. They must strike swiftly before redeploying to the following critical combat.

stratagems.name: EXPEDITIOUS EXIT
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Psyker Infantry unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
If every model in your unit has the Deep Strike ability, remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Designer’s Note: This Stratagem allows you to remove a unit in addition to those removed using the Gate of Infinity rule, and it allows you to remove a unit within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.legend: Pragmatists well aware of their irreplaceable value, the warriors of Titan will not spend themselves needlessly in losing battles.

stratagems.name: GIANTS OF THE BATTLEFIELD
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
stratagems.legend: Seeming to loom impossibly large in the minds of their foes, the Grey Knights employ the sheer force of their presence to overwhelm the enemy.

stratagems.name: GRIND THEM UNDERFOOT
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Grey Knights Terminator unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.legend: A psychic shock wave drives foes to their knees at the moment before the Terminators' armoured mass smashes into them with killing force.

stratagems.name: UNENDING FIDELITY
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Unto their last breath and sometimes even beyond, the templars of Titan strive to fight on in the Emperor’s name.

stratagems.name: SHINING RESOLVE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Undimmed by pain, hardship or horror, the Grey Knights will to see their duty done burns as bright as a purifying flame.

stratagems.name: PRECOGNITIVE STRATEGIES
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that is within 9 of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6.
stratagems.legend: The psychic abilities of these battle-brothers are turned toward predicting the foe's actions even before their enemies know what they will do.

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK PURGATION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, storm bolter weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] and [TWIN-LINKED] abilities.
stratagems.legend: Confident in the unbeatable protection of their armour and wards, the Terminators rake their foes with mass reactives at perilously close range.

stratagems.name: ABOMINUS-CLASS TARGETS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Eliminating massive priority targets such as diabolical war engines or Warp-tainted monsters is often crucial to victory.

stratagems.name: TRUESILVER WILL
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a Grey Knights Psyker Vehicle unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: The combination of a Grey Knight's psychic fortitude with the warding circuitry of their armoured vehicles is potent indeed.

stratagems.name: ARGENT WRATH
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Grey Knights Vehicle unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect:
Each enemy unit within 3 of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.|
GK|FORCE WAVE|000010361006|Sanctic Spearhead – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|A bow wave of psychic force slams out ahead of this vehicle, ploughing obstacles from its path and forming invisible bridges over yawning chasms.|Your turn|Movement or Charge phase|Sanctic Spearhead|000001084|WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.legend: Blazing with spectral silver flame and surrounded by a keening note of sorcerous dissonance that fills foes with unreasoning terror, this vehicle ploughs into enemy lines like some merciless avatar of destruction.

stratagems.name: SANCTIFIED KILL ZONE
stratagems.rawType: Warpbane Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or, re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a Purifier Squad.
stratagems.legend: As new ground is seized and consecrated, so are the Grey Knights lent greater ferocity and resolve.

stratagems.name: HALLOWED BEACON
stratagems.rawType: Warpbane Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit (excluding Terminator units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Set up your unit wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground and more than 6 horizontally away from all enemy units.|
GK|FIRES OF COVENANT|000009778005|Warpbane Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|As the enemy moves close, these warriors draw upon their pledges of duty and the bonds of their brotherhood to unleash a fiery conflagration of arcane death.|Opponent’s turn|Movement phase|Warpbane Task Force|000000992|WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: Newly sanctified ground serves as a luminescent beacon to guide warded battle-brothers stepping through glowing empyric gateways.

stratagems.name: AEGIS ETERNAL
stratagems.rawType: Warpbane Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: Channelling their shared psychic potential, these warriors form a coruscating aurora that courses through the warding sigils of their armour, causing them to flare with protective power.

stratagems.name: REPELLING SPHERE
stratagems.rawType: Warpbane Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets of that charge, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
stratagems.legend: Chanting a chorus of warding spells, the Grey Knights project a shimmering field of empyric forces that repels their foes.

stratagems.name: FLAMES OF SANCTITY
stratagems.rawType: Warpbane Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Purifier Squad unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6 of your unit, adding 1 to the result if your unit includes Castellan Crowe: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.|
LoV|BASTION RUNNING|000010448003|Brandfast Oathband – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|A Hekaton Land Fortress can be temporarily rigged by its crew for bastion running. They fortify its systems to provide a brief power surge, allowing the tank to smash its way through hostile environments.|Your turn|Movement phase|Brandfast Oathband|000001099|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: As the Purifiers battle, their pooled psychic might manifests in a corona of flame that is anathema to the unclean.

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE EFFICIENCY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Leagues of Votann unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: With the wealth of sensor-wrought information they can access, the Kin can efficiently adapt fighting withdrawals into deadly counterattacks.

stratagems.name: SECURE POSITIONS
stratagems.when: End of any of your phases.
stratagems.target: One Leagues of Votann Transport unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6 of your TRANSPORT. That unit cannot declare a charge in the same turn, but can otherwise act normally in the remainder of the turn.|
LoV|ILLUMINATED PRIORITY|000010448004|Brandfast Oathband – Wargear Stratagem|1|Using specialised beam emission signatures, multispectral ammunition, or broadcasting targeting data, the gunnery crews of Kin war engines can signify priority targets for their comrades.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Brandfast Oathband|000001099|WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a Leagues of Votann Vehicle unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.legend: While there are resources to secure, the Kin will seize any opportunity to effect a rapid and ordered deployment to establish defensive positions.

stratagems.name: WEAVEWËRKE BUTTRESS
stratagems.rawType: Dêlve Assault Shift – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, if units from your army have Hostile Acquisition.
stratagems.target: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Every dêlve is threaded with force fields to shield against catastrophe, a protection that can be tapped in battle to support advances into hostile territory.

stratagems.name: BRËKKEKNOTS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Kâhl, Ûthar the Destined or Einhyr Hearthguard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: These micro shield generators, worked into warrior jewellery or armour crests, trigger on command to provide short-lived boosted protection.

stratagems.name: FURY OF THE HEARTH
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Einhyr Hearthguard unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. If you spend 1YP, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability as well.
stratagems.legend: As though they unleash the raging flames of their kindred’s hearth upon the enemy, the Einhyr all but drown their enemies in fire.

stratagems.name: SUPERIOR CRAFTSMANSHIP
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: Not only are the finest of the Kindred’s warriors selected for this duty, but they are also equipped with the best weaponry and wargear the Brôkhyr can produce.

stratagems.name: UNYIELDING AGGRESSION
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That Leagues of Votann Infantry unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Even should they be compelled to pull back momentarily, the warriors of the Hearthband maintain a punishing curtain of fire to erode the enemy further or rally swiftly and drive back into the fight.

stratagems.name: MATERIALISATION MATRICES
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that is in Reserves and has the Deep Strike ability.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, when your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6 horizontally away from all enemy units.
RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.|
LoV|SURE OF PURPOSE|000009824003|Hearthband – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The single-minded advance of the Kin rolls over collapsing enemy lines and exploits every fault and weakness, driving on towards the objective.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Hearthband|000001001|WHEN: Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Built to a superior standard using secrets imparted by the Votann, the teleporters employed by this Hearthband can stabilise rematerialisation fields remarkably close to the foe.

stratagems.name: GRAND ARTIFICE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Unfazed by deception where it serves a practical use, Kin privateers willingly effect a seemingly ragged retreat only to turn back into the fight from a more advantageous position the moment they are clear of the mire of foes.

stratagems.name: MOBILE EXPLOITATION
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Hernkyn unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Alternatively, you can spend 2YP and target up to two HERNKYN units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units instead.
stratagems.effect: Remove your units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: The Hernkyn of mercenary oathbands are swift to outflank and outmanoeuvre the enemy, seeking avenues by which to punish any vulnerability as well as scouting for new sources of wealth.

stratagems.name: OPTIMAL EXPENDITURE
stratagems.when: The Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If you spent YP during this usage of this Stratagem, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.legend: By expending energy reserves, the Kin’s close-quarter weapons thrum with forgewrought power. The allotment of such resources sees their wielders determined to make every blow strike true.

stratagems.name: PRIVATEER ARSENAL
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If you spent YP during this usage of this Stratagem, you can re-roll the Hit roll and re-roll a Wound roll of 1 instead.
stratagems.legend: Confident their use will turn the tide, the Kin draw on personal caches of munitions, power cells bearing the signatures of acclaimed Brôkhyr or heirloom augurs to unleash a potent fusillade into the foe.

stratagems.name: ANCESTRAL SENTENCE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.
stratagems.legend: Some foes are so loathed that their ancestors are told to pass a sentence upon them. Marked for death, these enemies suffer the undiluted wrath of the Kin.

stratagems.name: HONOUR OF THE HOLD
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2 instead.
stratagems.legend: A kinhost's warriors take great pride in their combat proficiency as a symbol of their hold’s honour. The drive to cleave their foes apart is given greater impetus in pursuit of their kindred's needs.

stratagems.name: HUNTR’S MARK
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
stratagems.legend: Sensor-network calibration tied to the HunTR modules on Kin weaponry can portly automate targeting to ensure the uncompromising judgement of the Votann is carried out without fail.

stratagems.name: ORDERED RETREAT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Not for the Kin the sudden panic of the rout. Instead, they fall back steadily and by squads, laying down suppressing fire while preparing fresh assaults.

stratagems.name: REACTIVE REPRISAL
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, can only target that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
stratagems.legend: Once prizes have been seized, the Kin focus their efforts upon maximising their control and respond with redoubled fury to attempts to loosen their grip.

stratagems.name: VOID HARDENED
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Between their resilient armour and technology and their capacity to stoically endure pain and suffering, the Kin can weather devastating attacks.

stratagems.name: RANGER TACTICS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if that attack targets an assailed unit and/or if your unit has the Hernkyn keyword, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Foes thrown into disarray by the Hernkyn offer a vulnerability that is swiftly exploited.

stratagems.name: FRONTIER MOMENTUM
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Hernkyn unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.|
LoV|EXPOSED FLAWS|000010440004|Persecution Prospect – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Attuned to discerning imperfections in possible resources, Hernkyn soon spot weaknesses in their foes and are just as swift to profit from them.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Persecution Prospect|000001097|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Beyond the frontiers of kindred territory, survival depends upon swiftness of thought and action.

stratagems.name: ADAPTABLE AVARICE
stratagems.when: Start of any phase, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
stratagems.target: One Leagues of Votann Character unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend any number of YP. Once you have done so, if you have 6 or fewer YP, until the start of your next turn, units from your army have Hostile Acquisition instead.
stratagems.legend: When opportunity catches the eye of a prospect's commander, they will readily resume a rapid and aggressive footing.

stratagems.name: CORRIDOR COVERED
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
stratagems.legend: As their allies push forwards, Kin squads train their guns down darkened corridors, preparing to repel unexpected ambushes.

stratagems.name: JUDGED AND PUNISHED
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target has 1 or more Judgement tokens, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if the target has 2 Judgement tokens, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.legend: To draw the ire of the Kin is to invite a swift and brutal death.

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK FIRE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HEARTHKYN WARRIORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.
stratagems.legend: The Kin are well used to working in close confines and can fire their ranged weapons with precision even within the restrictive corridors of a voidship.

stratagems.name: RELIC CYPHER
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Select one closed Hatchway on the battlefield and open it.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.
stratagems.legend: The Kin possess the accumulated knowledge of their ancestors, including ancient cyphers that enable them to seize control of cogitational systems.

stratagems.name: MASKS OF DEATH
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Wreathed in tendrils of transdimensional shadow that intensify their deathly visages, these killing machines evoke such terror that steady aims tremble and blade arms are sapped of strength.

stratagems.name: INSANITY’S IRE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed by the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: To strike down one horror is merely to draw the rest of the pack's insane and murderous focus.

stratagems.name: MURDEROUS REANIMATION
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has just destroyed an enemy unit, or just caused an enemy unit that was not Below Half-strength to become Below Half-strength.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
stratagems.legend: Through some quirk of their kind's shared insanity, a spark of gruesome satisfaction surges through them with every enemy life snuffed out, triggering quiescent power reserves that drive them onwards.

stratagems.name: BLOOD-FUELLED CRUELTY
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Whatever strange afflictions eat away at the sanity of Destroyers and Flayed Ones, mercy is not one of them.

stratagems.name: THE SPOOR OF FRAILTY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your unit makes an attack that targets a unit below Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.legend: Where one foe falls, logic dictates all others must follow. Where blood is shed, ever must more flow.

stratagems.name: PITILESS HUNTERS
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6 instead of up to 3.
stratagems.legend: Driven into a state of hyperaggression, an Annihilation Legion's most eager hunters plunge into their prey's midst to maximise their butchery.

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE HUNGRY VOID
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. In addition, If a Necrons Character is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. (this is not cumulative with any other modifiers that improve Armour Penetration].
stratagems.legend: Necrons strike with data-augmented accuracy.

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE CONQUERING TYRANT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within half range, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll the Hit roll for that attack instead.
stratagems.legend: The legions employ the strategies of their masters in perfect synchronicity, laying down hails of mechanically coordinated fire.

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE ETERNAL REVENANT
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons Infantry Character model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect:
At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with half of its starting number of wounds remaining.
RESTRICTIONS: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.legend: Necron rulers possess enhanced self-repair systems.

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE UNDYING LEGIONS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit activates its Reanimation Protocols and reanimates D3 wounds (or D3+1 wounds if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit].
stratagems.legend: Nanoscarabs are released in boiling black clouds that whirl about the legions and effect rapid repairs

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE SUDDEN STORM
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, if a Necrons Character is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit.
stratagems.legend: Arcing energies leap from one Necron to the next, lending them unnatural speed and surety

stratagems.name: PROTOCOL OF THE VENGEFUL STARS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a NECRONS unit from your army.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 6 of that NECRONS unit when it was destroyed.
stratagems.effect:
After the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.|
NEC|CURSE OF THE CRYPTEK|000008547002|Canoptek Court – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Vindictive Crypteks often hardwire vengeance sub protocols into the ancient cores of their unliving servants, by which a last act of reprisal is assured.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Canoptek Court|000000816|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.legend: Criss-crossfire leaps from the Necron ranks, forming a blazing corona of deadly energy to punish those who dare threaten the indignant nobility's legions.

stratagems.name: COUNTERTEMPORAL SHIFT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18.|
NEC|SUBOPTIMAL FACADE|000008547007|Canoptek Court – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Canoptek constructs use sophisticated metalogic to craft sinister ambushes. Luring the foe in by appearing at suboptimal operation, a surge of reanimation protocols suddenly swells their numbers.|Opponent’s turn|Charge phase|Canoptek Court|000000816|WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.legend: With a twist to the fabric of time, a bubble of another moment enshrouds these constructs. Strange emissions from long-dead elder stars or utter darkness from a nighttime far in the future occludes them from their master’s foes.

stratagems.name: NANOSCARAB VIRUS
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
For each open Hatchway within 3 of your unit, you can close that Hatchway.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.|
NEC|QUANTUM FLARE-SHIELD|000009605003|Canoptek Harvesters – Wargear Stratagem|1|Crypteks enhance their living metal forms with all manner of reactive defences, including single-use quantum shields that flare into life to deflect incoming fire.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Canoptek Harvesters|000000961|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: The Necrons possess swarms of minute nanoscarabs that burrow into power networks and wrest control of cogitator systems.

stratagems.name: POTENTIALITY SYPHON
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Command phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army within range of one or more objective markers.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate. If it is a Cryptek unit, it reanimates an additional 1 wound.
stratagems.legend: Drawing upon the accumulated precausal potential energies that coalesce around significant locations, the conclave are able to steal that power and use it to trigger the unrealized probable remanifestation matrices of their own forces.

stratagems.name: MICROSCARAB SWARM
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Cryptek Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Necron Warriors keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit has the Immortals keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: This thrumming cloud of minute nanoscarabs whirls around the Necrons, affecting instantaneous repairs.

stratagems.name: ANIMUS CURSE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: One Cryptek model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly NECRONS model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: A portion of the Cryptek’s animus clings to the battlefield just long enough to possess their servants and use them to exact revenge.

stratagems.name: METHODICAL MURDER
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
stratagems.legend: In the grip of the Destroyer madness, these Necrons strike and slay with inhuman speed and efficiency.

stratagems.name: IMAGE OF DEATH
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Confronted with these android spectres of terminal mortality, even the most courageous enemies find their aim wavering and their limbs shaking.

stratagems.name: SPREADING MADNESS
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units, add 2 to the Charge roll.
stratagems.legend: It is as though witnessing other Necrons engaged in acts of merciless butchery stokes the Destroyer madness in their fellows.

stratagems.name: DRIVEN TO BUTCHERY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
stratagems.legend: The murderous goad of the Destroyer madness pushes these android killers to seemingly impossible efforts to get to grips with the foe.

stratagems.name: UNNATURAL AGGRESSION
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that is within 6 of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.|
NEC|MORTIS PROTOCOLS|000010669004|Cursed Legion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|In the absolute destruction of their enemies, the corrupted Necrons find fresh purpose and a macabre simulacrum of new life.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Cursed Legion|000001128|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first time a Destroyer Cult unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.
stratagems.legend: The android soldiery of the cursed legion are maddened with the desire to engage and slay their victims at close quarters.

stratagems.name: TERRIFYING AMBUSH
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That DESTROYER CULT unit.
stratagems.effect:
For each enemy unit within 3 of that Hatchway, if that Hatchway is visible to that unit and that unit is wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, that unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result: if failed, until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.|
NEC|BATHED IN BLOOD|000009597002|Deranged Outcasts – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The Destroyer Cults leave only blood, yore and butchered bodies to mark the decks they have taken.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Deranged Outcasts|000000960|WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed by a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army
stratagems.legend: The sudden appearance through a bulkhead or a hatchway of a blood-slick Necron Destroyer is enough to cause the boldest warrior to quiver.

stratagems.name: ANTI-PROXIMAL SUBROUTINES
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.
stratagems.legend: To counter the close-quarters threats in the depths of enemy vessels, Necrons employ firing patterns to scour enemy positions regardless of their proximity.

stratagems.name: DYNAMIC RECONFIGURATION
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One Cryptek unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one of the abilities from the Arcanoscientific Expertise Detachment rule. Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has that ability instead of any others from the Detachment Rule.
stratagems.legend: When a Cryptek's foes threaten to thwart their schemes, rapid reassessment of the situation ensures the most effective technoarcana is employed.

stratagems.name: CONTINUUM REALIGNMENT
stratagems.when: End of your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Cryptek unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3.|
NEC|REANIMATION CRYPTS|000008555004|Hypercrypt Legion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|There is no rest for Necrons who fall in the service of their master. In dark crypts, their bodies are repaired and they are dispatched once more to war.|Your turn|Command phase|Hypercrypt Legion|000000818|WHEN: Your Command phase.
stratagems.legend: Crypteks use strange technologies beyond the ken of other species, and are capable of altering space-time itself to ensure they are exactly where they need to be.

stratagems.name: HYPERPHASIC RECALL
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS INFANTRY unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks and one friendly MONOLITH model.
stratagems.effect:
Remove your INFANTRY unit from the battlefield and then set it back up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6 of your MONOLITH model and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.|
NEC|DIMENSIONAL CORRIDOR|000008555006|Hypercrypt Legion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|2|As the tomb's warriors pass through a dimensional displacement corridor, the passage’s surface is lit with data-glyphs providing hyperlogical tactical information. When they step from an eternity gate, they are already prepared for the hunt.|Your turn|Charge phase|Hypercrypt Legion|000000818|WHEN: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.legend: Obeying recall protocols, threatened tomb defenders will phase out of existence, only to be relocated to a more advantageous position by the tomb's hulking Monoliths.

stratagems.name: SUFFER NO RIVAL
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.legend: Few enemy are worthy of a duel. What dangerous vermin are encountered are prioritised for execution to safeguard the nobles' honour.

stratagems.name: NANOASSEMBLY PROTOCOLS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: A tomb world’s war engines are the pride of its nobility and they will suffer no affront to them, demanding the reassembly of slablike armour atom by atom even as the foe seek to sunder the vehicles.

stratagems.name: ENSLAVED ARTIFICE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.legend: It is not only android soldiery that be compelled to serve. With a command, prized war engines and ornate weapons are empowered to hyperlethality.

stratagems.name: SENTINELS OF ETERNITY
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Lychguard never tire, nor give a thought to their own safety over that of their master. With parrying blows and blocking shots they protect their liege even as they continue to strike down their opponents.

stratagems.name: YOUR TIME IS NIGH
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after your opponent’s WARLORD is destroyed.
stratagems.target: Your NECRONS WARLORD.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, subtract 1 from the result.
stratagems.legend: With a pulse of necroneural energy that erodes the foe’s will, the Necron commander declares the fall of the enemy general, promising their remaining forces that it is only a matter of time until they join their master in ignoble death.

stratagems.name: TERRITORIAL OBSESSION
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Lychguard or Triarch unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. If your unit has the VEHICLE keyword, add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic instead.
stratagems.legend: The ancient and arrogant will of the nobility drives their powerful servants to stand their ground defiantly as they claim the dynasty's rightful lands.

stratagems.name: CHRONODISTORTION
stratagems.rawType: Pantheon of Woe – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if the attacking unit is unravelling: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: With the battlefield shuddering in and out of sync with time and space, slain Necrons still strike at their enemies through cracks in temporal causality

stratagems.name: ENTROPHASIC AURA TARGETING
stratagems.rawType: Pantheon of Woe – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is unravelling, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.
stratagems.legend: Necrons’ android senses can target the foe by reading the exotic radiation signatures wreathed about them by the C’tan shards onslaught.

stratagems.name: MASS TRANSMOGRIFICATION
stratagems.rawType: Pantheon of Woe – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a Necrons Monster unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters) within 6 of that MONSTER unit.
stratagems.effect:
If that enemy unit was unravelling at the start of the phase, your friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.|
NEC|DISHARMONISATION CASCADE|000010673002|Pantheon of Woe – Epic Deed Stratagem|1|Tear one shard suddenly from the complex web of atomic resonances and its severing triggers a violent energistic dissonance blast.|Either player’s turn|Any phase|Pantheon of Woe|000001129|WHEN: Any phase, just after a Necrons Monster model from your army is destroyed, before making its Deadly Demise roll.
stratagems.legend: The power of the C’tan rips the foe’s greatest assets apart and forcibly reknits nearby Necron soldiery using the stolen corporeal matter.

stratagems.name: ENDLESS SERVITUDE
stratagems.when: End of your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monster and Titanic units) from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
stratagems.legend: Should the unclean thralls of lesser species threaten dynastic territories, the fallen Necron soldiery will rise to repel the interlopers.

stratagems.name: DIMENSIONAL TUNNEL
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can move horizontally through models and terrain features.
stratagems.legend: Using phase-shifting technology, Necron war engines can slip into alternate dimensions, leaving only ghostly traces as they move through solid matter.

stratagems.name: CHRONOSHIFT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.|
NEC|DISRUPTION FIELDS|000009589002|Tomb Ship Complement – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Fitted by ingenious Cryptek engineers, disruption fields lend Necron infantry greater killing power.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Tomb Ship Complement|000000959|WHEN: Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: The time-bending technologies in the nobility’s powerful vehicles allow them to traverse the battlefield in stuttering bursts of hypervelocity.

stratagems.name: YOOZ IN TROUBLE NOW
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Battlewagon, Hunta Rig or Kill Rig model from your army that was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: One Orks Infantry unit embarked within your model can disembark and make a Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: models in that unit move a number of inches up to this result, but that unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Spilling from their damaged transport, enraged Orkoid infantry mobs surge towards their attackers.

stratagems.name: IMPERVIOUS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Battlewagon, Kill Rig or Hunta Rig unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Ramshackle though they may appear, Ork vehicles are frighteningly resilient in their construction.

stratagems.name: MOUNT UP, LADZ
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Orks Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and one friendly Transport it is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect:
If your ORKS INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6 of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.|
ORK|HULKING BRUTES|000008886007|Bully Boyz – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|The sheer aggressive contempt advancing Nobz project, not to mention their thick skulls and ‘eavy armour, make them a terrifying prospect for foes desperately trying to gun them down.|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|Bully Boyz|000000857|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: With nothing left to blast or krump, these Orks scramble aboard their transport and thunder towards the next engagement.

stratagems.name: STALKIN’ TAKTIKS
stratagems.rawType: Da Big Hunt – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Beast Snagga Infantry or Beast Snagga Mounted unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack targets your unit, models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack. In addition, if your unit has the INFANTRY keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability.
stratagems.legend: There is no hiding a Beast Snagga stampede, but the more agile amongst the hunters know how to evade the worst of an unsporting prey’s dakka.

stratagems.name: DRAG IT DOWN
stratagems.rawType: Da Big Hunt – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Beast Snagga unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets your Prey, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
stratagems.legend: Beast Snaggas have many tales of the times they took on the biggest prey, clobbering them with so many blows that what was left was a crumpled mass of broken hide and squished innards.

stratagems.name: DAT ONE’S EVEN BIGGA!
stratagems.rawType: Da Big Hunt – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Beast Snagga unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. In addition, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for your unit, provided one of the targets of that charge is your Prey.
stratagems.legend: When bigger prey is sighted, nothing can keep a mob of Beast Snaggas from it. A great hunting chant erupts, and lesser gitz are swiftly forgotten in the enthusiastic impetus to pile into a bigger challenge.

stratagems.name: INSTINCTIVE HUNTERS
stratagems.rawType: Da Big Hunt – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Beast Snagga unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: With a keen eye for tracking their prey, especially kunnin' Beast Snaggas will circle round the hunt site to ambush the luckless gitz from another angle.

stratagems.name: WHERE D’YA FINK YOU’RE GOING?
stratagems.rawType: Da Big Hunt – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Beast Snagga Infantry or Beast Snagga Mounted unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
stratagems.effect:
If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6.|
ORK|UNSTOPPABLE MOMENTUM|000008869003|Da Big Hunt – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Smasha squigs are essentially battering rams on legs. Driven on by the squighogs piling in behind them, they plunge headlong into the foe, trampling one after the next.|Your turn|Charge phase|Da Big Hunt|000000853|WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a Beast Snagga Mounted unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.legend: Beast Snagga victims often make a break for it before the Orks have had their fill of fighting. With a roar, the Orks immediately give chase, or else lose interest and lunge after other potential trophies.

stratagems.name: SUPERFUELLED BOILER
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Orks Walker unit from your army has been selected to Advance.
stratagems.target: That Orks Walker unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
stratagems.legend: By pushing their engines past any sane level, Ork combat walkers can build terrifying momentum.

stratagems.name: BOARDIN’ RUSH
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.|
ORK|BASH AND GRAB|000010713002|Freebooter Krew – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Freebooterz waste no time getting violently stuck into anyone unwise enough to try to keep prized loot out of their grasping claws.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Freebooter Krew|000001138|WHEN: The Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Having cut their gold-plated fangs storming aboard hostile warships, these Freebooterz are good at getting stuck straight into the enemy.

stratagems.name: BULLDOZER BRUTALITY
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Boyz unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to fight, when determining which models in your unit are eligible to fight, any models in your unit that are within 3 of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3 of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.
