stratagems.legend: In the massive fights that Orks enjoy, the only way to ensure a slice of the action is to bludgeon a path through the press to get a hand on the enemy.

stratagems.name: COMPETITIVE STREAK
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Boyz unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit contains 10 or more models, re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.legend: Galvanised by the rest of their mates fighting around them, Orks will redouble their efforts to outdo each other.

stratagems.name: TIDE OF MUSCLE
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Boyz unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, add 1 to the Charge roll and, if your unit contains 10 or more models, you can re-roll the Charge roll.’
stratagems.legend: Once a horde of Orks get a sight of the foe, nothing can stop them.

stratagems.name: COME ON LADZ!
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Boyz unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Return up to D3+2 destroyed models to your unit (excluding Character models).
stratagems.legend: Orks are drawn to conflict and constantly race into battle at the merest hint of violence.

stratagems.name: BRAGGIN’ RIGHTS
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: Two Boyz units from your army that are within 6 of each other.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, while those two units are within 6 of each other, they both count as containing 10 or more models for the purposes of your Detachment rule, any Enhancements models from your army have and any Stratagems you use.
stratagems.legend: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional hurled rock, mobs of Orks bolster each other’s spirits in the most Orky ways possible.

stratagems.name: GO GET ’EM!
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Boyz unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: After the attacking unit has shot, your unit can make a Go Get ’Em! move. To do so, roll one D6: each model in your unit can move a distance in inches up to the result, but your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. If your unit contains 10 or more models, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit can move.
stratagems.legend: Keeping Orks at arm’s length and pummelling them with as much firepower as possible is often the safest tactic for their victims. Unfortunately, it can also draw their attention and give them the urge to re-educate the gitz in the joys of up-close savagery.

stratagems.name: CORNERED AND KRUMPED
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.target: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can fight as if it were the Fight phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.
stratagems.legend: It is no easy thing to disentangle from a mob of ferocious Orks and retreat in good order, especially when cornered by them within the claustrophobic confines of a voidship.

stratagems.name: PIT FIGHTER
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One WARBOSS model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: This Warboss is a terror of the fighting pits, single-mindedly battering his way through lesser foes or simply sweeping them aside as he carves a path towards his true quarry.

stratagems.name: LOOT ON THE MOVE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That ORKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Not only does ripping a door hatch right off its hinges allow for ease of progress, but the resultant large slab of bulletproof metal can make a handy temporary shield.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That ORKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.

stratagems.name: DAKKASTORM
stratagems.rawType: Kult of Speed – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Speed Freeks unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. While targeting a unit within 9, they have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.
RESTRICTIONS: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Blitza Fire Stratagem in the same phase.|
ORK|BLITZA FIRE|000008873005|Kult of Speed – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Fiercely gripping the trigger, with a manic grin as they close on their foes, Speed Freeks fire so many rounds that some just have to find a weak spot.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Kult of Speed|000000854|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Often all an enemy will see of a Kult of Speed is a blur as they speed by, all guns blazing.

stratagems.name: FULL THROTTLE!
stratagems.rawType: Kult of Speed – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That Speed Freeks unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: When racing buggies and warbikes charge at full pelt, the power behind their crews’ assault is so great that they can smash through the enemy.

stratagems.name: MORE GITZ OVER ’ERE!
stratagems.rawType: Kult of Speed – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Speed Freeks unit from your army that is within 9 of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6.
stratagems.legend: Sometimes new targets that emerge are just too juicy to ignore.

stratagems.name: SPEEDIEST FREEKS
stratagems.rawType: Kult of Speed – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit is a VEHICLE unit with an unmodified Toughness characteristic of 8 or less, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save instead.
stratagems.legend: Speed Freeks are often just blurs of vehicular mayhem that prove difficult to land a blow on.

stratagems.name: SQUIG FLINGIN’
stratagems.rawType: Kult of Speed – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit from your army ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That Speed Freeks or Trukk unit.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit within 9 of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, when doing so, subtract 1 from the result.|
ORK|LONG, UNCONTROLLED BURSTS|000009992005|More Dakka! – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|When facing off against sneaky gitz who like to lurk in cover, most Orks believe the most effective strategy is to fire off so many bullets and munitions that something is bound to hit the target.|Your turn|Shooting phase|More Dakka!|000001030|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Speed Freeks live in their vehicles, so it's no surprise to find small squigs lurking in some compartments. A few are vicious, and entertaining, enough to be worth lobbing into nearby enemies to cause anarchy.

stratagems.name: ENRAGED RUSH
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One BOYz unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make an Enraged Rush move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Shooting this mob only serves to attract their attention while simultaneously making them angry at such a blatant attempt to deny them a good punch up.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That ORKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.

stratagems.name: RAMBOYZ RAMPAGE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One BOYz unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced and each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead, until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.|
ORK|EAGER TO FIGHT|000009616004|Ramship Raiders – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Impatient from being bottled up aboard their voidships with no one to clobber, this mob cannot wait to get stuck in to a proper scrap.|Your turn|Movement phase|Ramship Raiders|000000963|WHEN: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone.
stratagems.legend: These ramship-riding Orks emulate the actions of their warship by barrelling full-tilt towards the enemy while roaring like lunatics then crashing into them head-on.

stratagems.name: TAKTIKAL RETREAT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ORKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Blood Axes feel no shame in retreating from a fight, particularly if the boss wants someone else duffed up.

stratagems.name: DAT’S OURS
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.legend: A few Orks, particularly those of the Blood Axe Clan, can resist their destructive urges long enough to prioritise the seizing of objectives.

stratagems.name: ERE WE GO
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Orks Infantry unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Advance and Charge rolls made for your unit.
stratagems.legend: Even Orks can put on a surprising turn of speed when the promise of a good face-to-face fight is in the offing.

stratagems.name: MOB RULE
stratagems.when: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Mob unit from your army that contains 10 or more models and is not Below Half-strength.
stratagems.effect:
Select one friendly Battle-shocked Orks Infantry unit within 6 of that MOB unit. That ORKS INFANTRY unit is no longer Battle-shocked.|
ORK|’ARD AS NAILS|000008366005|War Horde – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Even the lowliest Ork Boy has a toughened hide and a dense skull. While there yet remains the prospect of a git to give a good kicking, it takes a blow of truly phenomenal strength to even give the Ork pause.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|War Horde|000000852|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: The more Orks that gather in one place the more the Waaagh! energy flows, and the more fearless they all become.

stratagems.name: SURVIVOR OF STRIFE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: The fires of war have steeled this Freeblade’s resolve.

stratagems.name: NOBLE SACRIFICE
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+, adding 1 to the result if it is an Armiger unit, instead of only a 6.
stratagems.legend: Sensing their end drawing close, the scion overloads their Knight’s plasma core to take the enemy with them.

stratagems.name: FLANKING MANOEUVRES
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Armiger unit from your army that is within 9 of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.|
QI|POINT‑BLANK BARRAGE|000010756005|Freeblade Company – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Few can withstand the point‑blank fury of a Knight.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Freeblade Company|000001145|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Eager to earn glory, Knight Armigers focus on swiftly redeploying mid‑battle to flank the foe.

stratagems.name: TITANIC BOMBARDMENT
stratagems.rawType: Gate Warden Lance – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that Remained Stationary this turn, that is on your defensive line and that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.
stratagems.legend: Like an imperious artillery captain atop their gatehouse, the Noble directs a deluge of apocalyptic firepower into the enemy's seething tides.

stratagems.name: FORTRESS OF INTIMIDATION
stratagems.rawType: Gate Warden Lance – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that is on your defensive line.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
stratagems.legend: Rising like towering keeps armed with threatening weapons and inscribed with heraldry proclaiming bloody victories in countless campaigns, Imperial Knights are daunting prospects to engage.

stratagems.name: LANCEBREAKER
stratagems.rawType: Gate Warden Lance – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is on your defensive line.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greaterthan the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll
stratagems.legend: With a command, experienced Nobles can lock huge actuators into position, bring reserve power cells into wakefulness and shunt extra shielding into place to make their Knightly steed a bastion of defiance.

stratagems.name: BONDED IMPERATIVE
stratagems.when: Your Command phase, just before an Imperial Knights Character unit from your army uses a Bondsman ability.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect:
When selecting targets for that use of that Bondsman ability, you can select one friendly Adeptus Mechanicus unit within 12 of your unit in addition, or instead of selecting one Armiger model. Until the start of your next Command phase, every model in that ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is affected by that Bondsman ability.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target a Knight Preceptor with this Stratagem.|
QI|VENGEANCE OF THE MACHINE CULT|000009762003|Questor Forgepact – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Those who dare to fell the Machine God’s creations find themselves subject to the vengeance of the Adeptus Mechanicus.|Either player’s turn|Any phase|Questor Forgepact|000000988|WHEN: Any phase.
stratagems.legend: Tapping into the noospheric battle-sphere, this Noble pilot issues binharic commands directly into the minds of Adeptus Mechanicus allies.

stratagems.name: OMNISSIAH’S GRACE
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to an Imperial Knights or Adeptus Mechanicus unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: So resolute is their faith that the Machine God’s worshippers brave storms of killing fire, trusting in the Omnissiah to shield them from harm.

stratagems.name: MACHINE FOCUS
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, your unit
can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: the Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models; any Hit roll or Wound roll made for it.
stratagems.legend: Soothing psalm programs inloaded by Tech-Priests focus targeting arrays and enhance the responsiveness of the Noble pilot’s mighty Knight suit.

stratagems.name: THRONEGHEIST FURY
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that is within 24 of and visible to that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect:
Select one ranged weapon equipped by a model in your unit. That model can shoot at that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). When doing so, that model can only make attacks with that weapon and each time it makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers.|
QI|COURAGEOUS STAND|000010503002|Questoris Companions – Epic Deed Stratagem|1|When the night is long and the unworthy claw at one's shield, it is chivalry and duty that buoy the soul and bolster failing strength.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Questoris Companions|000001108|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: As augurs detect enemy movements, the pilot’s Throne Mechanicum comes alive with the whispered fury of their ancestors. Weapon systems flare instinctively to life, dispensing the hatred of long-dead Nobles upon the unfortunate foe.

stratagems.name: HERO’S TREAD
stratagems.when: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: Your Level of Control over that objective marker is 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.legend: It is said that unalloyed heroism can purge the foulest dishonour, that the very footsteps of those of noblest purity are enough to sanctify their path.

stratagems.name: TITANIC DUEL
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER, TITANIC or WALKER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: The greatest Knightly champions suffer no dishonourable rival to insult them for long with their existence.

stratagems.name: THIN THEIR RANKS
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your ARMIGER models have the [RAPID FIRE 1] ability.
stratagems.legend: A stentorian firing solution floods their Helms Mechanicum, and eager young Nobles shred their master's foes in a blizzard of fury.

stratagems.name: EXEMPLAR’S WISDOM
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model, and one or more friendly Armiger models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: With a fusillade upon their chosen enemy, the Bondsmen's mentor lectures their loyal servants on the application offeree to the foe's weak points.

stratagems.name: VIRTUE OF COURAGE
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: A Knight must have the courage to face the greatest horrors of the galaxy, with duty focusing their blows.

stratagems.name: LET DUTY BE YOUR SHIELD
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Armiger unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking units attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Heeding the teachings of their Noble master, a Bondsman is reminded that only by enduring can they hope to discharge their sworn obligations.

stratagems.name: MANTLE OF THE MENTOR
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your ARMIGER models are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: With a rapid volley of covering fire from a Noble liege, Bondsmen employ hit-and-run tactics at high speed.

stratagems.name: SQUIRES OFTHE HUNT
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effect:
For each of your ARMIGER models that is within 9 of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove that ARMIGER model from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.|
QI|FULL TILT|000010494004|Valourstrike Lance – Battle Tactic Stratagem|2|With their fellows' oaths ringing through the vox-net and the rush of battle coursing through their veins, Noble pilots pour power into their steeds' motive actuators and thunder onwards.|Your turn|Movement phase|Valourstrike Lance|000001106|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: At a ritualised signal, Bondsmen encircle the foe to cut off escape, prowling onto unexpected attack routes.

stratagems.name: THUNDERSTOMP
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights model from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, the Attacks characteristic of any armoured Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 8, the Attacks characteristic of any titanic Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 12, and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.
stratagems.legend: The Noble brings their Knight suit’s weight down with the force of an industrial piledriver, trampling their honourless foes beneath their iron tread.

stratagems.name: VOW OF RETRIBUTION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your models have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
stratagems.legend: With the swearing of cooperative pacts, Knightly companions vow to visit annihilation on their enemies in a searing barrage of retributive firepower.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FOIL
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights model from your army that is within 9 of that unit.
stratagems.effect: Your model can make a Normal move of up to D6.
stratagems.legend: The neural bond through their Throne Mechanicum enables seasoned pilots to accomplish swift counter-monoeuvres seemingly impossible for such towering war engines.

stratagems.name: RUN THEM THROUGH!
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by your models have the [LANCE] ability.
stratagems.legend: With deafening challenges blaring from their emitters, honour-bound comrades slam into their foes, where the Nobles' martial prowess and their Knight suits’ overwhelming power are wedded to overcome the most monstrous resilience.

stratagems.name: ROTATE ION SHIELDS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: Veteran Knight pilots can swiftly re-angle their ion shields and manipulate their energies to deflect incoming firepower.

stratagems.name: MERCILESS FUSILLADE
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army, and up to two friendly War Dog units, that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that is an eligible target for each of those CHAOS KNIGHTS units. Until the end of the phase, each time one of those Chaos Knights units is selected to shoot or fight, if that enemy unit is an eligible target, you can only select that enemy unit as the target for all of those attacks and those attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
stratagems.legend: The scion slaves their servants’ weapons to their own, forming an overwhelming firestorm.

stratagems.name: FLUSH THE QUARRY
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army and up to three friendly War Dog units within 6 of that Titanic Chaos Knights unit.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time one of those War Dog units makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, its models can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, they can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.|
QT|BEASTHIDE MANIFESTATION|000010752004|Helhunt Lance – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|The raw and bestial power of the Warp causes this Chaos Knight to sprout thick mutant scales and layered hide in response to incoming attacks|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Helhunt Lance|000001144|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Urged on by their masters, the War Dogs push hard through the densest terrain.

stratagems.name: CUNNING HUNTER
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a War Dog unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: This War Dog's pilot knows when to feign fight or give ground, only to redouble their attack the moment their prey’s guard drops.

stratagems.name: HARRYING HOUNDS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One War Dog unit from your army that is within 9 of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6.
stratagems.legend: War Dogs fight with agility and guile, giving ground only to surge in on the attack from another angle.

stratagems.name: WRETCHED MASSES
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Damned unit (excluding Accursed Cultists) from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect:
Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle. This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units.
stratagems.legend: In the wake of striding Knights are dragged tides of desperate zealots. No sooner has one horde of baying mortals fallen than another surges forth to take their place.

stratagems.name: SOUL HUNGER
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army has fought.
stratagems.target: That Chaos Knights unit.
stratagems.effect: If one or more models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If one or more models from Battle-shocked units were destroyed as a result of those attacks, your unit regains up to D3+2 lost wounds instead.
stratagems.legend: Daemonic corruption, both physical and spiritual, has debased once noble machines. As the pilots of corrupted Knight suits slaughter mortal victims, their mechanical steed feeds upon stolen life forces and raw fear.

stratagems.name: PRESERVE THE IDOLS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that is within 9 of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect:
Select one Damned unit from your army that is not Battle-shocked, not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is within 6 of your unit. That DAMNED unit can make a Normal move of up to 6, but it must end this move closer to that enemy unit than when it started the move.|
QT|AVENGE THE MASTERS!|000009766002|Iconoclast Fiefdom – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|As the object of their adulation is consumed by fire, mortal worshippers are roused to a desperate fury, seeking vengeance on behalf of their deceased master.|Either player’s turn|Any phase|Iconoclast Fiefdom|000000989|WHEN: Any phase.
stratagems.legend: Driven to preserve their Fallen Noble overlords, masses of mutants, cultists, and corrupted soldiers rush to interpose themselves between their knightly idols and the cursed foe.

stratagems.name: SPITEFUL DEMISE
stratagems.rawType: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: When rolling to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, that model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of a 4+ instead of on a 6.
stratagems.legend: Determined that tales will be told of their spectacular end, the Fallen Noble overloads the internal generators of their Knight suit, hoping to take their enemy with them into oblivion.

stratagems.name: TITANIC DUEL
stratagems.rawType: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that enemy unit is TITANIC, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.legend: The Chaos Knights engage in duels not for honour, but to assert their absolute dominance over the battlefield.

stratagems.name: RUNES OF DISDAIN
stratagems.rawType: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: Inscribed into the Knight suit’s servo-skeleton, these markings channel the pilot’s contempt for the foe and manifest it as a sorcerous aura of defence.

stratagems.name: CLAIMED FOR THE DARK GODS
stratagems.rawType: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control, with a Level of Control of 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.legend: The Fallen Noble dedicates their latest conquest to the Dark Gods in hope of reward.

stratagems.name: CRUSHED LIKE VERMIN
stratagems.rawType: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army ends a Normal move.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that your unit moved over during that move and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If one or more models are destroyed as a result of this Stratagem, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.legend: Screaming enemy warriors are crushed to gory paste as the Chaos Knight tramples spitefully through their midst, stamping and raking these unworthy foes with its huge, taloned feet.

stratagems.name: TROPHY HUNTER
stratagems.rawType: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army consolidates.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3 as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.|
QT|CONQUERORS WITHOUT MERCY|000008517003|Traitoris Lance – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Chaos Knights leave only death and devastation in their wake, and reduce entire worlds to ruin.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Traitoris Lance|000000806|WHEN: Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: To these Fallen Nobles, each new foe chased down is another opportunity to claim gory trophies.

stratagems.name: IMPERIOUS ADVANCE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two War Dog units from your army or one Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless it made a Charge move, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed (the Super-heavy Walker ability does not apply while using this Stratagem).
stratagems.legend: Employing piloting skill or brute force, Fallen Nobles can either manoeuvre or simply barge their steeds through foes and obstacles alike.

stratagems.name: DISDAIN FOR THE WEAK
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.
stratagems.legend: Fallen Nobles sneer at the pathetic efforts of their foes, doubly so in the case of those who fear them.

stratagems.name: STORM OF DARKNESS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability, and each time an attack targets your unit, models in it have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.
stratagems.legend: Through dark rituals and dread pacts, the Chaos Knights draw upon the fear and despair of their foes and bind it into a curse upon the land itself, wreathing themselves in a shrouding pall.

stratagems.name: A LONG LEASH
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Abhorrent unit from your army and up to two friendly War Dog units.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, those WAR DOG units are treated as being within range of any Aura abilities your ABHORRENT unit has.
stratagems.legend: The neural connections between Fallen Nobles and doggedly loyal or fearful War Dog pilots can extend over remarkable distances.

stratagems.name: PTERRORSHADES
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that is within 12 of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect:
Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound and one model in your unit regains up to 1 lost wound.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.|
SM|HEROES OF THE CHAPTER|000008495003|1st Company Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|When the fighting is at its fiercest, the veteran warriors of the Chapter truly show their quality.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|1st Company Task Force|000000798|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Shrieking with hunger, Pterrorshades descend in a whirlwind to feast on the fearful souls of the foe. Their banquet transmutes into vital energy that flows into the Chaos Knight on which they roost.

stratagems.name: DUTY AND HONOUR
stratagems.rawType: 1st Company Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
stratagems.legend: Adeptus Astartes veterans claim critical objectives in daring strikes, annihilating resistance in their Chapter’s name before sweeping onto their next target.

stratagems.name: FOCUSED FURY
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a Character unit, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [LANCE] ability as well.
stratagems.legend: Keeping the beast within under tight control, the Blood Angels nonetheless tap into that inner rage and shackle it to their precisely aimed blows.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes, combined with their transhuman physiology, makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: IN THE SHADOW OF GREAT WINGS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18.|
SM|INSTANT OF GRACE|000009836004|Angelic Inheritors – Epic Deed Stratagem|1|In this most desperate moment of need, a lone battle-brother rises to the challenge as a true inheritor of the Angel’s legacy.|Your turn|Command phase|Angelic Inheritors|000001004|WHEN: Your Command phase.
stratagems.legend: The enemy is engulfed in a soul-deep shadow for just a moment, as though mighty wings have spread above them and marred their vision with occluding darkness.

stratagems.name: PURGATION DOCTRINE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll (if your unit disembarked from a Heavy Transport this turn, add 1 to the Wound roll as well).
stratagems.legend: Emerging from their transports, Space Marine infantry ruthlessly clear enemy positions.

stratagems.name: MACHINE WRATH
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a Heavy Transport unit from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That HEAVY TRANSPORT unit, if you rolled a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved, and before any embarked units perform an Emergency Disembarkation. When making this move, your unit can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) and can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
stratagems.legend: In a last act of vengeance, the doomed crew of this burning transport drive into the midst of the enemy.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: ADVANCED DEPLOYMENT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Transport unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, units can disembark from your TRANSPORT after it has Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move this phase, and cannot declare a charge in the same turn (unless your TRANSPORT has the Assault Ramp ability), but can otherwise act normally.
stratagems.legend: Coaxing the utmost from roaring engines, transport crews strive to deploy their passengers as close as possible to their assigned objectives.

stratagems.name: CERAMITE SLEDGEHAMMER
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Transport unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features. In addition, if your unit is a Heavy Transport, when making this move, your unit can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) and can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
stratagems.legend: The mightiest Space Marine transports are unstoppable on the advance.

stratagems.name: RAPID EMBARKATION
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and one friendly Heavy Transport it is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect:
If your ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6 of that HEAVY TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.|
SM|CODEX DISCIPLINE|000010677002|Bastion Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Holding to the teachings of the Codex Astartes, these warriors unleash disciplined volleys of firepower.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Bastion Task Force|000001130|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: With steely discipline, Space Marine battle-brothers mount up swiftly, even as the enemy closes in.

stratagems.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.rawType: Black Spear Task Force – Wargear Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Kill Team unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.
stratagems.legend: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.rawType: Blade of Ultramar – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: COURAGE AND HONOUR!
stratagems.rawType: Blade of Ultramar – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.
stratagems.legend: Roaring their famed battle cry, the Ultramarines hurl themselves into the fight, striving all the harder to prevail beneath the unwavering eye of their Chapter Master.

stratagems.name: EXEMPLARY VIGILANCE
stratagems.rawType: Blade of Ultramar – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.
stratagems.legend: Long have the Ultramarines guarded both Ultramar and the wider Imperium. No foe can hide from their vengeful gaze or evade the reach of their wrath.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FORESIGHT
stratagems.rawType: Blade of Ultramar – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: With the enemy’s countermeasures and responses predicted and allowed for in advance, the Ultramarines can weather their most ferocious attacks.

stratagems.name: ULTRAMARIAN ADAPTIVITY
stratagems.rawType: Blade of Ultramar – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select the Devastator Doctrine, Tactical Doctrine or Assault Doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active for your unit instead of any other Combat Doctrine that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that Combat Doctrine this battle.
stratagems.legend: No Chapter’s warriors know better the breadth – theoretical and practical – of the Codex Astartes’ teachings, and how these can and should be adapted to ensure victory.

stratagems.name: PRACTICAL TACTICS
stratagems.rawType: Blade of Ultramar – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is within 9 of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6, or a Normal move of up to 6 instead if it is under the effects of the Tactical Doctrine.|
SM|IN THE EMPEROR’S NAME|000009241002|Boarding Strike – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Space Marines will suffer any hardship and endure the savagery of the most monstrous foes to see their duty done.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Boarding Strike|000000905|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: After rapidly making a theoretical assessment of the foes’ probable next moves, the Ultramarines apply practical repositioning to counter them.

stratagems.name: CHILLING HOWL
stratagems.rawType: Champions of Fenris – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Each enemy unit within 6 of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if that unit is Below Half-strength.|
SM|STALKING WOLVES|000009852006|Champions of Fenris – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|These veteran warriors approach the foe like wolves on the hunt. They are ever-poised to drop into cover or fade into the shadows to avoid their prey’s increasingly desperate attempts to drive them of|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|Champions of Fenris|000001008|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Raising their feral voices as one, the elite champions of Fenris give voice to a predatory howl fit to freeze the marrow of the bravest warriors.

stratagems.name: DREAD CRUSADERS
stratagems.rawType: Companions of Vehemence – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
stratagems.legend: To face the Emperor's transhuman crusaders as they chant their litanies of detestation can chill the soul.

stratagems.name: DEATH ON THE WIND
stratagems.rawType: Company Of Hunters – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Ravenwing unit from your army that has just shot.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, if one or more RAVENWING units from your army are within 6 of that enemy unit, subtract 1 from the test.|
SM|ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT|000008779003|Company Of Hunters – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Company of Hunters|000000836|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: The Ravenwing employ shock tactics and focussed firepower to tear bloody paths through the enemy ranks, shattering resistance and clearing the way to their true quarry.

stratagems.name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
stratagems.rawType: Firestorm Assault Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets the closest eligible target within 6, add 1 to the Wound roll.|
SM|IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS|000008483005|Firestorm Assault Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem|2|Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Firestorm Assault Force|000000795|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets the closest eligible target within 6, add 1 to the Wound roll.|
SM|IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS|000010369005|Forgefather’s Seekers – Battle Tactic Stratagem|2|Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Forgefather’s Seekers|000001086|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.

stratagems.name: HONOUR THE CHAPTER
stratagems.rawType: Gladius Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.
stratagems.legend: Every Chapter has forged its own tales of heroism, and none of its battle-brothers would see that noble record besmirched.

stratagems.name: STORM OF FIRE
stratagems.rawType: Gladius Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.
stratagems.legend: There is no escaping the wrath of the Space Marines, and they use their weapons to bring swift death to their foes wherever they may hide.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.rawType: Gladius Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: ONLY IN DEATH DOES DUTY END
stratagems.rawType: Gladius Task Force – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Imminent death does not prevent a Space Marine from enacting his final justice upon the enemies of the Imperium.

stratagems.name: SQUAD TACTICS
stratagems.rawType: Gladius Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is within 9 of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6, or a Normal move of up to 6 instead if it is under the effects of the Tactical Doctrine.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.|
SM|ADAPTIVE STRATEGY|000008352005|Gladius Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The tenets of the Codex Astartes allow for unorthodox use of combat tactics and the employment of divergent strategic doctrines if doing so will lead to victory.|Your turn|Command phase|Gladius Task Force|000000750|WHEN: Your Command phase.
stratagems.legend: Space Marines know precisely when to give ground in order to leave their enemies floundering, before surging back into the fight and driving them from the field in disarray.

stratagems.name: FOCUSED HATRED
stratagems.rawType: Godhammer Assault Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after you make a Charge roll for an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Charge move, models in your unit can move through models (when doing so, its models can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but they can only end that move within Engagement Range of enemy models if those enemy models belong to a unit that your unit declared a charge against this turn).
stratagems.legend: Surging from assault ramps, the Black Templars let none bar them from the most unholy threats, using their armoured might to bludgeon a path into battle.

stratagems.name: UNCOMPROMISING EGRESS
stratagems.rawType: Godhammer Assault Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Land Raider model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within your LAND RAIDER can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6 of your LAND RAIDER and can be set up within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.|
SM|GAUNTLET OF THE GOD-EMPEROR|000010401004|Godhammer Assault Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Like the mailed fist of the Master of Mankind, the crusade's armoured battle tanks, transports and combat walkers smash their way through choked war zones to reach those deserving execution.|Your turn|Movement phase|Godhammer Assault Force|000001093|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: Little can threaten to overwhelm the venerable Land Raider. Its multiple, hydraulically augmented assault ramps slam into closing aggressors, enabling its deadly cargo to deploy quickly.

stratagems.name: UNBOWED CONVICTION
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).
stratagems.legend: Space Marines exemplify obdurate tenacity. Even injured, they will never abandon their oaths.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and when making such an attack, if the attacking model is a VEHICLE, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.legend: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.

stratagems.name: VENGEFUL ANIMUS
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.
stratagems.legend: Carefully cogitated binharic prayers can focus a machine spirit’s ire into near-obsessive hatred of its slayers, ensuring that vengeance is meted out even in death.

stratagems.name: ANCIENT FURY
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES WALKER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, improve your model’s Move, Toughness, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics by 1 and each time your model makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: The heroes entombed within Dreadnoughts have fought across countless war zones throughout their extended existences, perfecting their martial prowess beyond mortal limits.

stratagems.name: POWER OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army that was reduced to Below Half-strength as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
stratagems.legend: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crew of their vehicle are slain and critical systems are failing.

stratagems.name: SAVAGE ECHOES
stratagems.rawType: Liberator Assault Group – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was just charged by an enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Select either the Strength or Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the selected characteristic. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
stratagems.legend: The Sons of Sanguinius may embrace the Red Thirst but for a moment, if the need arises.

stratagems.name: RED RAMPAGE
stratagems.rawType: Liberator Assault Group – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LANCE] or [LETHAL HITS] abilities. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, then it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] and [LETHAL HITS] abilities.
stratagems.legend: In times of great desperation, fury and ferocity can be a warrior's strongest allies.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.rawType: Liberator Assault Group – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: ANGELIC GRACE
stratagems.rawType: Liberator Assault Group – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army has a mortal wound allocated to it.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: Sanguinius' sons are blessed with the spiritual fortitude of their Primarch.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.rawType: Liberator Assault Group – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge even though it Fell Back. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge, even though it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: When Blood Angels execute a tactical withdrawal it is but a prelude to a renewed assault.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.rawType: Liberator Assault Group – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army has Advanced.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge, even though it Advanced. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge, even though it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: The Blood Angels enact a sweeping advance.

stratagems.name: SENSORY ASSAULT
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Psyker unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit that is within 18 of and visible to one PSYKER model in your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit’s Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it. In addition, if the Telepathy Discipline is active for your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.|
SM|ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT|000009791003|Librarius Conclave – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Librarius Conclave|000000994|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Paranoia, confusion and panic are heightened to a debilitating degree as the Librarian alters his foes’ perceptions.

stratagems.name: IRON ARM
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that is within 18 of one or more Adeptus Astartes Psyker models from your army and has not been selected to Fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, or add 2 if the Biomancy Discipline is active for your army.|
SM|FIERY SHIELD|000009791004|Librarius Conclave – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|As the enemy closes in for the kill, the psyker manifests his psychic will in a raging inferno that obscures imperilled allies and threatens to immolate any who come close enough to land a blow upon them.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Librarius Conclave|000000994|WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: This Librarian lends skull-shattering weight and impact to melee strikes by transmuting flesh into unyielding metal.

stratagems.name: STRENGTH IN UNITY
stratagems.rawType: Lion’s Blade Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect:
If that enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more Ravenwing units from your army, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more Deathwing units from your army, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of the target, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
RESTRICTIONS: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Armour of Contempt Stratagem in the same phase.
stratagems.legend: Combining their specialised methods of warfare, the Ravenwing and Deathwing confound their enemies with high‑speed manoeuvrability and stalwart fortitude.

stratagems.name: ILLUMINATING FIRE
stratagems.rawType: Lion’s Blade Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a RAVENWING unit from your army has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: That Ravenwing unit.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit within 12 of your unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly Deathwing unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.|
SM|ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT|000009734003|Lion’s Blade Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their transhuman physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Lion’s Blade Task Force|000000981|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Ravenwing vehicles tear across the battlefield, identifying priority threats and targeting them with volleys of killing fire. The storm of blazing fury serves as a beacon for the wrathful battle‑brothers of the Inner Circle, who strive to bring final judgement to the foe.

stratagems.name: KNIGHTS OF IRON
stratagems.rawType: Lion’s Blade Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Ravenwing unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.legend: Atop their snarling mechanical steeds, the warriors of the Ravenwing surge through seemingly impassable terrain, smashing through rubble and ruin to unleash the wrath of the Unforgiven upon unsuspecting targets.

stratagems.name: OVERPOWERING EXACTION
stratagems.rawType: Lion’s Blade Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Command phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, if your unit has the Deathwing or Ravenwing keyword, subtract 1 from the result.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
stratagems.legend: Engines roar, and teleportation flares erupt across the battlefield. Such is the din and ferocity of the Dark Angels’ assault that even the most veteran foes are given cause to cower before it.

stratagems.name: AUTO‑SENSE COORDINATION
stratagems.rawType: Orbital Assault Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Select the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have this ability in a turn in which they disembarked from a Drop Pod or while targeting an enemy unit within 12.|
SM|TACTICAL DECAPITATION|000010681003|Orbital Assault Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|By rapidly eliminating localised enemy leaders, the Space Marines keep the foe off balance and hamper organised resistance to their onslaught.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Orbital Assault Force|000001131|WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: By binding the datafeeds from their auto-senses, these battle-brothers generate triangulated targeting solutions for close-quarters fire spreads.

stratagems.name: BLIND SCREEN
stratagems.rawType: Orbital Assault Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and one friendly Adeptus Astartes Smoke Vehicle or Drop Pod unit within 9 of it.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, models in your units have the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets one of your units, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.|
