SM|SHOCK ONSLAUGHT|000010681004|Orbital Assault Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The sheer devastating momentum of a Space Marine drop assault shatters one enemy battle line after another.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Orbital Assault Force|000001131|WHEN: Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Autolaunchers spit a precogitated spread of blind grenades to baffle organic and mechanical targeting.

stratagems.name: KNIFE WORK
stratagems.rawType: Pilum Strike Team – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
stratagems.legend: These warriors strike at their enemies'weak spots, aiming to silence the foe without raising the alarm.

stratagems.name: MASTER MARKSMEN
stratagems.rawType: Pilum Strike Team – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
stratagems.legend: Every shot these warriors fire is placed for maximum impact and swift, decisive kills.

stratagems.name: FIGHTING RETREAT
stratagems.rawType: Pilum Strike Team – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: These warriors employ cover fire and frag charges to batter the foe as they fall back to new positions.

stratagems.name: ENHANCED EFFICIENCY
stratagems.rawType: Pilum Strike Team – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, it can attempt to operate one Hatchway it is within 1” of either at the start or end of that move. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.
stratagems.legend: Moving with alacrity, clearing each new space with exceptional speed and skill, the warriors of the strike team advance on their main objective.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes, combined with their transhuman physiology, makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: A GRIM WARNING
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Blood Angels unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.legend: So savagely butchered are the corpses left strewn by the Blood Angels that the mere sight of them gives the enemy pause.

stratagems.name: DEATHLESS DUTY
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Death Company unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Even as death at last smothers the inferno of fury consuming the minds of these lost brethren, they keep killing, until not even the faintest spark remains.

stratagems.name: LIMB FROM LIMB
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.
stratagems.effect: Select either the Strength or Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the selected characteristic. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it), and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
stratagems.legend: While the Blood Angels display skill and discipline at close quarters, it is tinged with a blood-drenched brutality that only increases with their building rage.

stratagems.name: RED WRATH
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it), and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: Already swift and aggressive even by Space Marine standards, the Blood Angels can enhance their might yet further by surrendering temporarily to the Red Thirst, albeit at the cost of higher strategic thought.

stratagems.name: INSENSATE RAMPAGE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Death Company unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
stratagems.legend: The agony of even the most catastrophic wounds means nothing to the warriors of the Death Company, pain finding no purchase on their maddened minds.

stratagems.name: FURIOUS DEDICATION
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not declared a charge or been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Charge rolls made for your unit and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.
stratagems.legend: Cold fury of purpose drives the charge of the Space Marines, their absolute dedication to their cause lending them ferocious speed and strength.

stratagems.name: FIGHT TO THE END
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Those who have sworn an oath to see Ultramar reclaimed will not yield a single yard of its territories once they have seized and secured them.

stratagems.name: CRUSADING CONQUERORS
stratagems.when: End of the Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.legend: The sheer will of these battle-brothers to reclaim the sacred Five Hundred Worlds is overwhelming.

stratagems.name: SCIONS OF GUILLIMAN
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army ends a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: The gene-sons of Roboute Guilliman are masters of his tenets, regardless of which Chapter they hail from.

stratagems.name: ULTRAMARIAN DESTINY
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.legend: All those Space Marines fighting to defend or to expand the Ultramarines stellar realm trust that their conquest – though it must be hard fought for – is nothing short of ordained by the Primarch’s will.

stratagems.name: MARCHING EVER ON
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1.|
SM|UNBRIDLED FEROCITY|000010270002|Saga of the Beastslayer – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|The Space Wolves fight with a savage fury that enables them to overcome even the most resilient targets.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Saga of the Beastslayer|000001070|WHEN: Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: The road to the complete rebuilding of the Five Hundred Worlds will be a long and gruelling one, and those who fight their way along it cannot pause in their advance for even a moment.

stratagems.name: SHOCK CAVALRY
stratagems.rawType: Saga of the Beastslayer – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Thunderwolf Cavalry unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4 or less in height. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but unless it is making a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.|
SM|COORDINATED STRIKE|000010270007|Saga of the Beastslayer – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Space Wolves officers rein in their warriors’ impulsive fury, repositioning them to strike exposed flanks.|Opponent’s turn|Fight phase|Saga of the Beastslayer|000001070|WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Thunderwolf Cavalry bound through friend and foe, leaping over obstacles in pursuit of their foes.

stratagems.name: IMPETUOSITY
stratagems.rawType: Saga of the Beastslayer – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Wulfen Infantry or Blood Claws unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, after that enemy unit has shot, if one or more models in your unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, your unit can make an Impetuous move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a number of inches up to the result, but your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Severe losses only drive Blood Claws and Wulfen forward into the midst of the foe.

stratagems.name: THUNDEROUS PURSUIT
stratagems.rawType: Saga of the Beastslayer – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within 9 of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6. If your unit has the Space Wolves Infantry or Thunderwolf Cavalry keywords, it can make a Normal move of up to 6 instead.|
SM|INSPIRING PRESENCE|000010266002|Saga of the Bold – Epic Deed Stratagem|1|The inspiring presence of a champion lends their pack's strikes lethal impetus.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Saga of the Bold|000001069|WHEN: Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: The relentless endurance of thunderwolf steeds enables the Space Wolves to run down fleeing foes.

stratagems.name: CHAMPION’S GUIDANCE
stratagems.rawType: Saga of the Bold – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Space Wolves Character unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: A paragon of Fenrisian savagery, this champion guides his warriors with confidence and precision.

stratagems.name: BIRTH OF A SAGA
stratagems.rawType: Saga of the Bold – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Wolf Guard Headtaker or Wolf Guard Terminator Pack Leader model from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Until the start of your next Command phase, your model has the CHARACTER keyword.
Designer’s Note: While in effect, your model’s unit is therefore a CHARACTER unit, meaning it can interact with the Heroes All rule, in addition to other rules that interact with CHARACTER units.
stratagems.legend: Heroes are forged in the heat of battle, rising from obscurity to become the warriors of epic sagas.

stratagems.name: ALPHA STRIKE
stratagems.rawType: Saga of the Bold – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: A true alpha wolf leads by example, and is always first into the fray.

stratagems.name: GRIMNAR’S COMMAND
stratagems.rawType: Saga of the Great Wolf – Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one Hunting Pack from the Master of Wolves Detachment rule. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Hunting Pack is active for your unit instead of any other Hunting Pack that is active, even if you have already selected that Hunting Pack this battle.
stratagems.legend: Pivotal as they are to the Great Wolf’s plans, this pack have their own orders to fulfil in this moment that come directly from Grimnar himself.

stratagems.name: EYE OF THE PACK
stratagems.rawType: Saga of the Great Wolf – Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Once one Fenrisian warrior has perceived some slight weakness in the defences of their foes, they all strike at it like encircling predators dragging down prey.

stratagems.name: BATTLE INSTINCTS
stratagems.rawType: Saga of the Great Wolf – Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Space Wolves unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6.|
SM|THE FOE FORESEEN|000010661002|Saga of the Great Wolf – Stratagem|1|With his great strategic wisdom, Grimnar predicted the peril these warriors would encounter and warned them to be ready for it.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Saga of the Great Wolf|000001126|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: These champions of Fenris respond to enemy fire with instinctive swiftness, rarely giving their foes a second chance to shoot at them.

stratagems.name: LAY LOW THE TYRANTS
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.legend: In a storm of blade thrusts and bludgeoning strikes, enemy champions and commanders are laid low, leaving their troops in leaderless disarray.

stratagems.name: STUNNING FUSILLADE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit that is more than 12 away, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.|
SM|ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT|000010467002|Shadowmark Talon – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Shadowmark Talon|000001104|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: From darkness and obscuring cover, Raven Guard battle-brothers open fire as one, striking their unaware targets with precision fire.

stratagems.name: CODEX WARFARE
stratagems.rawType: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: The Codex Astartes is held as a hallowed work of martial genius by the Shield Chapters. Its tenets prescribe tactical adaptability and fighting on the move, advancing from one adversary to the next in a series of deadly redeployments.

stratagems.name: OVERCHARGED BREACH
stratagems.rawType: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
Select one closed Hatchway within 9 of and visible to your unit. Open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once.|
SM|EVASIVE MANOEUVRES|000010630006|Spearpoint Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Battle-brothers of the White Scars Chapter are born and raised in the saddle. Expert pilots and riders all, they weave through incoming fire with instinctive skill.|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|Spearpoint Task Force|000001119|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: With a well-placed volley of high-powered ammunition or a dedicated melta charge, specially equipped Space Marines can effect a permanent access route.

stratagems.name: CARVE A PATH
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Terminator Assault Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1 of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.|
SM|ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT|000009191003|The Angelic Host – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their enhanced physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|The Angelic Host|000000901|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.legend: Power fists, chainfists, and sheer servo-actuated armoured mass ensure that Terminators’ paths are never barred for long.

stratagems.name: FURIOUS ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.rawType: The Lost Brethren – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Death Company unit from your army, just before that unit Piles-in.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3 instead of up to 3. If your unit is within 12 of one or more friendly Chaplain models, or if it is below Starting Strength, it can move up to 6 instead. In either case, it can only do so provided your unit ends that Pile-in move in Unit Coherency and within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.legend: The Lost push towards new foes, the bloodlust in their veins enhancing their preternatural speed.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.rawType: The Lost Brethren – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their enhanced physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: LOST TO RAGE
stratagems.rawType: The Lost Brethren – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Death Company unit from your army that is below Starting Strength and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks, Stength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and, unless your unit is within 12 of one or more friendly Chaplain models, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.|
SM|GLORIOUS SACRIFICE|000009187002|The Lost Brethren – Epic Deed Stratagem|1|Even in death, the Lost bring victory to their Chapter.|Either player’s turn|Any phase|The Lost Brethren|000000900|WHEN: Any phase.
stratagems.legend: The Lost are consumed utterly by rage.

stratagems.name: WRATHFUL RAMPAGE
stratagems.rawType: The Lost Brethren – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Death Company unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That DEATH COMPANY unit.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit is within 12 of one or more friendly Chaplain models, or it is below its Starting Strength, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.|
SM|UNBREAKABLE LINES|000008389007|Unforgiven Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem|2|Countless assaults have faltered against the unbreakable ceramite wall that is the Unforgiven standing their ground.|Opponent’s turn|Charge phase|Unforgiven Task Force|000000834|WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.legend: So lost to rage are the Death Company that they surge unstoppably into battle, eagerly outpacing their brothers.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: SURGICAL STRIKES
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.legend: Every tyrant must fear the assassin's blade, and the vanguard spring ambushes with precision coordination.

stratagems.name: CALCULATED FEINT
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6, or up to 6 instead if it is a PHOBOS or ScouT SQUAD unit.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.legend: A feigned retreat can be used to overextend eager foes or draw them into deadly arcs of fire.

stratagems.name: GUERRILLA TACTICS
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two PHOBOS and/or SCOUT SQUAD units from your army, or one other ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
RESTRICTIONS: Each unit selected for this Stratagem must be more than 3 away from all enemy models.|
SM|A DEADLY PRIZE|000008491002|Vanguard Spearhead – Wargear Stratagem|1|Warriors of a Vanguard Spearhead will rig critical objectives with explosives to deny them to the enemy.|Either player’s turn|Command phase|Vanguard Spearhead|000000797|WHEN: Start of the Command phase.
stratagems.legend: At the opportune moment, Space Marine infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.

stratagems.name: RECITATION OF THE REVERED
stratagems.rawType: Vindication Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Ancient unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: The Ancient leads a deafening recital of his banner's honours, the projected chant's zeal shaking the foe.

stratagems.name: RECLAIM OUR HONOUR!
stratagems.rawType: Vindication Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys an Ancient model from your army that has not been targeted with the Refusal to Yield Stratagem this phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army visible to that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the battle, each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target that ANCIENT model with the Refusal to Yield Stratagem this phase.
stratagems.legend: The sacred standards of a crusade embody its warriors' honour, and no one would see them lost.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.rawType: Wrath of the Rock – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their transhuman physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

stratagems.name: INESCAPABLE JUSTICE
stratagems.rawType: Wrath of the Rock – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after your Oath of Moment target is destroyed.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit within 12 and visible to your unit. That enemy unit becomes your Oath of Moment target until the start of your next Command phase.|
SM|TACTICAL MASTERY|000010161005|Wrath of the Rock – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|When the constituent elements of the Dark Angels fight as one, the enemy is often overwhelmed and torn apart by the fluidity of the Chapter’s rapid advances, tactical withdrawals and unexpected counteroffensives.|Your turn|Movement phase|Wrath of the Rock|000001059|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: The Dark Angels pursue their enemies relentlessly, eliminating one with ruthless precision before turning to the next.

stratagems.name: INTERLOCKING MANOUEVRES
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect:
If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move. It cannot embark within a Transport at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.|
TAU|PHEROMONE WAYPOINTS|000009840005|Auxiliary Cadre – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Air caste craft have dropped drones that emit pheromones into this region, their emissions invisible but blazing like beacons to the correct alien senses.|Your turn|Movement phase|Auxiliary Cadre|000001005|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: Regular Fire caste forces operating as part of auxiliary cadres are well trained in swift repositioning and fighting retreats, the better to exploit the presence of or provide support for their alien comrades.

stratagems.name: EXPERIMENTAL MODIFICATIONS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
stratagems.legend: These experimental Earth caste weapon upgrades can only activate for short bursts at a time, but the extra stopping power they provide is formidable.

stratagems.name: EXPERIMENTAL WEAPONRY
stratagems.rawType: Experimental Prototype Cadre – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you roll one or more dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in your unit, you can re-roll the result.
stratagems.legend: T’au scientists have distributed the latest prototype weapons amongst this cadre’s contingents, all optimised to increase reliability and accuracy.

stratagems.name: REACTIVE IMPACT DAMPENERS
stratagems.rawType: Experimental Prototype Cadre – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One T’au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Advancements in battlesuit field technology include the addition of autoreactive shield dampers to absorb and dissipate the energy from high-velocity kinetic strikes.

stratagems.name: AUTOMATED REPAIR DRONES
stratagems.rawType: Experimental Prototype Cadre – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One T’au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one BATTLESUIT model in your unit: that model regains up to D3+1 lost wounds.
stratagems.legend: Much research is being placed into deploying miniaturised drones to affect battlefield repairs and dispense emergency medical treatments in combat.

stratagems.name: NEUROWEB SYSTEM JAMMER
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One T’au Empire Crisis unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18.|
TAU|EXPERIMENTAL AMMUNITION|000009984005|Experimental Prototype Cadre – Wargear Stratagem|1|From hardened warheads and amplified ion capacitors, to hyperaccelerated pulse fields and refined fusion cores, the T’au are forever innovating improvements to improve the lethality of their ammunition.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Experimental Prototype Cadre|000001028|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: This prototype countermeasure device emits an intense neurostatic jamming field, scrambling the enemy’s senses and fouling their aim.

stratagems.name: PHOTON GRENADES
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One T’au Empire Grenades unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test, and until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Hurling a volley of photon grenades, the T’au leave their enemies dazzled and disorientated, unable to close the distance into combat at a crucial moment.

stratagems.name: COMBAT EMBARKATION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.target: One T’au Empire Infantry unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge, and one friendly Transport.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT. If it does, your opponent can select new targets for that charge.
RESTRICTIONS: Every model in your T’AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit must be within 3 of that TRANSPORT and there must be sufficient transport capacity to embark the entire unit.|
TAU|JOIN THE HUNT|000008822002|Kroot Hunting Pack – Battle Tactic Stratagem|2|When a Kroot Hunting Pack closes in on its prey, there are often other hunters waiting to join in the fray and take their share of any spoils.|Either player’s turn|Any phase|Kroot Hunting Pack|000000847|WHEN: Any phase.
stratagems.legend: Those who act as the lure in the Kauyon must be ready to make a hasty withdrawal once the enemy closes into killing range, lest they be trapped.

stratagems.name: GUERRILLA WARRIORS
stratagems.rawType: Kroot Hunting Pack – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Kroot unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That KROOT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge.
stratagems.legend: Kroot see no value in stand-up fights, caring little for honour or glory. They hit and fade, frustrating their foes and bleeding them by degrees until - weakened and out of position - they are rendered vulnerable.

stratagems.name: HIDDEN HUNTERS
stratagems.rawType: Kroot Hunting Pack – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Kroot unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18.|
TAU|EMP GRENADES|000008822004|Kroot Hunting Pack – Wargear Stratagem|1|Furnished by T’au allies or returning Farstalkers, these electromagnetic grenades wreak havoc with the animuses of armoured fighting vehicles.|Either player’s turn|Shooting or Fight phase|Kroot Hunting Pack|000000847|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.legend: The Kroot are experts in camouflage and concealment, able to utilise cover in ways most foes would never consider and - to their great misfortune - do not anticipate.

stratagems.name: BOARDING BLADES
stratagems.rawType: Kroot Raiding Party – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One KROOT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by an additional 1.
stratagems.legend: Expecting close-quarters carnage, these Kroot have adapted the blades on their weapons to slice through even thick armour.

stratagems.name: BRUTE FORCE
stratagems.rawType: Kroot Raiding Party – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a KROOTOX RIDERS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That KROOTOX RIDERS unit.
stratagems.effect:
Roll one D6 for each unit that is within 3 of that Hatchway, if that Hatchway is visible to that unit and that unit is wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.|
TAU|SWEEPING AMBUSH|000009646003|Kroot Raiding Party – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Once they spring their ambush these Kroot move fast, hacking through one band of foes and pouncing on the next before the enemy can regain their footing.|Either player’s turn|Fight phase|Kroot Raiding Party|000000967|WHEN: Fight phase.
stratagems.legend: Where cunning will not suffice, the brutal strength of Krootox sees hatchways and bulkheads smashed to pieces, filling the corridors beyond with whickering shrapnel.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE MOBILITY
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.|
TAU|PINPOINT COUNTER-OFFENSIVE|000008812002|Mont’ka – Battle Tactic Stratagem|1|Mont’ka emphasises rapid evolving threat-analysis and the application of overwhelming firepower to eliminate emergent high-priority targets.|Either player’s turn|Any phase|Mont’ka|000000845|WHEN: Any phase.
stratagems.legend: By advancing swiftly into commanding positions, Mont’ka forces maximise the benefits of their enemies' shock and disorientation.

stratagems.name: THE SHORTENED BLADE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One T’au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6 horizontally away from all enemy models.
RESTRICTIONS: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.|
TAU|THE TORCHSTAR GAMBIT|000008816006|Retaliation Cadre – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Though now disgraced by association with O'Shovah, Sub-Commander Torchstar’s strike-and-fade tactics are still taught - albeit officially under other names - in many Fire caste academies.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Retaliation Cadre|000000846|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Made famous by Commander Farsight and his protege Brightsword, this philosophy encourages pilots to drop into the very teeth of the enemy army and apply their firepower at point-blank range.

stratagems.name: RETREATING FIRE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One FIRE WARRIOR or PATHfINDER TEAM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Collapsing lines of infantry provide a defence in depth through the shipboard confines, allowing the enemy to overextend even as retreating T'au continue to pour fire into them.

stratagems.name: SULPHUROUS VEIL
stratagems.rawType: Changehost of Deceit – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons or Scintillating Legions unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Gouts of choking brimstone or arcane smog seeping from the Warp are exploited to confound the foe.

stratagems.name: ETHEREAL PHANTASM
stratagems.rawType: Changehost of Deceit – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Scintillating Legions unit from your army that is within 9 of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6, or a Normal move of up to 6 instead if it is wholly within 6 of one or more friendly Thousand Sons units.
stratagems.legend: Semi-sentient doppelgangers stalk the battlefield, bewildering attempts to target the daemonic spawn.

stratagems.name: DECEPTIVE GLAMOUR
stratagems.rawType: Changehost of Deceit – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets for its attacks, it can only target your unit if there are no eligible Scintillating Legions targets for those attacks.
stratagems.legend: Tendrils of phantasmal sorcery are sent to invade the minds of the Thousand Sons' foes, magnifying the infernal threat until it eclipses all others in a kaleidoscope of insanity.

stratagems.name: GLIMMERSHIFT PORTAL
stratagems.rawType: Changehost of Deceit – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two Scintillating Legions units from your army (excluding Monsters), or one Scintillating Legions Monster unit from your army, if all of those units are more than 6 horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.|
TS|CHRONOSORCEROUS BLEED|000010198006|Changehost of Deceit – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|By sacrificing minute slivers of the oncoming foes' lives, time can be bled into the Warp, stretching perceptions and causing sudden exhaustion.|Opponent’s turn|Charge phase|Changehost of Deceit|000001062|WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.legend: Weaving a spell of splintering translocation, Tzeentch's daemons can prise open an unnatural pathway through the Warp.

stratagems.name: TZEENTCH’S BOON
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army within range of an objective marker that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes a Psychic Attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: This psyker’s devotion to the God of Change has been rewarded with terrible destructive power.

stratagems.name: COSTLY BLESSING
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER CHARAcTER model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has a 3+ invulnerable save. At the end of the phase, your model suffers D3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: Tzeentch's gifts may protect his followers, but such intervention never comes without cost.

stratagems.name: EMPYRIC DESECRATION
stratagems.when: End of your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER CHARAcTER model from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Select one objective marker Secured by your opponent’s army that is within 6 of and visible to your model, then roll one D6: on a 2+, that objective marker is no longer considered Secured by your opponent’s army.|
TS|INFERNO BOLTERS|000009655004|Chosen Cabal – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The Thousand Sons inferno bolters make use of warp-imbued ammunition capable of burning through bulkheads to strike unsuspecting targets.|Your turn|Shooting phase|Chosen Cabal|000000969|WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.legend: Powerful Sorcerers may use their mastery of the warp to corrupt areas of the battlefield and deny them to the foe.

stratagems.name: FLESH CHANGE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TzAANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
stratagems.legend: Tzeentch’s mutagenic gifts lend resilience to those brave or fool hardy enough to embrace them.

stratagems.name: PSYCHIC INGRESS
stratagems.when: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER CHARAcTER model from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Open every Hatchway within 3 of your model. When measuring this distance, ignore Walls and closed Hatchways.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.|
TS|BESTIAL SURGE|000009664005|Devoted Thralls – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|When struck by enemy fire, the bestial Tzaangors react with instinctive fury, surging towards their assailants in a vengeful flock.|Opponent’s turn|Shooting phase|Devoted Thralls|000000970|WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.legend: The Sorcerers of the Thousand Sons can draw upon their powers to melt away hatches and bulkheads.

stratagems.name: PSYCHIC DOMINION
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [hazardous] ability, and models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks.
stratagems.legend: To pit one's psychic prowess against the sorcerous might of the Thousand Sons is to be trapped, helpless and screaming, within one's mind.

stratagems.name: DESECRATION OF WORLDS
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.legend: The Sorcerers of the Thousand Sons pour their corrupting spite and contempt into the bedrock of the battlefield, tainting it with their warpcraft.

stratagems.name: DESTINED BY FATE
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a saving throw is failed for a Thousand Sons Psyker model from your army. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple saving throws at once.
stratagems.target: That PSYKER model.
stratagems.effect: Change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those attacks you failed a saving throw for.
stratagems.legend: The Architect of Fate has great designs for his pawns, which do not yet include their untimely demise.

stratagems.name: ARCANE FOCUS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after you take a Psychic test for a Thousand Sons model from your army that Channelled the Warp (before resolving that Ritual).
stratagems.target: That THOUSAND SONS model.
stratagems.effect: Re-roll all of the D6 rolled for that Psychic test (including the additional D6 for Channelling the Warp).
stratagems.legend: Using a locus formed from the ritually broken matter of sorcerous artefacts, a Sorcerer can infuse themselves with its power. So invigorated, their empyrically fuelled manipulations are made all the more potent.

stratagems.name: EGOTISTICAL POWER
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select the Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom or Wrath of the Immaterium ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability applies to your unit instead of any other Kindred Sorcery ability, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.
stratagems.legend: Drawing on the accumulating empyric energies, one devoted to Tzeentch will willingly syphon the swelling power to fuel their selfish ploys.

stratagems.name: KALEIDOSCOPIC TEMPEST
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and, if your unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic, each time an attack targets your unit, it has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.
stratagems.legend: As the Thousand Sons solidify their control over sites of magical power, the Immaterium spills into reality in searing torrents, blossoming into a multi-spectral storm of arcane energy that obscures mortal senses and mechanical augury.

stratagems.name: THROUGH THE VEIL
stratagems.when: Start of the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Rubric Marines or Scarab Occult Terminators unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.effect:
If it is a RUBRIC MARINES unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Deep Strike ability. When your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATOR unit it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic and more than 6 horizontally away from all enemy models.
RESTRICTIONS: If a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS unit is targeted with this Stratagem, it is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.|
TS|WARDING HEX|000009742002|Hexwarp Thrallband – Epic Deed Stratagem|1|Thousand Sons Sorcerers draw upon tide swells of Warp energy to weave spells of binding and warding, thereby shackling sites of arcane power to their own arrogant will.|Either player’s turn|Command phase|Hexwarp Thrallband|000000983|WHEN: Command phase.
stratagems.legend: With arcane energy flooding the battlefield, the veil between Warp and reality rapidly collapses. From yawning rifts emerge Rubricae reinforcements to ensure their thrallband’s victory.

stratagems.name: ARDENT AUTOMATA
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Rubricae unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That RUBRICAE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: The martial discipline once known amongst the Legion's fellowships has been pared back and twisted until it is another means of control, one which the Rubricae’s masters use to wrongfoot their foes with sudden changes of tactics.

stratagems.name: INFERNAL FUSILLADE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all inferno bolt pistols, inferno boltguns, inferno combi-bolters and inferno combi-weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and a Strength characteristic of 5.
stratagems.legend: Arcane invocations imbue the Thousand Sons’ weapons with sorcerous power, rendering them still more lethal to the foe.

stratagems.name: HEX-MARKED ARMOUR
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Amorphous runes and sigils carved into the armoured flanks of the Cabal's war engines flare with unholy power, leaching the foe's attacks of strength.

stratagems.name: ENSORCELLED INFUSION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Thousand Sons Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase, that is within 6 of one or more friendly Thousand Sons Psyker units.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by VEHICLE models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and each time an attack is made with such a weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll.|
TS|MUTATE LANDSCAPE|000010210003|Warpforged Cabal – Epic Deed Stratagem|1|Where the Warpforged Cabals spread their malignant change, the terrain erupts in uncontrolled mutation or transmogrifies into hazardous forms.|Your turn|Command phase|Warpforged Cabal|000001065|WHEN: Your Command phase.
stratagems.legend: Utilising the fell powers of the Warp, Thousand Sons Sorcerers infuse vehicles with empyric energies to render them even deadlier.

stratagems.name: CYBERSPIRIT MACHINATIONS
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Thousand Sons Vehicle unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That VEHICLE unit, and one friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit within 6 of that VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn, your VEHICLE unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.|
TS|WARPFLAME GARGOYLES|000010210007|Warpforged Cabal – Wargear Stratagem|1|On the hulls of vehicles swollen with the power of Tzeentch, gnashing maws open to spew warpfire over those nearby.|Opponent’s turn|Charge phase|Warpforged Cabal|000001065|WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.legend: Technoshamanic rites can briefly possess a vehicle's logic-cores, shackling its mechanisms to a new lore.

stratagems.name: DERANGED FEROCITY
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a Tzeentch Mutant unit from your army is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That TZEENTCH MUTANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6 instead of up to 3, and when determining which models in it are eligible to fight, any models in it that are within 3 of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3 of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.
stratagems.legend: With insane, bestial ferocity is true change wrought.

stratagems.name: WARPED VICISSITUDE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Tzaangors unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: With a shrieked plea to Tzeentch, mutant flesh can flicker between insubstantial states as if not there.

stratagems.name: TWISTED MIRAGE
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Tzeentch Mutant unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6 horizontally away from all enemy units, or anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9 horizontally away from all enemy units if it is a Monster unit. In either case, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.legend: The very flesh of a Warpmeld Pact's mutant abominations radiates a reality-twisting aura. They may appear in one place to their foes, but things are not always as they seem.

stratagems.name: RAPACIOUS HUNGER
stratagems.when: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that just destroyed an enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit immediately Regenerates (See Feed the Swarm). When doing so, if your unit is a Harvester unit and you choose for one model to regain up to D3 lost wounds, that model regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.
stratagems.legend: The hunger of the Tyranids can never be satiated.

stratagems.name: BROODGUARD IMPULSE
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Harvester unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your HARVESTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.legend: Should a foe successfully slay one of the swarm’s assimilation organisms, they only mark themselves as a priority for predation and consumption in turn.

stratagems.name: ABLATIVE CARAPACE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Harvester unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, until the end of the phase models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.
stratagems.legend: These organisms have employed consumed minerals to exude an additional hardened protective layer over their chitinous armour.

stratagems.name: RECLAIM BIOMASS
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a TYRANIDS unit from your army is destroyed, before the last model in it is removed from play.
stratagems.target: One Harvester unit from your army that is within 6 of that destroyed unit.
stratagems.effect: Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6 of your HARVESTER unit (See Feed the Swarm).
stratagems.legend: Dead Tyranids are consumed and reconstituted by the swarm just as readily as the lifeless carcasses of their prey.

stratagems.name: TYRANNOFORMED
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Harvester unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
stratagems.legend: Swarms of diminutive Tyranid phage organisms carpet even the most vital strategic assets, steadily breaking them down for assimilation.

stratagems.name: SECURE BIOMASS
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a Harvester unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit as well.
stratagems.legend: When rich sources of biomass are identified the warrior organisms of this swarm will stop at nothing to destroy resistance and claim them.

stratagems.name: ONRUSHING HORDE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army (excluding WINGED TYRANID PRIME units), that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Surging toward their victims in a swift mass of screeching maws and lashing talons, the Tyranids are a panic-inducing sight.

stratagems.name: SWARM HUNTERS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One TERMAGANTs unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can ignore other models in their unit for the purposes of determining visibility. In addition, if your unit is within Synapse Range of your army, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: These Termagants act like a single, many-limbed, many-weaponed organism, squirming around one another to level the most firepower possible.

stratagems.name: LIVING AVALANCHE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a TYRANIDS unit from your army has opened a Hatchway.
stratagems.target: That TYRANIDS unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a Swarm move. To do so, your unit can be moved up to 3, but at least one model from your unit must end that move on the opposite side of that Hatchway from the one it started the phase on. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of enemy units.|
TYR|SQUIRMING MASSES|000009700003|Biotide – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|Like water flowing through every available gap and channel, the Tyranids squeeze through ducts and vents to spill out in the midst of the prey.|Your turn|Movement phase|Biotide|000000975|WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
stratagems.legend: This hatchway does not so much slide open as burst asunder like a breached dam, warrior organisms spilling forth from it in a heaving mass.

stratagems.name: LITHE KILLERS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: These warrior organisms employ agility and stealth in place of resilience, weaving around their victims' blows and exploiting the tangled internal structures of the voidship to their advantage.

stratagems.name: ADRENALISED SLAUGHTER
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 5+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: These organisms contain additional adrenal biomorphs, which send them into a final killing frenzy just before death.

stratagems.name: TALON-TIP SWARM
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a TYRANIDS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That TYRANIDS unit.
stratagems.effect:
If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 3. After that move, if your unit is within range of an objective marker and no enemy units are within range of that objective marker, that objective marker is Secured by your army.|
TYR|PREDATORY POUNCE|000009691005|Boarding Swarm – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The internal hatchways of prey voidships make excellent ambush sites for vanguard organisms.|Opponent’s turn|Movement phase|Boarding Swarm|000000974|WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.legend: As they break the prey's lines, these organisms seek key strategic sites to tear apart.

stratagems.name: OUTFLANK
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALERs or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit from your army that is wholly within an Entry Zone.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. It will arrive back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase. When doing so, if it was within one of your Entry Zones when it was removed, it must be set up wholly within another one of your Entry Zones. If it was within one of your opponent’s Entry Zones when it was removed, it must be set up wholly within another one of your opponent’s Entry Zones instead. If this is not possible, your unit is destroyed.
stratagems.legend: Swarms of Genestealers crawl through vents and ducts as they seek to outflank their prey.

stratagems.name: PERVASIVE DREAD
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after the enemy WARLORD is destroyed (and is not returned to the battlefield) by a GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That GREAT DEVOURER unit.
stratagems.effect: In your opponent’s next Command phase, each enemy unit on the battlefield must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. This Stratagem cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
stratagems.legend: With the death of their leader, the surviving prey feel an ominous sense of doom press down upon them, heightened by subtle psionic assault.

stratagems.name: RAPID REGENERATION
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.
stratagems.legend: Prey stare in horror as chitinous armour regrows and flesh, muscle and sinew knots back together.

stratagems.name: ADRENAL SURGE
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army and are eligible to fight, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army that is eligible to fight.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in any of those selected units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.legend: These warrior organisms destroy all as their adrenaline surges.

stratagems.name: DEATH FRENZY
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: Tyranids care nothing for self-preservation, lashing out even in death.

stratagems.name: OVERRUN
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a TYRANIDS unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.target: That TYRANIDS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3 as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, instead of making that Consolidation move, it can make a Normal move of up to 6.
stratagems.legend: Tyranids in battle form an unstoppable avalanche of flesh and chitin that buries the foe alive.

stratagems.name: PREDATORY IMPERATIVE
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect:
Select one Hyper-adaptation. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Hyper-adaptation is active for those selected units in addition to any other that may be active for your army.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select the same Hyper-adaptation you selected at the start of the first battle round.
stratagems.legend: Guided by the instincts of leader-beasts, the swarm can be tasked with focusing its hunting instincts.

stratagems.name: ENDLESS SWARM
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two Endless Multitude units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: You can return up to D3+3 destroyed models to each of the selected units.
stratagems.legend: As the battle rages, more organisms pour in to bolster the swarms.

stratagems.name: RETREAT BELOW
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Tyranids unit or up to two Burrower units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.legend: The network of tunnels beneath the battlefield enables Tyranid organisms to retreat from the foe and prepare further ambushes.

stratagems.name: TUNNEL NETWORK
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Tyranids unit from your army that is wholly within 9 of one or more of your Tunnel Markers and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect:
Remove your unit from the battlefield and set it up again, wholly within 9 of another Tunnel Marker you placed, and more than 6 horizontally away from all enemy units.|
TYR|SWARMING ASSAULT|000010148006|Subterranean Assault – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|A hive fleet’s vanguard organisms favour mobility and aggression, keeping the foe on the back foot with repeated coordinated assaults.|Your turn|Charge phase|Subterranean Assault|000001057|WHEN: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.legend: Taking advantage of freshly burrowed tunnels, Tyranid bioforms move swiftly across the landscape, emerging in unexpected locations.

stratagems.name: ENFILADING EMERGENCE
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Tyranids unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
stratagems.legend: Emerging from the depths, Tyranid bioforms level their weapon morphs and spit hissing volleys of living ammunition into the exposed backs of outflanked prey.

stratagems.name: REPLENISHING SWARMS
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Tyranids unit from your army, wholly within 9 of one or more Tunnel Markers you placed.
stratagems.effect:
One model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds, or you can return up to D3+1 destroyed models with a Wounds characteristic of 1 to your unit, with their full wounds remaining, instead.|
TYR|ADAPTIVE OPTIMISATION|000010148002|Subterranean Assault – Wargear Stratagem|1|On occasions where subterranean assaults are deemed tactically useful, the hive mind may spontaneously alter its burrowing organisms, enabling them to act as beacons for its will.|Either player’s turn|Command phase|Subterranean Assault|000001057|WHEN: Command phase.
stratagems.legend: Scrambling through the tunnels come endless multitudes of warrior-beasts and harvester bioforms, spilling out of the depths to reinforce the teeming masses.

stratagems.name: REINFORCED HIVE NODE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Synapse unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.legend: Psionic shielding crackles around these leader-beasts, helping to ensure their survival.

stratagems.name: IRRESISTIBLE WILL
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Synapse unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit within 24 of and visible to the SYNAPSE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the attacking model’s unit is within 6 of your SYNAPSE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
stratagems.legend: Whether paralysing its prey or forcing them to stumble out of cover with its force of will, or else puppeteering nearby warrior organisms, the leader-beast ensures the prey targets are struck down.

stratagems.name: THE SMOTHERING SHADOW
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.target: One Synapse unit from your army within 12 of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect:
Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.|
TYR|OVERRIDE INSTINCTS|000008556007|Synaptic Nexus – Strategic Ploy Stratagem|1|The seemingly omniscient Hive Mind processes the sensory input of its swarms at an impossible rate, and compels its broods to react accordingly.|Your turn|Movement phase|Synaptic Nexus|000000773|WHEN: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.legend: In the heart of the swarms, the Shadow in the Warp can literally kill with its smothering power.

stratagems.name: TEEMING MASSES
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Skittering, darting and pouring over one another, the Tyranids make for hard and confusing targets.

stratagems.name: SWARMING MASSES
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and If your unit contains 15 or more models, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.legend: The sheer weight of Tyranid numbers begins to tell as they bury their victims in lashing, biting horror.

stratagems.name: PRESERVATION IMPERATIVE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is treated as containing fewer than five models for the purpose of the [BLAST] ability.
stratagems.legend: Triggered by incoming projectile fire, a synaptic pulse spurs the danger-senses of lesser warrior organisms and causes them to scatter like a shoal evading predators. Only once the explosions have stopped and the dust cleared do the bioforms bunch up once again.

stratagems.name: UNENDING WAVES
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect:
Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
RESTRICTIONS: Any destroyed Character units that were attached to your unit are not returned. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.legend: No matter how many warrior organisms are slain, more are already surging forward over their corpses.

stratagems.name: SYNAPTIC GOADING
stratagems.when: Any phase, just before an Endless Multitude unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army makes a Surge move.
stratagems.target: That ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit.
stratagems.effect: When making that Surge move, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit moves, and your unit can end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker (instead of as close as possible to the closest enemy unit]. All other rules for making Surge moves still apply.
stratagems.legend: For a moment, a minuscule sliver of the Hive Mind’s ineffable will is focussed through these warrior organisms, driving them to pounce upon either valuable prey or else some vital strategic target.

stratagems.name: ASSASSIN BEASTS
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Vanguard Invader Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.legend: These bioforms have been adapted to strike with pinpoint precision at the pre-assessed weak points of selected prey that require elimination.

stratagems.name: SURPRISE ASSAULT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a Vanguard Invader unit from your army has selected its targets.
